slob dpon sangs rgyas bskyangs kyis thal 'gyur ba'i srol phye yang / legs ldan byed kyis thal 'gyur ba'i skyon bzung ba rnams 'gro bar grags nas/ thal 'gyur ba'i bstan pa spel ma thub ste/ phyis zla grags su skye ba bzhes nas 'phags yul du thal 'gyur ba'i bstan pa cung zad spel bar mdzad/ bod gangs can du yang bstan pa snga dar la zhi ba 'tsho/ ye shes snying po/ padma'i ngang tshul te rang rgyud shar pa go gsum spyan drangs te/ rang rgyud pa'i bstan pa ches cher 'phel yod/ thal 'gyur ba'i bstan pa ni ma byung la/ phyi dar la zla ba grags pas a ti shar skye ba bzhes nas thal 'gyur gyi bstan pa spel bar dgongs kyang / ji bzhin ma byung nas a ti sha nyid pa tshab tu skye ba bzhes/ de'i bu chen tshig la mkhas pa gangs pa she'u/ don la mkhas pa gtsang pa 'bre yur/ gnyis ka la mkhas pa rma bya byang brtson/ gnyis ka la mi mkhas pa zhang thang zag pa dang / bzhi'i sgo nas thal 'gyur ba'i bstan pa dar bar byas zhes bshad la/ de ru ni zla grags klu sgrub yab sras kyi dngos slob min pa kho na'i lugs su snang mod/ dbu ma'i yig cha snying ma 'ga' zhig las klu sgrub nas zla grags la brgyud tshul la gsum ste/ nye gnas dngos grub brnyes pa'i rnal 'byor pa las brgyud tshul/ gzhung bshad rgyud kyi mkhas pa paṇḍi ta las brgyud tshul/ rtsa ba klu sgrub nyid nas dngos su thug tshul dang gsum/ dang po ni/ klu sgrub la nye gnas na ga bo dhi ste klu'i byang chub/ shanti de wa ste zhi ba lha/ arya de wa ste 'phags pa lha dang gsum yod pa'i klu sgrub kyi rigs tshogs rnams arya de wa la bshad/ des zla grags la bshad do/ /gnyis pa ni klu sgrub kyi thal rang gi srol 'byed buddha pa li ta ste sangs rgyas bskyangs dang / bai bya ka ra legs ldan byed gnyis la dngos su bshad/ de gnyis ka la zla grags kyis thos so/ /gsum pa ni zla grags kyis klu sgrub la dngos su thug ste/

de yang rgya gar gyi paṇa grub ha su ma ti'i zhal nas zla grags kyis klu sgrub lo brgya phyed bsten zer ro/ /de ltar na nye brgyud la klu sgrub zla grags des lo brgya bzhugs/ de la rig pa'i khu byug gis thug lo gsum brgya bzhugs/ de la sa ra dhe ha/ ha su ma ti/ ka na ka warna gsum gyis thug cing / de gsum ka la pa tshab kyis zhus so/ /pa tshab kyi slob ma gtsang pa sa/ rma bya byang ye/ zhang thang zag pa dang gsum/ yol lcags/ rma bya byang brtson gyis/ rma bya byang ye/ zhang thang zag gtsang pa sa'i slob ma gangs gnyan dang gsum la dbu ma gsan/ yang paṇḍi ta ha su ma ti'i slob ma dza ya a nanda des/ khu lo tsā ba mdo sde 'bar la dbu ma thal 'gyur lugs bshad/ des gtsang nag pa brtson 'grus seng ge la/ des kyang rma bya byang brtson la bshad pas/ rma bya byang brtson ni pa tshab lugs dang / khu lugs kyi dbu ma thal 'gyur ba'i gnad la shin tu mkhas zhes bshad 'dug de bzhin du gsang 'dus 'phags lugs kyi brgyud pa'i lo rgyus dang / do ha skor gsum gyi brgyud pa'i lo rgyus rnams las kyang / zla grags klu sgrub zhabs zin du byas pa'i lo rgyus kho na snang / 'on kyang rig pa'i khu byug zla grags kyi zhabs zin yin la/ a ti sha rig pa'i khu byug gi dngos slob yin zhing / nag tshos jo bo spyan 'dren du phyin pa'i tshe/ yang rig pa'i khu byug bzhugs pa rnam thar dang lam yig dag na gsal bas/ de dag gi lo grangs rtsis na mngon sum du mi 'grig pa ltar snang ste/ sa lugs kyi bstan rtsis ltar na/ a ti sha 'das lo nas lo gsum stong lhag tsam 'das pa'i tshe byon par mngon gsum gyis grub/ klu sgrub 'das lo nas lo bzhi brgya lon pa'i tshe/ byon nas lo drug brgya bzhugs zer bas 'das lo nas lo stong 'das pa'i tshe/ klu sgrub mi bzhugs par khas blangs kyis grub/ de nas zla grags kyis lo lnga brgya bzhugs zer ba dang /

rig pa'i khu byug gis lo gsum brgya bzhugs zer ba rnams rtse mthun/ klu sgrub/ zla grags/ rig pa'i khu byug gsum gyi lo grags kyang / 'das lo nas gsum stong du slebs pa la/ lo stong dang nyis brgya 'chad pas/ a ti sha dang rig pa'i khu byug dus mi mtshungs pa'am/ zla grags dang klu sgrub dus mi mtshungs pa gang rung zhig khas blangs dgos 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ /des na kho bo ni lung rigs kyis dpyad de sngar bshad pa ltar klu sgrub kyi lo drug brgya las ches lhag pa zhig bzhugs pa'am/ yang na dag pa'i snang ba kho nas zhal mjal ba gang rung zhig las ma 'das par khas blangs par bya ste/ chos kyi rjes su 'brang ba'i rnam dpyod kyis dpyad pa las de kho na ltar mthong ba'i phyir ro/ /pa tshab kyi bu bzhi la yang deb sngon las gtsang pa sa smos/ rma bya byang ye/ dar yon tan grags/ zhang thang zag pa ye shes 'byung gnas dang bzhi zhes bshad/ mi mthun pa de dag las rma bya byang brtson ni/ rma bya byang ye dang / zhang thang zag pa sogs kyi slob mar snang zhing / pa tshab la'ang 'dus pa dang / dbu ma gnyis ka gsan zer mod/ bu bzhi'i nang tshan ni rma bya byang ye nyid yin par sems la/ gzhan gtsang pa 'bre rgyur dang / gtsang pa sa sbos zhes dang / gangs pa she'u dang / gangs pa gnyan zhes sogs ji ltar yin kho bos ma 'tshal lo/ /shang pa bka' brgyud ni lo chen 'di'i smad tsam la dar bar sems te/ khong stag lo pa yin zhes pa tsam zhig las gsal bar mi snang yang / khong gis 'phags yul du lan bdun tsam zhig phebs pa dang / 'phags yul nas phebs pa'i tshur lam a ti sha mnga' ris su phebs pa dang mjal zhes dang / khong la 'phags yul du rdo rje gdan pas ming spod pa dang dbu skra gcod pa sogs rab byung sgrub par brtsams kyang mkha' 'gros ma gnang ba la/ phyis glang ri thang pa snang ba mtha' yas su gzigs nas bsnyen par rdzogs zhes dang / khong gis lo brgya dang lnga bcu bzhugs zer ba rnam thar na gsal bas/

de dag dang khong bgrigs na khong gi shangs zhong gi dgon pa btab ste/ ni gu'i zab chos spel ba ni khong rang gi sku tshe'i smad la byung bar gsal bas so/ /de nyid la slob ma'i mchog la stod pa dkon mchog mkhar dang / rmog cog pa rin chen brtson 'grus sogs khri so brgyad yod par grags so/ /rngog lo chen po'i thugs sras de dag las gtso bor phar phyin gyi bstan pa spel ba la 'bre chen po slob brgyud dang bcas pa dang / gtso bor tshad ma'i bstan pa spel ba la gro lung pa dang / khyung gi slob brgyud rnams bka' drin che bar byung 'dug pa las/ 'bre chen po shes rab 'bar ni 'khrungs yul nyang stod gtsang so nang pa yin la/ sku gzhon nu nas yol chos dbang las rab tu byung ste gsan pa mang du mdzad/ de nyid kyi slob ma'i mchog tu gyur te gdan sa bskyangs/ gzhan yang paṇa chen 'bum phrag gsum pa dang / rngog lo chen po sogs bsten te thugs kyi sras su yang gyur/ slob ma grwa pa dpe 'grems stong phrag re byung ba'i nang nas mchog tu gyur pa la stod pa dkon mchog mkhar/ ar byang chub ye shes/ khyung rin chen grags/ snyal pa dregs ston/ mngon pa byang grags/ bya 'dul brtson 'grus 'bar dang drug go /dang po/ la stod pa chen po che ba bcu dang ldan pa'i gnas snying pa zhes grags pa'i gdung brgyud du sku bltams te/ de yang la stod byang gcung du grags pa'i thub mdor/ sngags 'chang spyil rgyal ba grub pa/ de'i sras bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ de'i sras rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ de'i sras thugs rje rin chen/ de'i sras spyil rin chen 'byung gnas/ de nyid kyi jo mo chung ba la sras dkon mchog mkhar/ dkon seng / dkon sprin te gsum byung ba'i yab sras de bzhis shangs kyi gad phur du rnying ma'i chos gsan du byon pas/ 'bre chen po nyang stod kyi mda' na chos 'khor skor ba'i snyan pas thugs 'phrogs te/

sras gsum po 'bre chen po'i drung du btang nas rab byung bsnyen rdzogs byas/ thos bsam mthar phyin/ 'bre chen po'i yon tan bum pa gang byon thugs su chud/ 'di nyid kyi mkhan rabs la 'ded pa na mi bcu'i/ chong btsun shes rab seng ge sba btsun bsod nams dbang phyug yol chos kyi dbang phyug 'bre chen po shes rab 'bar/ la stod dkon mchog mkhar zhes zer ro/ /la stod pa chen po sa byi lo nas yos lo'i bar lo brgya bzhugs/ sku gzhon nu'i dus su lo chen rin bzang la rgyud 'grel dang sgrub thabs 'ga' gsan/ khyung rin chen grags la tshad ma gsan/ phyis dpal ldan sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying po la dus 'khor/ rgyud gsum man ngag dang bcas pa gsan zer ba khong rang gi gdung rabs na 'dug de ltar na lo chen rin bzang gis don dgu bzhes pa'i sa mo byi ba la/ la stod pa bltams par sems/ 'bre chen po'i gdan sa mdzad de tshogs pa brgyad brgya re bskyangs zer/ 'di'i gdung rabs la che ba bcu'i che ba dang po/ sa bdag chos skyong rgyal po'i 'ja' sa'i che ba ni/ gnas snying gi sa cha stod na gtsug lag khang gsum/ smad na she'u lung gsum/ bar na skye rabs tu gsum/ 'bre khyung rje 'bangs dang bcas pa 'di khri ral pa can gyis rgya 'jam dpal gsang ba la 'ja' sas bcad de gnang / de nas de'i sras rgya dpal chen skyabs/ de'i sras bdud 'joms/ de'i sras a mes jo sras phur pa 'phel te gdung rabs gsum gyi ngo la'ang bdag mdzad de/ phur pa 'phel gyi mchod gnas yol mched gsum la phul/ yol gyis slob ma 'bre chen po la gnang / 'bre chen pos thugs sras dkon mchog mkhar la gnang ste/ de phyin chad la stod pa'i dbon brgyud kyis bdag mdzad pa'o/ /che ba gnyis pa sngags 'chang grub thob chen po'i lung bstan gyi che ba ni/ rgya 'jam dpal gsang ba sku 'da' khar/ bu slob rnams kyis ma 'ong pa na gnas snying 'di ji ltar 'gyur zhus pas/

gos kha gang khyer shog gsungs/ de la khong gi zhabs rjes gnyis bzhag zhabs rjes kyi mtha' la khong rang gi lo grangs/ bla ma'i sku 'dra gdugs yod pa so gnyis/ padma yod pa nyer brgyad/ gdugs dang padma med pa nyer brgyad de brgyad cu rtsa brgyad byon no/ /ma 'ongs pa na gnas 'dir spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul pa brgyad cu rtsa brgyad byon pas bstan 'gro'i don byed ces lung bstan pa'o/ /che ba gsum pa paṇa chen dhi paṃ ka ra'i lung bstan rab gnas kyi che ba ni/ jo bo mnga' ris nas nyan tshor phebs pa'i tshe/ yol sku mched gsum gyis mjal/ rab tu dad pa thob/ jo bos yol sba btsun la gtad de rab tu byung / gzhan dag la ma gnang ba'i rta mgrin sho na ma dang / thugs rje chen po'i phyi nang gsang gsum gyi sgrub skor rnams gnang / da nyang chu'i brgyud la bzhugs te song / sa padma 'dab brgyad 'dra ba/ gnam 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad 'dra bar gnas thob ces lung bstan/ yol mched kyis gnas snying du byon/ a mes jo sras phur pa 'phel la/ bsam gtan sgom pa'i gnas gcig zhus pas/ ri gdong pha gi yol tsam na sa phug zhig yod pas der bzhugs zer lung bstan/ gnas de la a mes yol ces grags/ jo bos kyang nyan tsho nas gnas snying du mi tog gtor te rab gnas mdzad pa'o/ /che ba bzhi pa yol sku mched kyi sgrub rtags kyi che ba ni/ a mes jo sras phur pa 'phel gyis gnas snying gi sa cha rnams yol sku mched gsum la phul/ de gsum gyis kyang dge 'dun gyi sde btsugs/ bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa spel/ sku mched gsum gyis sgrub rtags mi 'dra ba re re ston te/ yol chos dbang gis chos gos nyi zer la bskal/ sham bu'i rtsa brgyad grol lam du 'khrid/ mthar brgyad stong pa 'chad pa'i mu nas chos khri'i khar sku gshegs zer/ yol drang srong gis ljon dmar gyi rdo rje gcus pas khrag bton/ yol thog 'bebs kyis brag dkar seng ge kha gdang pa lta bu/

a mes yol gyis sa dgra ru 'gro ba zhig la rta'i zla ba la thog dgu phabs/ snyug skya ltar bsil ba'i nang nas shel gyi mchod rten 'khru gang pa dang / mi gang pa gcig byung ba/ mi gangs pa de hor gyis khyer nas pho brang tā'i tu'i gan ji ra la yod zer/ chung ba deng sang gnas snying na bzhugs pa'o/ /che ba lnga pa spyan ras gzigs kyi lung bstan gyi che ba ni/ la stod pa chen po'i yab spyil rin 'byung gi rmi lam du thugs rje chen po'i sprul pa mi dkar po zhig byung nas/ sa byang phyogs bod kyi rgyal khams 'di/ /nga thugs rje chen po'i gdul bya yin/ /khyad par lha yi rnam 'phrul dngos/ /bskal ldan khyod kyi rgyud la 'jug /byang chub sems dpa'i gdung brgyud gzung / /zhes gsungs nas mi dkar po rang la thim ste byin gyis rlabs pa'o/ /che ba drug pa phyag drug mgon po'i bka' babs kyi che ba ni/ la stod pa chen pos shangs zhong du khyung po'i drung du byon/ bde mchog dang mgon po'i zhal gzigs shing bka' babs/ mai tri pa'i thugs dam mgon thang da lta shangs lo mar grags pa de/ bla ma shangs pas gnas mal zhes par bye mdar phebs nas gro gsol ba'i tshe/ thang sku nam mkha' las la stod dkon mkhar gyi thu bar byon pa da lta gnas snying na bzhugs pa'o/ /bdun pa 'bre shes rab 'bar gyi gdan sa'i che ba ni/ 'bre chen pos la stod pa chen po la gdan sa gtad de/ 'ja' sa che ba'i gnas snying gi sa cha dang / 'bre'i khyad 'phags bcu gsum gyis gtsos pa'i dngos byad thams cad gnang ba ste/ khyad 'phags bcu gsum ni gser sku thub pa dmar po/ bla 'bum skya phod rnam gsum/ gser 'bum byin rlabs char 'bebs/ 'bre'i bla gdugs dkar po/ chos dung bkra shis dar lung / bla yol 'gran zla kun bral/ sbug chal nyi ma rgyang grags/ bum pa bkra shis mjing ring / ber seng ge 'jing snol/ dkar yol zla ba khron chung /

grum ze gnam sngon mo/ gser sga bkra shis 'od 'bar/ chibs pa ngang pa phur shes dang bcu gsum mo/ /che ba brgyad pa bstan srung mahā kā la'i zhal bzhes kyi che ba ni/ de'i tshe la stod pa'i dgongs pa la mkhan po'i dgongs pa ni ma grol/ dus snyigs ma'i sde dgon dang mi dmangs kyi mgo ji ltar 'don snyam pa'i tshe/ chos skyong phyag drug pa zhal dngos su bstan te thugs 'khrig mi 'tshal/ dgon pa'i bdag gnyer nga rang gis byed gsungs zhal gyis bzhes pa'o/ /che ba dgu pa slob ma'i mchog gyur grub thob rnam gsum gyi che ba ni/ la stod dkon mkhar la slob ma'i mchog grub thob phag mo grub pa/ khams pa rdor rgyal/ grub thob nyi phug pa chos grags/ 'khon dbang phyug rin chen dang gsum gyis gtsos pa'i brgyad brgya tsam byung ba'o/ /che ba bcu pa brgyud pa'i mchog gyur byang sems byon tshul ni/ gong gi lung bstan ltar gnas snying pa'am/ la stod pa'i gdung rab la spyan ras gzigs kyi rnam 'phrul brgyad cu rtsa brgyad byon pa'o/ /de ltar na yang 'bre chen po'i bshad rgyun spel ba'i slob ma ar byang chub ye shes yin la/ de'i slob ma khu sher brtson dang gzhon nu tshul khrims/ de gnyis kyi slob ma zhang g.ye ba smon lam tshul khrims/ de'i slob ma gnyal zhig 'jam pa'i rdo rje/ des pho bra 'u shangs rdor lo dgu mtshams bsdams te bshad pa mdzad pa las/ gnyal zhig gi bu dgur grags pa byung ste/ bzad ring / phu thang dar dkon/ gtsang pa gru gu gsum snga tshar/ 'u yug pa bsod nams seng ge bo dong rin chen rtse mo/ gtsang pa jo nam gsum bar tshar/ rgya 'ching ru ba/ 'jam gsar shes rab 'od zer/ skyel nag grags seng gsum phyi tshar ro/ /de dag las phu thang dar dkon gyis stod lung dang yar lung du bshad pa mdzad/ slob ma gnyan dar ma 'dong / bya yul dkar mo sogs so/ /bzad ring gis khro phur bshad pa mdzad/ slob ma lho pa grub seng sogs so/

/gtsang pa gru gus zha lur bshad pa btsugs/ 'u yug pas sa skya 'jam dbyangs sa paṇḍi ta la rnam 'grel gsan/ sa skyar bshad pa mdzad/ slob ma zhang mdo dpal sogs te/ rnam 'grel dar ba 'di 'jam mgon sa skya pa dpon slob kyi drin yin/ bo dong rin rtses brag ram du bshad pa btsugs/ slob ma bu ston grags seng dang / dbu ma pa shes rab 'bum sogs so/ /'jam gsar gyis rkyang dur du bshad pa btsugs/ slob ma kun mkhyen chos sku 'od zer dang / rong pa sga lo sogs so/ /dkyil grags seng la mchims chen pos zhal brda mdzad nas snar thang du bshad pa btsugs/ slob ma skyi ston grags 'bum dang chu mig pa seng ge dpal la sogs pa'o/ /bcom ldan rig pa'i ral gri yang yul phu thang pa yin la/ phyis snar thang du phebs/ snar thang gi thems pa la zhabs bzhag pa dbu la nyi ma shar ba/ snar thang gi tshogs dung bus pa gsum 'dzoms pa'i rten 'brel gyi gnad zab mo 'grig mdze'i rnam rtog cung zad yod kyang tshad ma rnam nges stong tshar gcig bshad pas yul bud/ bka' bstan bcos kyi bsgyur byang dang bam tshad sogs la nges shes mdzad de so sor sdebs/ deng sang bka' 'gyur/ bstan 'gyur zhes grags pa yang khong gi phyogs phyogs su sdebs/ bstan pa rgyan gyi me tog sogs bstan bcos po sti bcu drug tsam brtsams/ slob ma'i mchog dbus pa blo gsal byang chub ye shes dang / btsun pa 'jam sgom 'jam nyeg sogs mang du byon/ phyis btsun 'jam dbyangs kyis rgya nag nas mthun rkyen sbyar/ dbus pa blo gsal/ lo tsā ba bsod rnams 'od zer/ rgyang rong byang chub 'bum gsum gyis bka' 'gyur bstan 'gyur gyi glegs bam bzhengs nas/ 'jam lha khang gi gtsug khang du bzhugs su gsol ba las mang du 'chad de/ phyis bu ston gyis go rim bsgrigs shing dag ma dag gi rab dbye gtan la phab bo/ /rngog lo'i bu chen gro lung pa blo gros 'byung gnas kyis lo tsā ba'i gsungs la gces spras cher mdzad/

de nyid la cha pa chen pos gtugs/ gro lung pa slob brgyud las 'phel ba dang / 'bre ar gyi lugs ni tha dad pa yin zer te/ rgyu mtshan 'bre ar gyi phar phyin gyi bshad pa ni bstan pa snga dar gyi bshad rgyun khams su 'phos pa las byung ba yin la/ gro lung pa sogs ni rngog los phyis kha che nas bslab pa'i bshad rgyun la gtso bor mdzad zer bar snang ngo / /cha pa chen pos lo chen gyi dngos slob gang pa she'u blo gros byang chub dang / khyung rin chen grags kyi slob ma stod lung rgya dmar byang chub grags la tshad ma gtso bor sbyangs/ rig pa'i sgo phye ste/ cha bsdus yid kyi mun sel la sogs pa'i rang shar rtsom pa mang du mdzad/ ne'u thog gi gdan sar phebs te 'chad pa'i rgyun srings/ slob ma'i mchog kyang seng chen brgyad/ che sras bzhi/ seng 'dra brgyad ces sogs yod pa las/ gtsang nag pa brtson grus seng ge dan bags pa smra ba'i seng ge gu sha bsod nams seng ge rma bya brtsod pa'i seng ge rtsegs pa dbang phyug seng ge myang phran pa chos kyi seng ge ldan ma dkon mchog seng ge gnyal pa yon tan seng ge ste seng chen brgyad/ kha gcig gtsang pa 'jam seng 'dren zer/ 'khon jo sras rtse mo/ rngog jo sras ra mo/ khu jo sras ne tso/ mnyos pa jo sras dpal te jo sras bzhi'o/ /'bar dbang grub/ kong po 'jag chung / lho pa sgog zan/ par phu ba bzhi la shes rab btsan bzhi zhes zer ro/ /de ltar cha pa'i seng chen brgyad dang / gnyal zhig bu dgu sogs kyis gtso bor mdo phyogs kyi bstan pa la phan che bar mdzad 'dug go /de dag gis ni bstan pa phyi dar sum stong brgya dang gsum lon pa la lo chen rin bzang byon pa nas sum stong brgya dang dgu bcu pa la rngog lo chen po byon pa'i bar sum stong brgya pa'i bar cung zad bshad zin nas/ gnyis pa sum stong nyis brgya pa'i skabs su byon pa'i mkhas grub dam pa ni/

dpal sa skya pa chen po yab sras rnams dang / dwags po bka' brgyud yab sras rnams dang / bka' gdams sku mched gsum gyi thugs sras rnams te/ de yang sum stong nyis brgya dang nyer bzhi 'das pa'i nyer lnga pa chu pho sprel lo dpal sa skya pa chen po bltams/ lo 'di phyi dar sa mo bya nas brgya dang zhe bzhi pa yin la/ jo bo byon pa'i shing rta nas so dgu pa yin zhing / rngog lo byon pa'i me bya nas so drug pa yin pas/ 'di'i bcu drug pa me mo phag la rngog lo bstan pa'i nyi ma sku gshegs/ rngog los bcu gcig lon pa me mo lug la lo chen rin bzang mkha' spyod du zhud/ sa chen rang gi bcu gcig pa la yab sku gshegs/ ba ri lo tsā ba rin chen grags kyis bka' drin chen pos bskyangs te gzim khang rnying mar 'jam dbyangs sgrub pas phyi'i bar chad bsal te sgrol ma'i zhal gzigs/ nang gi bar chad bsal te mi g.yo ba'i zhal gzigs/ zla ba drug nas 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi zhal gzigs te/ zhen pa bzhi bral la sogs pa'i phar phyin gyi gdams pa zab mo'i bka' drin bstsal/ bcu gnyis pa la rong ngur rmig tu brang ti dar ma snying po la mngon pa gsan/ brang ti de ni khu ston gyi slob ma rwa khri bzang 'bar gyi slob ma ste/ rngog lo chen po paṇḍi ta 'bum phrag gsum pa dang mjal ba'i phyir 'khor dge slong sum brgya dang bcas te phebs pa na/ lo tsā ba'i 'khor dge slong re re la/ rang gi slob bu dge slong bcu gsum bcu gsum bsnyen bkur byed du bcug zer/ de nas lo tsā ba'i dngos slob khyung rin chen grags dang mes lhang tsher ma la dbu chad/ kha'u pa dar ma rgyal mtshan sku mched la gsang 'dus dang mgon po zhal gyi chos skor/ sgyi chu ba dgra lha 'bar la kyai rdor/ gung thang pa mal lo la bde mchog dang mgon po'i man ngag gsan/ pu rang lo chung la bde mchog sogs gsan/ rang lo nyi shu rtsa dgu lcags pho byi lo gung thang nas 'cham mgon sa skyar phyag phebs/

'cham mgon 'di ni tho btsun grub rjes mahā bho dhi'i sku bzhengs pa'i dus bzhengs pa yin/ de'i tshe bla ma zhang ston dgung lo re brgyad bzhes pa'i tshe byi lo nas lo ngo bzhi'i bar du/ zhang ston la gsungs ngag zab mo'i bka' drin nod de rang lo so gnyis pa chu mo yos bu'i lo sgrub pa'i lung sbyin ngo mtshar ba'i rdzu 'phrul gyi ltad mo bstan/ rang lo zhe bdun pa sa pho rta'i lo rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug grub chen bi ru pa gtso 'khor lnga chos sgo skyel du byon te/ spyir rgyud sde bdun cu rtsa gnyis kyi man ngag khyad par lcags ri las mi 'da' ba'i zab chos bzhi la sogs te/ mdor na gsung ngag nye brgyud kyi zab mo'i bdud rtsi'i ngom par gsol/ rang lo lnga bcu pa lcags mo bya'i lo zhang gis gdams pa'i lo bco brgyad kyi bka' rgya yang grol te/ mdo khams kyi khams pa a seng gis zhus pa'i ngor/ gsung ngag thog mar bka' bstsal/ gzhung bshad a seng mar grags pa yi ger bkod/ rgyud man ngag zab mo'i bdud rtsi spel/ sku'i bkod pa mi 'dra ba drug bstan/ slar re bdun pa sa pho stag dbyug zla'i tshes bcu bzhi la sku 'bum rnam rgyal du grags par chos dbyings su gshegs/ bde ba can/ po ta la/ u rgyan/ byang gser mdog can bzhi na sku'i bkod pa bzhis bskal ldan gyi don mdzad cing da lta yang bzhugs skad/ phag grub pa'i rnam thar na bde ba can/ byang ya yu ta ra/ gser mdog can gsum na sku'i bkod pa gsum bstan te bzhugs/ 'di rang ngo mtshar che gsungs skad do/ /slob ma'i mchog ni sing ga gling gi rnal 'byor pa/ byang chub sems dpa' stag sgom pa skyi 'bar te mchog thob gsum/ rje btsun rin po che/ zhu byas dngos grub/ dga' ston rdo rje grags/ sgom pa 'od zer grags/ nags sgom bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ 'tshar kha'i rnal 'byor pa/ mang chung pa ste bzod thob bdun/ gzhan yang rtogs pa dang ldan pa brgyad cu byon no/

/'o na rje btsun rtse mo mi 'dren pa ji ltar zhe na/ de ni bla ma chen po dang ngo bo gcig pas so sor ma phye zhes mkhas pa dag gsung ngo / /gzhan yang gzhung bshad gces par 'dzin pa'i thugs sras bcu gcig ni/ tshig rkang rnam par 'grel ba'i thugs sras bdun/ phyogs kyi mkhas grub chen po bzhi zhes bya ste/ zhu byas kyis sdebs pa'i bstod pa las/ zab don yongs su rdzogs pa'i slob ma ni/ /pho brgyad mo gsum dag la yi ger gdams/ /zhes pa ltar khams pa a seng / lho pa zhu byas/ klog skya jo sras chos grags/ thugs sras snyan phul chung pa/ gtsug tor rgyal mo mtshan dngos bsod nams rdo rje/ spyan ras gzigs kyi rnam 'phrul byang sems zla ba rgyal mtshan/ bzang ri phug pa/ khams pa sna theng gnyag bzhi/ rwa ba dbang phyug rgyal mtshan te pho brgyad/ rang sras kun dga' 'bar gyi yum jo lcam phur mo/ g.ya' lung gi jo mo 'a 'u ma/ mang mkhar gyi jo mo mang chung ma ste mo gsum/ rnam 'grel bcu gcig zhes grags pa ni/ gang zag 'di bcu gcig la gdams pa yin gyi gzhan du yid g.yo bar ma byed cig gnyis pa gzhung bshad mdzad pa'i dngos slob ṇa ro bande bshes gnyen grags/ stod sgom byang chub shes rab/ me nyag pradzña dzwa la/ zhu brag dmar ba/ zhang zer dmar ba/ 'u yug gi g.yar sbu ba ma/ phag mo grub pa'o/ /phyogs kyi mkhas grub bzhi ni/ la stod dkon mchog mkhar/ khams pa sga lo/ nai tshe sbas ston/ gshen rdo rje bzang po'o/ /mdor na spyir mdo rgyud kyi snying po dang / sgos bla chen 'brog mi'i rgyud man ngag gi bcud kyi snying po 'dzin pa ni dpal ldan sa skya pa chen po 'di kho na ste/ ji skad du/ ma dros ye shes zhabs las rgyun bzhi'i bla ma ni/ /rgyal po rig dang snying po snang ba'i mtha' can te/ /rig dang snying po'i zhabs la 'bar ba 'bar ba'i mtha'/ /rgyun bzhi 'dzin pa'i bla chen de la bdag phyag 'tshal/

/zhes pa ltar 'brog mi lo tsā ba ma dros pa'i mtsho chen po las/ 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po/ se ston kun rig mnga' ris pa gsal ba'i snying po/ 'khyin lo tsā ba 'od kyi snang ba ste/ gaṅgā la sogs pa'i chu bo chen po bzhi dang 'dra ba'i rgyud man ngag gi rgyun babs pa/ bla chen sa skya pa chen po'i thugs kyi snod du nye bar bzung ba yin te/ de yang rgyun thog mtha' gnyis ni/ 'khon dkon mchog rgyal pos/ 'brog mi dang 'khyin gnyis char la dngos su gsan zhing / de nyid la bla chen sa skya pas dngos su gsan pas grub/ rgyun bar ma gnyis ni/ se las zhang ston chos 'bar dang / mnga' ris pa las sgyi chu ba dgra lha 'bar gyis gsan la/ de gnyis la sa chen gyis dngos su gsan pas grub pa yin no/ /de ltar na yang spyir gsung ngag lam 'bras kyi bka' srol bco brgyad ces grags te/ bla chen 'brog dang gyi jo las brgyud pa'i lam 'bras gnyis las/ gyi jo lugs dang gcig dang po las 'phel ba la bla chen 'brog gi sku'i sras ind+ra dang rdo rje las brgyud pa'i lam 'bras/ thugs kyi sras de pa'i lam 'bras dang gnyis te gsum/ se 'khar chung pa nas 'phel ba rab 'bring gsum du yod pa'i 'bring du thob pa zha ma nas 'phel ba la/ pho brgyud mo brgyud bsres brgyud gsum/ pho brgyud la yang rje khum bu ba chos rgyal nas/ se sgom grags rgyal/ rje mal gyo sogs las 'phel ba'i slob brgyud dang / sras zha ma lcam sring nas spang lte nyi ma grags la 'phel ba'i bsres brgyud de gnyis/ mo brgyud la yang zha ma'i slob ma nyang sgom las/ smon dkar ba/ ston g.yung / dbon po sher tshul gsum nas 'phel ba'i lugs gsum ste pho mo'i lugs lnga dang brgyad/ bsres brgyud la zha ma pho mo bsres pa dum bu ko brag pa'i lugs/ zha ma pho mo gnyis/ sa lugs dang gsum bsres pa cha gan gyi lugs/ 'brog mi lugs dang / gyi jo lugs bsres pa jo nang kun spang gi lugs/

lam 'bras/ sbyor drug rdzogs chen gsum bsres pa la stod dbang rgyal gyi lugs te/ bsres brgyud bzhi dang bcu gnyis/ rab tu thob pa zhang gi brgyud 'dzin sa lugs la/ snga bu dang phyi bu gnyis/ snga bu la phag grub lugs dang / gces sgom lugs gnyis/ phyi bu la nye brgyud/ ring brgyud gnyis te sa lugs bzhi dang bcu drug 'brog jo sras gnyis dang zhang ston mched gnyis te bzhis gsung ngag gi gces mdzod bsdus pa mang lam zhig po'i lugs dang bcu bdun/ se ston las tha mar thob pa byang chub ye shes kyis zhing phug pa la gdams pa'i lugs dang bco brgyad do/ /de dag re re las ji ltar 'phel tshul mang bas ma bris so/ /sum stong nyis brgya dang don bzhi 'das pa'i don lnga pa chu pho khyi la rje btsun rtse mo byon/ lo gsum pa la 'jam dbyangs/ dges rdor sgrol ma gsum gyi zhal gzigs/ bcu drug pa yan la rgyud man ngag gi sgro dogs chod/ bcu bdun pa nas phyā pa'i drung du byon/ snga phyir lo bcu gcig tu mdo phyogs kyi sgro 'dogs bcad/ nyer bdun pa me mo phag la chos la 'jug pa'i sgo brtsams/ nyer brgyad pa la gsung ngag rin po che gnang ba'i sgo nas gdul bya bskal ldan la 'jam dbyangs/ phyag na padma/ birwa pa gsum gyi dag pa'i snang ba bstan/ zhe gcig pa chu pho stag gi rmal zla'i tshes bcu gcig la dag pa'i zhing du gshegs/ rje pas mdzad pa'i gsol 'debs gdung dbyangs ma'i mchan las/ tshes bcu'i dgong rje btsun sku mched kyis tshes bcu'i mchod pa mdzad/ nang par rje pas byon pas na bza' sbu gu thibs pos sku lus ma spang par mkha' spyod du bzhud/ gdung dbyangs kyi gsol ba drag tu btab pas/ na bza'i sbu gu nas bung ba'i skad lta bu'i lung bstan khyad par can zhig byung zhes bshad do// ༈ //sum stong nyis brgya dang don dgu 'das pa'i brgyad cu sa me mo yos la rje btsun grags pa byon/

brgyad lon pa'i tshe byang sems zla rgyal las tshangs spyod kyi dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa nod/ bcu gsum pa la dpal ldan sa skyar gdan sar phebs/ nga drug pa chu pho khyi lo snye mo ru mtshams kyi gtsang kha dgon par mtshan gyi 'od gsal chen po'i ngang las/ bla ma sa chen gyi sku ye shes kyi snang ba bstan te/ lam 'bras shin tu nye brgyud ces grags pa brda don gsal ba'i bka' drin mchog tu nos/ rang lo bdun cu pa me pho byi ba'i dbo zla ba'i tshes bcu gnyis la dag pa'i zhing du gshegs kyi bar du bstan pa'i bya ba kho na mdzad pa'i sras kyi dam pa ni chos rje sa paṇa nyid yin la/ grags pa'i mtha' can bzhir grags pa ni/ dkar shākya grags/ nub pa rig 'dzin grags/ ṇa ro bande bshes gnyen grags/ gsal la dbang phyug grags dang bzhi'o/ /grags pa mi brgyad/ ces grags pa ni snga ma bzhi'i steng du gra ston blo gros grags/ dga' ston bdud rtsi grags/ lde ston dkon mchog grags/ sa ston 'jigs med grags dang bzhi la 'jog par sems so/ /gur rgyan zhus pa'i mi bzhi ni/ mu tshu byang chub grags/ gtsang ston brtson 'grus grags/ lha thog yon tan gzung / rigs ldan shes rab rin chen dang bzhi'o/ /rig 'dzin gyi sdom brtson chen po bzhi ni/ jo sras lcags kyi rdo rje/ dbon ston skyer sgang pa chen po/ rtsis 'dul gzhon nu seng ge khams kyi 'dzi ston dge slong ngo / /de na da lta'i shing byi 'di sa chen gyi chu sprel nas bzhi brgya dang don gsum/ rtse mo'i chu khyi nas bzhi brgya dang nyer gsum/ grags pa'i me yos nas bzhi brgya dang bco brgyad lon pa'i lo de yin no zhes shes par bya'o// ༈ //sum stong nyis brgya dang bcu gcig 'das pa'i bcu gnyis pa sa mo lug la bka' brgyud dwags po bltams/ rang lo nyer drug pa la mar yul blo ldan la bsnyen par rdzogs/ thog mar rnal 'byor pa chen po'i slob bu mang ra brtson 'grus 'bar sogs las bka' dam gsan/

rang lo so gnyis lon pa'i tshe rje mi la don gcig bzhes skabs su mjal te/ bka' rgyud kyi zab chos gsan/ bka' phyag chu bo nyis 'dres kyi gdams pa thugs nyams su blangs/ khyad par du dwags po bka' rgyud ces snyan pas phyogs kun tu khyab pa lags so/ /'di nyid don lnga pa bya lo sgrog gi zla ba'i tshes bco brgyad kyi snga dro gshegs so/ /'di la slob bu'i tshogs ni dwags po sgom tshul/ phag mo grub pa/ grub thob dbu se/ bha rong ras pa ste brgyud 'dzin gyi bu chen bzhi/ dwags po sgom chung / rmog cog pa/ gsal stong sgom she/ bla ma 'ol ka ba ste thugs sras bzhi/ dwags po 'dul 'dzin la sogs pa nye sras bzhi sogs mang du byon yang / brgyud 'dzin gyi gtso bo phag grub pa nyid lags so/ /dwags po 'di sa chen las lo bcu gsum gyis bgres/ dwags po'i slob ma phag grub pa/ dbu se'am dus gsum mkhyen pa/ gsal stong sgom she gsum la khams pa mi gsum zhes grags te/ sum stong nyis brgya dang zhe gnyis 'das pa'i zhe gsum pa lcags pho stag la phag gru dang / dus gsum mkhyen pa gnyis bltams/ 'di gnyis sa chen las lo bcu gnyis kyis gzhon no/ /de yang phag grub lo bco brgyad la dbus su byon/ rgya dmar la dbu tshad gsan/ nyer lnga pa la zus phur bya 'dul gyis mkhan po/ stod lung rgya dmar gyis slob dpon/ ar gyis gsang ston mdzad de bsnyen par rdzogs shing mdo la sbyangs/ de nas gtsang du byon las ston dkon mchog mkhar gyi sras gsum gyi ya gcig yin/ sras gnyis pa nyi phug pa chos grags stag ste/ seng ge lung du chu mo bya la 'khrungs/ sa chen las lo gnyis kyis gzhon/ de nas phag grub pas dpal ldan sa skyar phebs/ sa chen snga phyir lo bcu gsum bsten/ gzhung bshad bshad mdzod mar grags pa de zin thor sdebs/ khong gi slob ma pradzña kartis/ de la 'grel bshad kyang mdzad/ da lta yang lung rgyun bzhugs/

byang sems zla rgyal la sems bskyed dang / dmar chos rgyal la bde mchog sogs gsan/ phyis dwags po rin po che'i zhabs pad bsten/ dgung lo zhe dgu pa la phag grur phebs/ 'jag spyil rin po cher lo bdun bzhugs/ grwa pa brgyad brgya la gdugs thogs lnga brgya byung zer/ re gcig pa lcags pho stag zla ba bdun pa'i nyer lnga la gshegs so/ /'di'i slob ma'i mchog mos gus mthar thug stag lung pa bkra shis dpal/ rtogs pa'i mthar thug rnam bu ba gling ras/ shes rab mthar thug par phu ba/ nus pa mthar thug 'chan phu ba ste bka' babs bu chen bzhi/ par phu ba 'di cha pa'i slob ma shes rab can bzhi'i par phu bar grags pa de yin/ bskal ldan ye shes seng ge rtogs ldan mi nyag sgom rin/ grub thob nyag re se bo/ kun ldan gtsang pa ras chung bzhi la gdams pa'i bu bzhi zer/ 'bri khung kyu ra rin chen dpal/ chos rje lta bum pa/ chos rje rgyal tshar/ ban dha phug pa bzhi la ro gcig rtogs pa phyed bzhi zer te/ ban dha phug pa la jo mo yod pas phyed zer ro/ /de sogs mang du yod kyang gtso bor bsdus na gling ras/ 'bri stag gnyis/ khro phu ba/ kun ldan gtsang pa ras chung dang bzhir 'dus so/ /dus gsum mkhyen pa'am dbu se ni bcu drug lon pa'i tshe/ rngog lo'i slob ma sre bo mchog gi bla ma dang / chag seng ge grags las rab tu byung / mtshan dpal chos kyi grags pa zer/ lo nyi shu pa la dbus stod lung se thang du byon/ rgya dmar dang cha pa la dbu tshad/ sha ra ba la bka' gdams/ pa tshab la rigs tshogs/ sa skya pa'i thugs sras shes rab rdor bzang la lam 'bras/ rga lo dang a seng la sbyor drug sogs gsan/ mal 'dul 'dzin la bsnyen par rdzogs/ lo sum cu pa la dwags po'i sras su gyur/ lo brgyad cu rtsa bzhi pa la gshegs so/ /de'i slob ma ni brgyud 'dzin gyi bka' babs 'gro mgon ras chen/ 'gro don gyi bka' babs grwa pa bka' gdams pa/

rtogs pa'i bka' babs dgra sgom chos btson/ rdzu 'phrul gyi bka' babs rje chug sangs rgyas dang bzhi'o/ /sum stong nyis brgya dang nga drug pa chu mo lug la skye med zhang brtson 'grus grags pa byon/ dang po sgom tshul dang rga lo sogs bsten/ tshal dang gung thang sogs btab/ don gnyis pa chu mo glang la gung thang gi 'bum mo che bzhengs/ bang rim gsum pa'i tshe zhi bar gshegs so/ /de na da lta'i shing byi 'di dwags po'i sa mo lug nas bzhi brgya dang gya drug phag grub pa dang dus gsum mkhyen pa'i lcags stag nas nyis brgya dang nyer lnga/ zhang gi chu mo yos nas bzhi brgya dang nyer gnyis su slebs pa'i lor shes par mdzod cig sum stong nyis brgya dang drug cu 'das pa'i re gcig pa sa pho sprel lo gling ras bltams/ rang lo so gcig pa nas rgyal ba lo dang / sum pa sogs lo ras mched gsum snga phyir lo bco lnga bsten te/ nā ro'i gdams pa'i nyams su bzhes/ zhe gcig pa la phag grub pa'i lhan cig skyes sbyor gsan pas/ chu bo gaṅgā tshun na blta ba bzang bar grags/ dbyar zla gsum phag grur bzhugs/ bud med sngon po zhig gis mdo rgyud kyi lung gnang bas/ mdo rgyud rang dbang du 'grel ba'i spob pa thob/ bka' 'gyur thugs la bzhugs/ mkha' 'gro ma lngas rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan rgyu gos chen la/ sku rnams thags la thon pa phul ba/ da lta yang rna bu chos lung la yod gsungs/ rang lo re gcig pa sprel lo dbyar ra'i nyer brgyad la gshegs/ 'di skye med zhang las lo lngas gzhon no/ /gling ras kyi slob ma'i gtso bo ni gtsang pa rgyal sras ye shes ston no/ /sum stong gnyis brgya dang don bzhi 'das pa'i don lnga pa chu pho khyi la stag lung chos rje bkra shis dpal yang shod bong rar bltams/ lo bco brgyad pa la rab tu byung / nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa la dbus su byon/ phag grub pa lo drug bsten/ so dgu pa lcags mo byi lo stag lung du phebs/

tshogs pa stong phrag 'dus/ rang lo re dgu pa rta lo mgo zla ba'i tshes bcu dgu la gshegs so/ /'bri khung pa chen po ni khams kyi ldan dmar chu mo phag la byon pas stag lung pa las lo gcig gis gzhon/ so lnga pa la zhang sum thog pa skye po yer rdor las bsnyen par rdzogs so/ /sku gzhon nu nas phag grub pa bsten/ gdan sa lo gsum mdzad de gzhan don cher ma byung / phyis so bdun pa la 'bri khung du phebs/ tshogs pa lnga khri lnga stong lnga brgya nyer lnga 'dus/ 'di ni slob dpon klu sgrub kyi skye bar grags te/ sing gha gling gi dgra bcom pa zhig gis kha che paṇa chen gyi gcung po la me tog bzhi bskur te/ gcig 'bri zhes bya ba'i dgon pa na slob dpon klu sgrub byang chub sems dpa' rin chen dpal du skye ba blangs yod pas de la phul/ gcig ratna pu ṭa'i gtsug lag khang na byang chub sems dpa' bskal ldan shing rta yod pa de la phul/ gcig de wa bha wa zhig yod pa de la phul/ gcig lha chen po zhig bzhengs pa 'dug pas de'i thugs khar zhog ces bshad pa dang / yang kha che paṇa chen klas mo cher bzhugs pa'i tshe/ 'bri khung pa'i khams btsun zhig gis paṇa chen la chos blangs zhes sku chos la 'jus/ nye gnas kyis kho sdabs te snar khrag phyung bas/ paṇa chen thugs dam kyi tshe sgrol ma 'byon pa la/ zhag bdun du ma byon te khyod slob dpon gyis klu sgrub kyi slob ma la sdig bsags/ nyes de sbyong ba la rab byung gzhan la rang gi lo grangs kyi chos gos byin cig ces sogs bshad pa las shes so/ /dgongs gcig la sogs pa'i bstan bcos brtsams/ thugs sras spyan snga bas 'grel pa yang mdzad do/ /mthar rang lo don lnga pa glang lo zla ba gnyis pa'i nyer lnga la sku gshegs pa las/ slob ma gnyis kyi tshogs pa la zhal ston par gsol bas/ slar 'od gsal las bzhengs te/ nyi ma gnyis su chos gnang nas nyer bdun la gshegs so/

/mchod pa gang la 'dzin zhu pas nyer lnga la gzung gsungs te nyi shu lnga mchod du grags so/ /'di'i thugs sras ni spyan snga ba grags pa 'byung gnas te/ 'di ni rje btsun grags pa chos dbyings su gshegs pa'i gsol 'debs kyi tshogs dpon la/ chos rje sa paṇa gyis spyan drangs zhes kyang zer ro/ /de na 'bri stag gnyis kyi bar na lo gcig las med la/ stag lung pa chen po rje btsun bsod rtse dang na mnyam/ de gnyis gling ras las lo bcu bzhis gzhon no/ /bka' gdams pa'i bskor la glang thang pa shing pho rta lo pa yin pas/ sa chen las lo bco brgyad kyis bgres/ sha ra ba lcags pho khyi lo pa ste/ sa chen las nyer gnyis kyis bgres/ bya yul ba gzhon 'od shing mo yos lo pa ste/ sa chen las lo bco brgyad kyis bgres/ bya 'chad ka ba ye shes rdo rje lcags mo sbrul lo pa ste/ sa chen las lo dgus gzhon/ stabs ka ba dar ma grags chu mo lug lo pa ste/ sa chen las lo bcu gcig gis gzhon/ 'od 'jo ba gzhon nu yon tan me mo lug lo pa ste/ sa chen las lo lngas gzhon/ bsod rtse las bco lngas sgres/ rje sgam po pa ni sha ra ba las lo brgyad dang / bya yul ba las lo bzhis gzhon/ gling ras sa chen las lo so gcig gis gzhon/ gzhan yang cha pa'i seng chen brgyad/ gnyag zhig bu dgu/ pa tshab bu bzhi sogs sa chen yab sras gsum dang ci rigs par thog mtshungs pa lags so/ /sum stong nyis brgya dang go gsum 'das pa'i go bzhi pa lcags mo sbrul la gling gi thugs sras gtsang pa rgyal ras nyang stod du byon/ 'di rje btsun grags pa las lo bcu gnyis kyis gzhon/ 'brug ra lung gi dgon pa btab/ 'brug pa zhes yongs su grags shing / nā ro pa'i sprul par byed/ 'di la slob ma'i mchog dbon sras dang / chos sras gnyis/ dang po ni dbon sras dar ma seng ge sogs so/ /gnyis pa la dang por che ba spa rkyang gnyis/ bar du che ba rgya 'bras gnyis/

tha mar che ba lo sgod gnyis sogs yod pa las/ dang po ni spa ri ba dang rkyang mo kha pa gnyis/ gnyis pa ni rgya legs pa dang / 'bras mo ba gnyis/ gsum pa ni lo ras pa dang / sgod tshang pa gnyis so/ /de yang lo nas mched pa la smad 'brug dang / sgod tshang pa nas mched pa la stod 'brug dang / dbon sras sogs kyis skyong ba la bar 'brug ces grags so/ /gzhan yang sku'i sprul pa dam pa sa bskor ba/ gsung gi sprul pa dam pa gter khu ba/ thugs kyi sprul pa dam pa ko brag pa/ 'phrin las kyi sprul pa grub thob mgon ye dang bzhi'o/ /de lta bu'i gtsang pa rgya ras de ni nga gcig pa dbo zla ba'i nyer lnga la gshegs so/ /'di nyid bltams pa'i lcags sbrul nas bzhi brgya dang nyag bzhi ru slebs pa ni shing pho byi lo 'di yin no// ༈ //gsum pa sum stong gsum brgya pa'i skabs su byon pa'i/ ko brag pa/ khro lo/ sa lo/ rgod tshang pa rnams te/ de yang sum stong sum brgya dang gnyis 'das pa'i gsum pa lcags pho stag la ko brag pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan ding rir byon/ lo brgyad cu bzhugs/ dwags po bka' rgyud dang / lam 'bras zha lugs sogs la nyams len mdzad/ slob ma'i gtso bo yang dgon pa dang / mchims nam mkha' grags gnyis/ gzhan yang lcags lo khro lo chag lo mnyal lo ste/ lo tswa ba bzhi'o/ /deb sngon las ko brag pa/ sa paṇa dang dgung mnyam yin zer ro/ /sum stong sum brgya dang bzhi 'das pa'i lnga pa chu pho sbrul la khro phu lo tsā ba byams pa dpal byon/ 'di ni phag grub pa'i dngos slob rgyal tsha rin mgon dang / de'i dbon po kun ldan gtsang ma ras chung gnyis yod pa'i kun ldan ras pa'i dbon po yin la/ kun ldan ras pa'i slob ma ma gcig ri mas nya pa lug skyes zhes pa la bu gcig skyes pa/ skyes bu dam pa gcig 'byon par shes nas gso skyong mdzad pas/ lce sgom rdzogs par grags/ mkha' skyong brag pa zhes kyang bya/

'di nyid sa chen gyi dngos slob tu 'dod/ 'ga' zhig sa chen gyi dngos slob rgyal tsha phug pa yin la/ de yang ma gcig ri ma'i dngos slob gces sgom rdzong pa yin zer/ 'ga' zhig 'di 'khrungs yul khams pa yin la/ nyi gzhur brag tu lta ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i don skyong bas mkha' skyong brag pa dang / rta nag gi rdzong la sgom pas lce sgom rdzong pa yang grags zer/ bdag gi bla ma ni lce sgom 'di la rta nag lce sgom dang / kha rag lce sgom sogs yod pa'i man ngag rin spung gsung ba po ni rta nag lce sgo yin gsung ngo / /gang na'ang khro los/ rje mi tra/ paṇa chen buddha shrī/ shākya shrī gsum rim pas spyan drangs/ byams chen bzhengs pa sogs bstan pa'i bya ba mtha' yas par mdzad do/ /sum stong sum brgya dang bcu bzhi 'das pa'i bco lnga pa chu pho stag la gangs can mkhas pa'i gtsug brgyan sa paṇḍi ta byon/ chu stag de nas sum brgya dang dgu bcu rtsa gsum lon pa'i lo ni da lta'i shing byi 'di yin la/ des na phyi dar sa mo bya nas nyis brgya dang so gsum song zin pa'i so bzhi pa'am/ rngog lo tsā ba byon pa'i me mo bya nas brgya dang nyer lnga 'das pa'i nyer drug pa'am/ sa chen kun snying byon pa'i sa pho sprel lo nas dgu bcu 'das pa'i go gcig pa chu pho stag la sa paṇḍi ta bstan pa'i nyi ma shar ba yin no/ /sa paṇḍi ta 'di nyid btsas ma thag tu saṃ skri ta'i gsung dbyangs snyan par sgrogs/ bco lnga yan chad la rje btsun chen po'i drung du sa skya gong ma'i gsung gi bcud mdo sngags kyi zab gnad yongs su rdzogs/ bcu dgu pa ku mud bzhad pa'i dus kyi 'od gsal chen po'i ngang las/ a phyi 'bum pa'i drung du/ mkhas mchog dbyig gnyen la chos mngon pa mdzod dang / kha che paṇa chen la de nyid kyi chos zab mo rdo rje'i glu las legs par nos/ rgya gar shar phyogs su phyogs kyi glang po'i khri la 'khod de/

glegs bam gzhal du med pa'i lde mig bzung / pad dkar bzhad pa'i dus kyi mdangs rab tu rgyas pa'i tshe/ 'phrang du zhu don rdo rje skyabs la byams chos sogs lung gi chos skor/ nyi shu pa la rkyang dur du rma bya byang brtson dang / gtsang nag pa'i dngos slob tshur ston gzhon nu seng ge la/ bod bgres po las brgyud pa'i tshad ma'i chos skor/ gzhan yang cha pa'i seng chen brgyad kyi rtsegs pa dbang phyug seng ge la bod la grags pa'i grub mtha' bzhi'i chos ji snyed pa/ spyi bo lhas byang chub 'od la bod la grags pa'i zhi byed/ rdzogs chen/ gcod/ bka' gdams la sogs pa'i gdams ngag ji snyed khong du chud/ nyer gsum pa shing pho byi lo gtsang chu mig tu kha che paṇa chen dang mjal/ paṇa chen de nyid dang de'i slob bu rgya gar shar nub gung gsum na sgra la mkhas par grags pa'i saṃ ga shrī ste dge 'dun dpal dang / su ga tā shrī ste legs par gshegs pa'i dpal dang / dā na shī la ste tshul khrims sbyin la sogs par snga phyir bsten te/ bod rgan po'i 'dres kyis ma bslad pa'i lha rgyan gyi bshad srol las byon pa'i tshad ma la sogs pa'i rig gnas che ba lnga/ snyan ngag sdeb sbyor/ mngon brjod/ zlos gar/ rtsis te rig nas chung ba lnga ste rig nas bcus bsdus pa'i zab bcud thams cad chos sgo skyes su byon pa'i sgo nas legs par nod de sa skya paṇḍi ta zhes snyan pas grags/ paṇa chen dbus nas 'khor rje nyid kyis nyi shu rtsa bdun bzhes pa'i sa pho 'brug gi lo/ lo ston rdo rje dbang phyug gis bzhengs pa'i nyang smad rgyan gong gi gtsug lag khang du/ kha che paṇa chen gyis mkhan po/ spyi bo lhas pa byang chub 'od kyis las slob/ don mo ri pas gsang ston bgyis te bsnyen par rdzogs/ sa paṇa nyid sku bltams pa'i lo rje btsun rtse mo 'ja' lus su gshegs pas zhal gyi bdud rtsi dngos su ma thob kyang rang lo so lnga pa'i bar du grags pa'i 'chi med bdud rtsi ngom par gsol/

khyad par lam zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi sgo nas phyi nang rten 'brel gyi gnad rang sar 'grig ste sa dang po'i yon tan mchog tu brnyes/ nyid kyi so gsum pa la kha che paṇa chen slar kha cher bzhud/ so lnga pa la rje btsun chen po bde ba can du gshegs/ so brgyad pa tsam gyi tshe rgya bod kyi ngan rtog brag ri 'joms par byed pa'i tshad ma'i bstan bcos rig pa'i gter zhes grags pa de yang brtsams/ lnga bcu rtsa gcig tsam gyi tshe legs bshad kyi sbrang rtsi spel ba'i dga' ston bstan pa'i pad tshal rgyas par byed pa'i sdom gsum rab dbye'i nyin byed kyang shar/ lnga bcu rtsa dgu pa'i tshe 'phags pa wa ta'i dri gtsang khang dang 'dab 'byor ba'i dpal gyi gnas su/ rgya gar lho phyogs kyi 'phrog byed dga' bo la sogs pa'i phas kyi rgol ba ngan pa drug lung rigs kyis tshar gcad de rgyal ba'i bstan pa la bcug gang gi snyan pa'i rnga sgra gangs ri'i ljongs 'dir ma shongs te/ rgya dkar nag hor bal gyi ljongs thams cad kyang gang bar byas/ drug cu rtsa gsum pa'i tshe stobs kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba rgya nag mtha'i rgyal po go dan gyis bsod nams kyi mgron du spyan drangs/ drug cu rtsa lnga pa me pho rta'i lo pho brang chen po li chu rtser gdan phebs/ rgyal pos nyams sad pa'i phyir sgyu ma'i dri gtsang khang khang phran gyis skor ba'i gtsug lag khang gi sgyu 'phrul rwa bar spyan drangs pa'i tshe/ ting nge 'dzin gyi mthus brtan par bzhugs su gsol te/ byang phyogs sprul pa sde'i gtsug lag khang zhes phyogs kun tu snyan par grags/ sgyu ma'i mkhan po la bslus chen po der byung / rgyal po 'khor bcas dga' bdes yid rab tu gsos/ bdun cu pa'i bar du rgya nag po'i yul du bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa spel/ lcags phag smal zla'i bcu bzhi'i tho rang sku'i bkod pa re zhig bsdus/ sku'i skye ba phyi mar mkha' la spyod pa'i rig pa 'dzin pa'i gar gyis rol/

de nas gnyis pa'i tshe shar phyogs mu mu nir rgyal po nyi ma stobs 'phel gyi sras dam par gyur te sa lam phal cher bgrod/ de nas gsum pa'i tshe mngon dga'i zhing du bde bar gshegs pa dri ma med pa'i dpal zhes bya ba'i sangs rgyas longs sku'i cha byad sku mdog gangs ri'i mdog can chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya can rin po che'i rgyan dang rab tu mdzes pa'i gos kyis klubs pa/ dag pa'i 'khor 'bum gyis bskor ba'o/ /de ltar na phyi dar nyid la bstan pa'i nyin byed lan gsum shar te/ lo chen rin bzang gis/ dar mas bstan pa bsnubs rjes kyi chos min thams cad tshar gcad/ de rjes 'gos rngog rnam gnyis kyis glo bur gyi chos log thams cad sun phyung / de nas bzung ste chos rje sa skya pa chen po grags pa'i mtha' can gyi sku tshe'i stod smad lo brgya tsam bstan pa sprin med kyi mkha' ltar gnas pa las/ phyis rang bzo phag mo'i byin rlabs/ yi dam skrong bskyed/ gtum mo bde skyed/ sems bskyed rmi lam ma/ sems bskyed rku thabs/ bsngo ba yod dge dkar po chig thub sogs chos min gyi rnam grangs brgya rtsa zhig gi mun rum tshar gcod pa la/ bstan bcos sdom gsum rab dbye'i nyin byed 'di shar ba yin no/ /des na deng sang gi dus na rgyal ba'i bstan pa la lung rigs kyis cung zad dpyad du yod pa 'di paṇa chen 'di nyid kyi bka' drin yin la/ shes bya rig pa'i gnas lnga'i sgo phye ste/ rig pa'i gnas la blo kha cung zad phyogs pa'i bod kyi gzhon nu blo gsal dag la sa paṇḍi ta zhes pa'i mtshan tsam gyis kyang kha ba can 'di dkar por byas pa ma yin nam/ de yang phyi dar la lo chen rin chen bzang po'i sku ngo la/ rmal lo tsā bas tshad ma la bshad pa cung zad mdzad cing / khyung po grags ses kyang tshad ma bshad de/ tshad ma rnying ma zhes pa'i bstan pa cung zad dar/ der rjes rngog lo chen pos tshad ma rgyan dang /

chos mchog gtso bor ston te tshad ma gsar ma zhes pa'i bstan pa spel/ de nyid kyi dngos brgyud kyi slob bu dag gis rang bzor sgro btags pa'i tshad ma'i bstan pa ha cang dar ches pa'i tshe/ dag ma dag gi rab dbye legs par phye ste sde bdun gyi snying po gsal bar ston pa'i tshad ma rig pa'i gter zhes bya ba'i sgo nas tshad ma'i bstan pa ji ltar ba bzhin shar ba yin zhing / rig gnas gzhan la yang des mtshon te shes par mdzod cig sa paṇḍi ta 'di la slob ma'i mchog rtogs pa'i brgyud 'dzin tshogs grub dbon gsum/ man ngag gi brgyud 'dzin lho dmar rnam gnyis/ bshad pa'i brgyud 'dzin shar nub gung gsum/ sdom phrug bgres pa dpal bzang po bcu gsum/ gzhon pa rgyal mtshan mtha' can bdun/ lo tsā ba chen po bzhi/ sbas pa'i rnal 'byor pa chen po bzhi/ mkhas btsun thugs sras bzhi/ sgrub pa'i brgyud 'dzin rgyal ba yang dgon pa/ sbas pa'i grub chen zangs tsha bsod rgyal lo/ /de dag kyang rim pa ltar tshogs sgom kun dga' dpal/ gtsang sgyer phur lcags pho rta la byon/ chos rje pa lo bcu gsum bsten/ go brgyad pa la gshegs/ sa paṇa las lo nyer brgyad kyis gzhon/ grub thob yon tan dpal stag sde ngam ring du byon/ chos rje pa lo drug bsten/ se mo che ras pa zhes grags/ dbon po 'phags pa rin po che sa paṇa nga bzhi bzhes pa'i shing mo lug la byang ngam ring klung khang du byon no/ /tshogs grub dbon gsum gyi brgyud pa 'dzin pa la/ la nyan zhang gsum zhes grags te/ la ru ba bsod nams bzang po/ rtag rtse la ru gser khang du byon/ bco brgyad pa la 'phags pas rab tu byung / shar pa rdo rje 'od zer la rgyud gsum man ngag dang bcas pa gsan/ phyis spya'i se mo rar grub thob yon tan dpal la lo gsum gsung ngag gsan no/ /nyan chen bsod nams brtan pa la stod byang mdog rje rong dbyig mkhar du chu pho rta la byon/

tshogs sgom pa lo bcu gsum bsten/ lo go drug bzhugs/ tshogs sgom pa las lo bcu gnyis kyis gzhon no/ /zhang dkon mchog dpal 'og nas gsal/ lho pa kun mkhyen rin chen dpal lho pha drug pa yin/ sku shin tu bgres pa nas byang ngos su brda don gsal ba'i tho sgrig zhu ba la byon/ dmar chos rgyal pu rangs lo chung gi dngos slob dmar chos rgyal mtshan gyi dbon brgyud yin/ rje pa lo brgyad bsten/ shar nub gung gsum gyi shar pa sher 'byung gnas dang / shar pa rdo rje 'od zer te sku mched gnyis/ nub pa la 'u yug pa rig pa'i seng ge de'i dbon po nyi thog pa kun smon/ de'i bka' chen khang nyan zhang gsum/ zur khang pa bzhir grags pa'i khang ston 'od zer rgyal mtshan/ gnyan dar ma seng ge zhang mdo sde dpal/ zur khang pa dkar shākya grags/ gung pa la sgyo yon tan dri med de/ thams cad sa paṇa gyi dngos slob yin/ kar shākya grags ni gtso bor grags pa'i yin no/ /sdom phrug bgres pa bcu gsum ni/ tshogs sgom kun dga' dpal bzang po/ grub thob yon tan dpal bzang po/ rin chen skyob pa dpal bzang po/ lho pa kun mkhyen rin chen dpal bzang po/ zhang rgyal ba dpal bzang po/ zhang mdo sde dpal bzang po/ bya ru ba seng ge dpal bzang po/ grub thob snying po rdo rje dpal bzang po/ ldong ston shes rab dpal bzang po/ jo gdan byang chub dpal bzang po/ kha'u pa 'od ldan dpal bzang po/ skyo ston dri med dpal bzang po rnams so/ /jo gdan byang chub dpal ni/ chos rje pa'i slob ma shin tu yin kyang / kha che paṇa chen gyi mkhan bu yin pas/ chos rje pas sdom phrug tu cung zhig mi rigs pa 'dra 'o/ 'on kyang rje kun mkhyen gyi ṭīkka ltar bgrangs pa'o/ /gzhon pa rgyal mtshan gyi mtha' can bdun ni/ shar pa ye shes rgyal mtshan/ khang ston 'od zer rgyal mtshan/ dga' ldan pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ gsol bya ba 'dul ba rgyal mtshan/

'u yug pa dpal gyi rgyal mtshan/ yar lung pa shākya rgyal mtshan/ yar lung pa byang chub rgyal mtshan rnams so/ /de yang yar lung pa byang chub rgyal mtshan ni chos rje pa'i rnam thar tshigs bcad ma rgyas pa rtsom pa po yin la/ rnam thar bsdus pa rtsom pa po'i yar lung pa grags pa rgyal mtshan yang bsnan nas rgyal mtshan gyi mtha' can brgyad ces bya'o/ /lo chen bzhi ni chag lo tsā ba chos rje dpal/ glo bo lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen/ rong pa rga lo rnam rgyal rdo rje/ zhang lo tsā ba grub dpal dang bzhi'o/ /chag lo ni chag dgra bcom gyi dbon po ste me mo sbrul lo byon/ sa paṇa las lo bco lngas gzhon no/ /zhang lo ni kha che paṇa chen gyi slob ma yang yin la/ gtso bor ras chung snyan brgyud kyi brgyud pa la bzhugs pa de'o/ /yar lung pa rgyal tsha lung gi dbang phyug zhang bya ru ba arya de wa/ lung bu ba bsod nams rin chen/ slang ra ba kun dga' rgyal mtshan te sbas pa'i rnal 'byor pa chen po bzhi/ mkhas btsun chen po bzhi ni/ bo dong rin chen brtson 'grus rdo rje/ gtsang nag phug pa 'jam dbyangs shes rab 'od zer/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen bzad pa ring mo/ te ra ba byams pa mgon po ste bzhi'o/ /bo dong rin chen ni lcags pho sprel lo pa ste/ sa paṇa las lo bco brgyad kyis gzhon/ gtsang nag phug pa mkhas pa yongs grags gsum byon pa'i gtsang nag brtson 'grus seng ge ni/ cha pa'i seng chen gcig yin/ gtsang nag phug pa thugs rje seng ge ni/ jo nang kun spangs zhang gi slob ma ste/ bar do 'phrang grol mdzad pa po de yin/ 'jam dbyangs shes rab 'od zer ni/ thog mar sa paṇa la dgag pa mdzad pas/ 'jam dbyangs mi dges pa'i rnam pa bstan/ bshags pa byas te chos rje khu dbon gyi thugs sras su gyur pa'o/ /sum stong sum brgya dang bcu drug 'das pa'i shing pho 'brug la zang tsha bsod nams rgyal mtshan sku 'bum rnam rgyal du byon/

dgung lo nga drug pa sa mo phag rgyal zla'i nyer gnyis la mdog ros kyi sag rir gshegs/ 'phags pa dang 'gro mgon phyag na gnyis/ slob dpon ye shes 'byung gnas dang rin chen 'byung gnas gnyis ste bzhi la zangs tsha'i sras bzhi zer/ phyi ma gnyis sa pho khyi lo pa dgung mnyam yin no/ /sum stong sum brgya dang nyer gcig 'das pa'i nyer gnyis pa sa mo bya la rgod tshang pa mgon po rdo rje bltams/ lo bcu dgu pa la rab tu byung / gtsang pa rgyal ras kyi zhabs zung zla ba gsum bsten/ kong po dza lan dha ra'i bar gnas rnams su sgrub pa dang gzhan don kho na mdzad/ bdun cu bzhes pa rta lo zla ba lnga pa'i tshes gsum la gshegs/ slob ma'i mchog rang las lhag pa gcig rang dang mnyam pa brgyad sogs byon pa las/ rang las lhag pa ni yang dgon pa yin la/ rang dang mnyam pa brgyad ni/ rten 'brel rang dang mnyam pa nai ring pa/ sgrub tshul rang dang mnyam pa pho ri ri khrod gling pa/ mos gus rang dang mnyam pa spyil dkar ba/ snying rje rang dang mnyam pa'i ma bdun pa/ zhen log rang dang mnyam pa gangs shākya bshes gnyen/ dag snang rang dang mnyam pa'i nam mkha' rdo rje/ dka' spyad rang dang mnyam pa'i g.ya' mdo rings kyi shākya rag pa/ brtul shugs rang dang mnyam pa'i grub chen u rgyan pa dang brgyad do/ /des na rgod tshang pa byon pa'i sa bya nas sum brgya dang don drug pa yin la/ 'di sa paṇa las bdun gyis gzhon no/ /sum stong sum brgya dang so lnga 'das pa'i so drug pa chu mo phag la rong pa sga lo byon/ khams pa sga lo'i skye bar bzung bas rga lo zer/ khams pa rga lo ni sa chen dang phar slob tshur slob yin/ dpyal po'i drung du rgya yig sogs la sbyangs/ brgyad cu pa la gshegs so/ /sum stong sum brgya dang so drug 'das pa'i so bdun pa shing pho byi lo/ kha che paṇa chen shākya shrī bha tra 'khor paṇa chung dgu dang bcas te bod du byon/ de'i tshe ko brag pas lo nyi shu rtsa bzhi/

khro los so gsum/ sa los nyi shu rtsa gsum/ rgod tshang pas bcu drug lon/ des jo bo rje bod du byon pa'i shing pho rta nas/ lo brgya dang lnga bcu 'das pa'i nga gcig pa shing pho byi lo/ paṇa chen shākya shrī bod du byon pa yin zhes bya'o/ /'khor paṇa chung dgu ni/ dbu phar la mkhas pa su ga tā shrī/ sngags 'dul la mkhas pa dzā ya dā tra/ sgra dang mngon pa la mkhas pa bi budha tsant+ra/ tshad ma la mkhas pa dā na shrī la/ tsanḍa la mkhas pa sam ga shrī/ mngon pa gong 'og la mkhas pa su ma ti garbhā/ dus 'khor la mkhas pa dzi na sū pa ta/ spyod 'jug la mkhas pa mahā bo dhi rnams so/ /de yang kha che khri bstan gyi bye brag dza sho dha ra zhes par shing mo glang gi lo/ paṇa chen 'di nyid sku bltams/ lo bcu pa la bram ze lakṣi ndhā ra la sgra rig gsan/ lo dgu nas nyer gnyis kyi bar la tshangs spyod dge bsnyen mdzad/ nyer gsum pa la mkhan po su kha shrī bha dra bde ba dpal bzang po las rab tu byung / nyer dgu'i bar du kha cher bzhugs/ sum cu pa la yul ma ga dhar byon/ mkhan po shant+ra ka ra gupta ste/ zhi ba'i 'byung gnas sbas pa dang / da sha bha la dang / gsang ston dha bar ka sogs bco brgyad las bsnyen par rdzogs so/ /drug cu bzhes pa'i tshe khro lo lo so gsum lon pa zhig gis byi lo chu'i zla bar spyan 'dren la byon te/ rgya gar bai ḍūrya'i tshong 'dus su phebs/ shākya'i bstan pa la shākya'i sras bltams/ shākya'i mtshan zhes sogs kyi zhu yig rten dang bcas pa phul/ ba ne shā ra bya bar paṇa chen dang 'jal/ paṇa chen gyi gsung gis/ lo tsā ba 'di chos mang du shes pa/ lha chen bzhengs pa'i stobs yod pa'i/ yar rgan gcig yod bsam pa la na tshod gzhon nur 'dug chos bsgyur ba'i lo tsā ba yang mi phod/ sgrub thabs 'ga' byin la 'o kol dpon slob phyir ldog gsungs/ paṇḍi ta dzā ya shrīs dpon slob rnams lo tsā ba'i gzugs la bsnyes 'dug pas 'bel ba'i gtam smros shig ces skabs dbye/

lo tsā bas paṇa chung dgu la dri ba mi 'dra ba gnyis gnyis byas/ paṇa chen rab tu dges te spyan 'dren gtang ba'i rngo thogs paṇa chung rnams la'ang do li byas te rim pas spyan drangs/ chu mig tu khro phu ba'i bsu ba'i bkod pa dang / dge 'dun drug cu dar gdugs rol mo sogs drug cu drug cu dang bcas pas khro phur spyan drangs/ de'i tshe sa paṇḍi tas yab dpal chen 'od po phag lo sku gshegs nas/ gshegs rdzongs kyi sku skal rkyang dur du 'bul du phebs pa'i bar lam chu mig tu chos rje dang mjal/ tshad ma chos mchog gi bstod pa sogs mdzad pa yin zer/ khro phur byi lo'i dbyar gnas mdzad/ tshugs shing len pa brgyad brgya byung / brgyad stong pa sogs gsungs so/ /lo tsā bas dar zab kyi thun yon re ma chag par phul/ lho brag pa byang chub dpal la bsnyen rdzogs gnang / dbus la 'bri khung pas spyan 'dren pa'i cha rkyen mang po slebs/ lhas mo cher phebs/ rgya gar nas spyan drangs pa'i rten mchod rnams zhal phye mchod pa rgyas par phul/ gtsang po ba bsod nams mdzes kyis mjal/ bdag bsnyen par rdzogs nas ltung ba byung ba ma dran pas/ tshul khrims bsrung ba'i dge ba bsngo ba zhus pas/ dbu zhwa zul gyis phud/ phyag thal mo sbyar nas bsngo rgyu bzang / 'di lta bu rgya gar na yang dkon gsungs te bsngo ba mdzad/ glang lo'i dbyar gnas slas mo cher mdzad/ dgag dbye thon nas chu mig ring mor byon/ rgyan gong gnas su rdo rje dpal la bsnyen rdzogs gnang / gzhu bsnye mo'i nang la byon/ 'tshur phu nas stod lung brgyud de jo bo rnam gnyis la mchod pa phul/ 'tshur phu ba'i skyes mi rnams la khyod kyi dgon pa na/ sangs rgyas thod pa'i rgyud nas bshad pa'i sku gsum snang ba khyed kyis ngo ma shes gsungs/ sku gsum ni bde mchog yab yum go zlog shākya thub pa sprul sku la yum rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ rdo rje dril bu mnyam sbyor gyi sku dang gsum mo/

/de nas srin po rir stag lo dbyar gnas mdzad/ byams chos khrid dang / rigs tshogs rnams gsungs/ me mo yos la sol nag thang po cher phebs/ bstan rtsis mdzad pa na/ smig drug zla ba'i dkar phyogs kyi/ /tshes brgyad nam gung mnyam pa la/ /zla ba ri bo la nub tshe/ /thub dbang yongs su mya ngan 'das/ /de rjes lo ni stong phrag gcig /bdun brgya dang ni lnga bcu dang / /zla ba gnyis dang zla ba phyed/ /de bzhin nyi ma snga rabs 'das/ /zhes sogs bshad/ 'o na rang lugs kyi bstan rtsis dang cher mi mthun no snyam na/ skyon med de paṇa chen gyi bstan rtsis kyi 'das lo'i thog ma ni/ tho btsun grub rje dang / bde byed bdag pos byang chub chen po'i sku bzhengs dus kyi me mo sbrul nas bzung ba yin no zhes bshad zin la/ de lta bu'i me sbrul de ni 'das lo nas stong dang lnga brgya gya dgu 'das pa'i dgu bcu pa yin no zhes kyang bshad zin cing / paṇa chen gyi bstan rtsis 'di ni me mo yos lo'i tshe nag pa zla ba'i tshes lnga la mdzad pa yin pas/ me yos nag pa zla ba'i tshes lnga de ni/ mahā bo dhi byon pa'i me sbrul nas lo stong dang bdun brgya dang lnga bcu rtsa gcig pa me mo yos lo rang gi steng nas zla ba phyed gsum dang zhag lnga song ba de yin par shin tu gsal ba'i phyir ro/ /de na me yos 'di ni 'das lo nas lo sum stong sum brgya dang bzhi bcu pa dang / paṇa chen bod du byon pa'i lo bzhi pa yin no/ /de nas byang ra sgreng du byon pa'i yar lam 'bri khung pas spyan drangs kyang / gdan gcig pa dang bka' gdams pas gegs byas mjal du ma ster ro/ /phyi de sa pho 'brug gi lo gtsang du phebs/ nyang brgyud rgyan gong du sa paṇa la bsnyen rdzogs gnang / gsang ston spyi bo lhas pa byang chub 'od shing pho byi lo pa ste/ de'i tshe re lnga pa yin/ sbrul lo'i dbyar gnas rin chen sgang du mdzad/ rta lo'i dbyar gnas sa skyar mdzad/

lug lo'i dbyar gnas shangs lug gu rdzong du mdzad/ lha btsun gung thang pa la bsnyen rdzogs gnang / sprel lo'i dbyar gnas khro phur mdzad de chu bo sprel lo dbo zla ba'i tshe gsum nas bcu gsum gyi bar du khro phu byams chen gyi rab gnas mdzad/ rim gyis khro phu nas mnga' ris su phebs te bya lo'i dbyar gnas pu hrang du mdzad/ shing pho khyi lo kha cher phebs te nyer dgu tsam zhig tu bstan 'gro'i don mdzad/ dgu cu rtsa dgu pa sgrog zla ba'i tshes lnga la zhi bar gshegs so/ /de la paṇa chen shing pho byi lo bod du phebs nas/ lo bcu gcig bzhugs zer ba 'di la phal cher mthun mod/ 'khrungs lo la mi mthun pa 'ga' zhig 'dug pa'i/ deb sngon las/ paṇa chen me mo lug la bltams/ don brgyad pa shing pho byi lo bod du phebs/ chu mo bya'i bar lo bcu bzhugs/ shing khyi la kha cher thegs/ go gcig pa shing bya la gshegs zer mod/ khro los mdzad pa'i bstod pa las/ gcig gis ma tshang lo brgya'i dus/ /bya lo snron zla'i dkar phyogs kyi/ /spen pa'i nyi ma'i tshes lnga la/ /'gro ba'i nyi ma nub par bstan/ /zhes go dgu pa bya lo zhi bar gshegs par bshad pa dang cung zad 'byor kyang / thub dbang yongs 'das lo ni brgya phrag bcu/ /drug bcas dgu cu rtsa gnyis mthar son tshe/ /shākya'i bstan srog ngur smrig 'dzin pa'i gtso/ /byon gyur drang srong de yi rnam thar bris/ /zhes pa dang / mi 'byor te/ lung des paṇa chen lugs kyi 'das lo nas lo stong dang drug brgya go gnyis tshe sku 'khrungs par bshad la/ thang po cher bstan rtsis me mo yos yan chad la lo stong dang bdun brgya lnga cu 'das par paṇa chen rang gis bshad pa ltar yang khas blangs dgos pa las/ khyed ltar na thang po che'i me mo yos lo ni/ paṇa chen gyi brgyad cu rtsa gcig pa yin pas/ paṇa chen 'khrungs gong yan chad kyi stong drug brgya go gnyis dang / paṇa chen gyi dgung lo gya gcig po bsres pas stong bdun brgya bdun cu don gsum du yang slebs 'dug pa'i phyir ro/

/jo bstan tshogs dge 'dun sgang pa'i mkhan po mkhan chen chos grub seng ges mdzad pa'i paṇa chen gyi rnam par las khro los mdzad pa'i/ thub dbang yongs 'das lo ni brgya phrag bcu/ /drug bcas dgu cu rtsa gnyis mthar gson nas/ /zhes pa 'di yi ge ma dag pa yin pas/ thub dbang yongs 'das lo ni brgya phrag bcu/ /dgu bcas bdun cu rtsa gsum mthar gson nas/ /zhes 'don dgos la/ de ltar na 'das lo las lo stong dgu brgya don gsum 'das pa'i lcags pho sprel lor paṇa chen bltams/ re lnga pa shing pho byi lor bod du phebs/ don lnga pa shing pho khyi lor kha cher phebs/ go dgu pa khyi lor zhi bar gshegs zhes bshad pa yang / thang po cher rtsis pa'i bstan rtsis dang 'gal te/ khyed ltar na thang po che'i me yos ni/ paṇa chen gyi drug cu rtsa brgyad pa yin la/ drug cu rtsa brgyad po de dang / paṇa chen 'khrungs gong gi lo stong dgu brgya don gsum po bsres pas nyis stong zhe gcig tu yang 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /des na kho bo ni skabs 'dir/ dus gsal sor bzhag nas kha che paṇa chen rang nyid kyi bstan rtsis ltar gyi 'das lo'i stong dang drug brgya go gnyis 'das pa'i go gsum pa shing mo glang lor paṇa chen bltams/ drug cu pa shing byi la bod du phebs/ bdun cu pa shing khyi la mnga' ris nas kha cher phebs te/ go dgu pa la dag pa'i zhing du gshegs/ mnga' ris nas kha cher phebs dus jo bstan gtsang so ba/ byang rdor rnam gnyis kyi gnas kyi slob dpon du bzhag shing khyi de nas lo bcu gcig pa paṇa chen gyi dgung lo brgyad cu lon pa'i tshe/ byang rdor rnam gnyis kyi dge 'dun gyi sde so sor btsugs pa ni/ tshogs dge 'dun sgang pa dang / tshogs sam mig pa gnyis/ de gnyis las mched pa la chos lung pa dang / byi rdzing pa zhes zer te/ jo gdan tshogs sde bzhi zhes grags so/ /des na thang po cher rtsis pa'i me mo yos lo ni/

paṇa chen gyi drug bcu rtsa gsum pa yin la/ re gsum po de dang / paṇa chen 'khrungs gong gi lo drug brgya go gnyis po bsres pas/ stong dang bdun brgya nga lnga 'byung ba la 'khrul pa med pa'i phyir ro/ /'on kyang paṇa chen shing glang la bltams nas go dgu la 'das pa'i lo de ni chu mo yos kyi lo yin pas/ khro los bya lo'i sgrog zla'i dkar phyogs kyi/ zhes sogs bshad pa ni yi ge ma dag pa'o zhes khas blangs dgos te/ gzhan du na kha che paṇa chen gyi bstan rtsis dang 'gal ba'i phyir te/ mdor na kha che paṇa chen gyi bod du lo ngo bcu gcig bzhugs/ mdo phyogs kyi bstan pa la phan che/ sa paṇḍi ta dang byang rdor gnyis la bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa gnang / shang pa jo gdan dang / seng ge zil gnon la me tog phreng rgyud sogs rgyas par gnang / 'dul ba stod smad gnyis kyi steng du 'dul ba'i brgyud pa zur pa zhig kyang spel/ slob bu mang du byung yang sa skya paṇḍi ta kho na sras kyi dam par mdzad/ de yang 'dul ba smad 'dul ba'i sdom brgyud ni/ thub dbang / shā ri'i bu/ sras sgra gcan 'dzin/ bram ze sgra gcan 'dzin/ klu sgrub/ legs ldan byed/ dpal sbas/ ye shes snying po/ zhi ba 'tsho/ dba' ratna/ gtsang rab gsal/ bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal/ klu mes tshul khrims sogs yin la/ stod 'dul ba'i sdom brgyud ni/ dharma pā la/ pradzña pā la/ zhang zhung rgyal she/ dpal 'byor shes rab/ zhing mo che pa byang chub seng ge yang rtse ba rdo rje seng ge rtag pa padma g.yung drung / rtsis 'dul thugs rje byang chub/ bde ba can pa shākya byang chub/ kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ byang chub seng ge byang chub bzang po/ blo gros rgyal mtshan/ dpal ldan bla ma/ mdog lho pa mkhan chen kun dga' bzang po/ re mda' ba sogs so/ /mkhan brgyud gsar ma'i sdom brgyud ni/ ston pa/ shā ri'i bu/ sgra gcan 'dzin gnyis/ klu sgrub/ gu na ma ti ste yon tan blo gros/

ratna ma ti ste rin chen dkon mchog blo gros/ shrī dharma pā la te dpal ldan chos skyong / gu na sā ga ra ste yon tan rgya mtsho/ dharma mā la te chos kyi phreng ba/ a ka ra gupta ste zhi 'byung sbas pa/ paṇa chen shākya shrī/ sa paṇa sogs so/ /stod 'dul ba'i dharma pā la yan gyi sdom brgyud gsal bar bris pa mi snang / yang stod 'dul ba'i dharma pā la dang mkhan brgyud gsar ma'i dharma pā la gnyis don gcig na/ klu sgrub nas brgyud tshul 'dra mod/ cung zad thog mi mtshungs pa 'dra'o/ /des na da lta'i shing pho byi lo 'di kha chen paṇa chen bod du byon pa'i shing byi nas lo sum stong sum brgya lnga bcu rtsa gcig lon pa'i lo yin no// ༈ //sum stong sum brgya dang zhe bzhi 'das pa'i zhe lnga pa chu pho sprel lo/ stag sde ba seng ge rgyal mtshan mdog pha ri lung du byon/ bo dong rin chen rtse mo'i zhabs la btugs/ lo gya gsum bzhugs/ sngar tshar gyi bu chen gshongs rdo rje rgyal mtshan dang / gshongs blo gros brtan pa ste sku mched gnyis/ gcen gyi skyes rabs dpag bsam khri shing dang / snyan ngag me long dang / sgra tsaṇḍa pa sogs sngar ma 'gyur ba'i chos mang po bsgyur/ sku mched de gnyis kyi slob ma ni/ mang mkhar khra tshang pa mchog ldan legs pa'i blo gros/ de'i slob ma dpang lo ste lo tsā ba de bzhi sgra snyan ngag sogs la bka' drin mchog tu che/ rgya gar gyi kha che blo brtan ni blo brtan dang po yin la/ gshongs blo brtan dang / dpang blo brtan la blo brtan gnyis pa dang gsum pa zhes grags/ blo brtan bzhi pa ni tshig gter gyi 'grel pa mdzad pa po de yin no/ /dpang los lo bcu gsum pa nas mdog tsha snar/ stag sde ba seng rgyal zhi bar gshegs kyi bar lo bcu dgu'i bar du bsten zer bas/ stag sde ba'i phyi tshar gyi slob ma yin la/ stag sde ba 'di tshogs sgom pa las lo gnyis kyis gzhon no//

༈ //sum stong sum brgya dang zhe lnga 'das pa'i zhe drug pa chu mo bya la yang dgon rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la stod lho'i shrī lung par bltams/ bla ma'i mchog ni rgod tshang pa/ sa paṇa/ ko brag pa/ 'bri khung spyan mnga' rin po che dang bzhi/ slob ma'i mchog ni lo ras chos skyong dpal dang / dar ma rgyal mtshan gnyis/ spyan mnga' rigs ldan dpal dang / zur phug pa rin chen dpal gnyis te bzhi zur phug pa'i thugs sras ni/ 'bar ra rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po ste/ yang dgon pa'i sku skyes su byed/ yang dgon pa zhe drug pa'i nam mthong gi tshes bcu dgu la gshegs so// ༈ //sum stong sum brgya dang nga bdun 'das pa'i nga brgyad pa shing mo bya la/ nai rings pa sras bde legs rgyal mtshan la stod lho bya rog tshang du bltams/ nyer gnyis pa rta lo rgod tshang pa'i drung du byon/ de nas bcu gsum pa sa mo lug nai rings btab/ de nas nyi shu rtsa gnyis 'gro don mdzad de/ nga bdun sbrul lo dbyug pa zla ba'i nyer dgu'i srod la gshegs so/ /thugs sras ni dbon po kun dga' rdo rje dang / mkhan po shes rab grags so/ /nai rings pa 'di nyan chen pa las lo gsum gyis gzhon no/ /sum stong sum brgya dang re gnyis 'das pa'i re gsum pa lcags pho stag la grub thob u rgyan rin chen dpal ba lho nas lhum du byon/ bcu drug pa la rgod tshang pa las dge bsnyen mdzad/ bo dong rin rtse/ bcom ldan ral gri/ go lung pa mdo dpal sogs la mdo phyogs gsan/ gong lung pa'i gcung po yang yin/ bo dong rin rtse las bsnyen par rdzogs/ rgod tshang pa las gdams pa gsan pas sgro 'dogs chod/ shrī rdo rje rnal 'byor mas pu ti gcig gnang ba mid pas bka' mdo rgyud la thogs pa med/ yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i u rgyan sogs dgu ru byon/ dgung lo go gnyis pa lcags bya lo zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes nyi shu la gshegs so/ /slob ma'i mchog karma rang byung rdo rje/

grub thob tsha chung ba/ rtogs ldan zla seng dang bzhi'o/ /rtogs ldan tsha chung bas sbu ṭa nas lha sar nyin re la phebs/ rgya khab brgya dus re la gsol nas ba spu'i bu khar dus gcig la 'don/ rtogs ldan zla seng ge dus 'da' khar bu ston rin po ches gsol ba btab ste lo gsum bzhugs zer/ des na da lta'i shing byi 'di yang dgon pa'i chu bya nas gsum brgya dang nga gnyis pa/ nai rings pas shing bya nas sum brgya dang bzhi bcu pa/ u rgyan pas lcags stag nas sum brgya dang so lnga pa legs so// ༈ //sum stong sum brgya dang re bdun 'das pa'i re brgyad pa shing mo lug lo 'phags pa rin po che byon/ lo drug lon pa'i tshe chos rje sa paṇa gyi phyag phyir skyid grong du byon zer/ lo bcu pa la gcung phyag na bcas chos kyi rje rgya la phebs pa'i zhabs phyir thegs/ dbus su chos rje sa paṇa gyi mkhan po/ zul phu ba'i na bza' 'phred gsol gyi slob dpon bgyis te rab tu byung / bcu gnyis pa la rgyal po'i pho brang chen por phyag phebs/ bcu bdun yan la lung rtogs kyi yon tan phul du phyin/ de'i tshe chos rje sa paṇa gyis bstan pa'i khur chen po nyid kyi phyag tu gtad de dag pa'i zhing du gshegs/ bco brgyad pa la chos kyi rje'i dgongs rdzogs legs par sgrub/ bcu dgu lon pa chu mo glang lo hor rgyal po se chen go gdan gyi pho brang twa tur spyan drangs/ lugs gnyis kyi mdzad pas rgyal po'i thugs rab tu 'phrog ste/ rgyal pos zhus pa'i ngor/ rgyal pos gtsos pa'i bskal ldan gyi gdul bya lnga phrag lnga la dges pa rdo rje'i smin byed kyi dbang bskur/ tī shrī'i mtshan gsol dbang yon du bod khri skor bcu gsum phul/ khri skor bcu gsum ni lho byang gnyis/ chu zhal gnyis/ lha shangs gnyis te gtsang la drug g.ya' phag gnyis/ rgyal tsha gnyis/ 'bri stag gnyis te dbus la drug ya 'brog khri bskor dang bcu gsum yin la/

'di nas bzung ste bod khams thams cad dpal ldan sa skya pas lugs gnyis kyis bskyangs so/ /de nas lo nyer gcig pa rgya hor yul gyi mtshams su/ mkhan po snye thang pa grags pa seng ge las slob jo gdan bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ gsang ste yar lung pa byang chub rgyal mtshan sogs las bsnyen par rdzogs so/ /slar so gcig pa shing mo glang la dpal ldan sa skyar phebs/ de'i tshe bod dbus gtsang gi dge ba'i bshes gnyen che dgu thams cad kyis mdo khams su bsu ba ser phreng la phebs/ gshongs rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyis bstod pa spel legs kyi snyan ngag phul/ 'bel ba'i gtam gyi bka' mchid mchog tu stsal/ de dag kun gyi nang nas la stod pa gangs shākya bshes gnyen dang / dbus kyi 'bre'u rin chen gnyis la mchog tu dges par thob ces kyang zer ro/ /dbus dang khams su 'gro kun chos dang zang zing 'byor pas bde ba la bkod/ slar so gsum pa la gong nas spyan 'dren gyi gser yig pa slebs pas shar la phebs/ de'i tshe gsol gzim mchod gsum/ mjal yig mdzod gsum/ thab 'dren gdan gsum/ rta skya gnyis/ mdzo khyi gnyis te las mtshan bcu gsum gyi bkod pa gnang / bcom ral gyis/ sangs rgyas bstan pa bka' phyag sprin gyis bsgribs/ /zhes sogs kyi zhu mchid phul/ bstan la 'phel bsgribs 'byung ba rgyal bas gsungs/ /zhes sogs kyi bka' mchid gnang / so bzhi pa sa mo 'brug la dpon chen shākya bzang pos khri bskor bcu gsum bskul te/ lha khang chen po'i gzhi bting / rgyal po'i pho brang du phebs/ dbang yon du rgya'i yur ma chod/ bod chol kha gsum phul/ chol kha gsum ni/ dbus gtsang chos kyi chol kha/ mdo stod gon gyo mi'i chol kha/ mdo smad gling kha rta'i chol kha zhes zer/ 'ga' zhig mang yul mtsho/ gu ge g.ya'/ pu rang gangs kyis bskor bas stod mnga' ris bskor gsum chol kha gcig gtsang g.yas ru dang g.yon ru gnyis/

dbus la sbo ru dang g.yo ru gnyis te bar dbus gtsang ru bzhi chos khal gcig tsha ba sgang / spo 'bor sgang / smra khams sgang ste mdo khams sgang gsum chol kha gcig yin zer ro/ /slar zhe gcig pa la dpal ldan sa skyar phyag phebs/ zhe gsum pa me mo glang la rgyal po jin gyim gyis sbyin bdag mdzad/ gtsang chu mig rings mor dge 'dun khri phrag bdun la gser ja gos dar sogs kyi mchod nas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor te/ zhe drug pa 'brug lo zla ba bcu pa'i nyer gnyis la bde bar gshegs so/ /'di nyid la slob ma'i mchog man ngag gi bka' bab zhang dkon mchog dpal dang dge slong kun blo gnyis/ rgyud kyi bka' bab dga' ldan pa bkra shis dpal dang / dga' ldan pa kun bsod gnyis/ mgon po'i bka' bab dam pa kun dga' grags/ bsnyes pa'i mchod g.yog ti shri grags 'od/ blo chen sangs rgyas sras/ ri phug pa dar ma rgyal mtshan/ pro lung pa kun smon dang bzhi'o/ /nus pa'i bdag nyid gcung phyag na rdo rje dang rgyal bu jin gyim gnyis so/ /gzhan yang che ba'i bdag nyid shar pa dus 'khor ba ye shes rin chen/ shar pa kun dga' seng ge shar pa 'jam dbyangs bzhi thog pa rin chen rgyal mtshan/ khang gsar ba ti shri sangs rgyas dpal/ snyan tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ cha ban dbang phyug rgyal mtshan dang drug go /de dag las 'gro mgon phyag na sa mo phag la mngog gad sler byon/ lo drug pa la gong la byon/ brtul shugs kyi spyod pa mthar phyin/ nyer lnga pa la bod du phebs/ nyer dgu pa yos lo zla ba bdun pa'i tshes gnyis la dgu rum du gshegs so/ /'di 'phags pa las lo gnyis kyis gzhon no// ༈ //sum stong sum brgya dang don gnyis 'das pa'i don gsum pa lcags pho khyi lo zhang dkon mchog dpal ra sa tshal gung du byon/ shar pa sher 'byung las rab tu byung / brag ram du bo dong rin chen brtson 'grus rdo rje las phar tshad sogs sbyangs/

tshogs sgom pa dang ra gnyis pa chen po sogs kyang bsten/ dra ba dge slong dang kun blo gnyis 'phags pa rin po che bsu ba la byon/ rang lo so lnga pa shing khyi'i lo 'phags pa dang mdo khams rtsod mdor mjal/ lo re brgyad bzhugs// ༈ //sum stong sum brgya dang don bdun 'das pa'i don brgyad pa shing mo sbrul la tī shri grags 'od stag sde ra lung du byon/ ti shri lo bcu gnyis mdzad/ 'phags pa las lo lngas gzhon lo nga brgyad bzhugs/ des na da lta'i shing byi 'di 'phags pa rin po che byon nas gsum brgya nyer sum 'das pa'i nyer bzhi pa lags so/ /mdor na 'gro ba'i mgon po 'phags pa rin po ches bcu dgu bzhes pa chu mo glang la hor se chen rgyal po'i ti shri thob pa nas theg chen chos rje kun dga' bkra shis rang lo re lnga pa chu mo sbrul la rgya nag ta ming rgyal chen gyi ti shri thob pa'i bar lo grangs brgya dang drug cu re gcig gi bar du dpal ldan sa skya pa'i gdung brgyud rim pas rgya hor gyi rgyal po'i ti shri thob pa rim can du byung ba kho na yin la/ de yang thog mar dpal ldan sa skya paṇḍi tas rgyal po go dan gyi spyi bor dbang gi cod pan bcings pa'i bka' drin yin mod/ ti shri'i mtshan ma gsol te/ de'i tshe rgyal po go dan rgyal srid kyi khur bor te rang gi dbon po se chen rgyal po rgyal sar ston zin pa nyid kyis so/ /de ltar na chos rje khu dbon gnyis kyi bka' drin las/ bod khams su thams cad dmag khral las gsum las bton te/ lo grangs brgya lhag tsam zhig gi bar du rgyal srid chos bzhin du bde bar bskyangs pa ni/ gang la gang 'dul gyi dbang gis bskal ldan gyi gdul bya la bde ba'i ngal gso chen po thob pa yin no/ /deb sngon las/ dpal ldan sa skya pas lo grangs bdun cu rtsa lnga'i bar du khri bskor bcu gsum bdag mdzad nas sa mo glang nas ta'i si tu byang chub rgyal mtshan gyis khri bskor bcu gsum bdag mdzad pa yin no zhes bshad la/

de la nges pa'i gtan tshigs yod na/ sa mo glang de 'phags pa rin po ches ti shri mdzad pas chu mo glang nas go drug 'das pa'i go bdun pa/ theg chen chos rje bltams pa'i lo de yin par gdon mi za mod/ ji ltar bden kho bos da dung dpyad par bya'o// ༈ //sum stong brgya dang go bzhi 'das pa'i go lnga pa chu pho khyi lo bla ma bdag nyid chen po bzang po dpal mang mkhar khab smad du bltams/ yab slob dpon ye 'byung nyer lnga pa'i sras yin/ bcu drug pa la 'phags pa dang mjal/ mi res pus mo la 'bab/ yon tan slob gsungs/ bcu dgu pa la 'phags pa zhi bar gshegs/ nyer gcig pa la gong la byon/ snyan sgra'i stabs kyis so lnga pa'i bar du sman rtse'i yul du 'byon dgos par shar/ ti shri grags 'od khu dbon gyis legs pa'i mtshams sbyar/ so drug pa la 'phags pa ti shri dbon po yin nges su 'dug pas gdung brgyud spel dgos kyi rgyal po'i lung bud/ so bdun pa sa pho khyi la sa skyar phebs/ chos dang 'jig rten gyi 'byor pas gdan sa bskyangs/ re gsum pa shing pho byi lo zhi bar gshegs so/ /'di nyid la sras kun dril bco lnga tsam zhig byon par snang yang / yongs grags sras dgu ni ti shri kun blo yab so brgyad pa sa mo phag la byon/ bcu gcig pa la ti shri thob/ nyer bzhi pa khyi lo bod du bsnyen rdzogs la byon/ nyer drug pa la yab gshegs/ sku mched rnams la bla brang so sor bgos/ nyer dgu pa la gong du gshegs zer/ mkhas btsun pa sku mched la bzhi thog bla brang pa zhes zer te/ mkhas btsun nam mkha' legs pa yab zhe bzhi sa sbrul lo bltams/ so dgu pa la gshegs/ gcung gu shri nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ yab gshegs pa'i byi lo'am yang na chu pho khyi lo pa chos rje bla ma dang dgung mnyam yin zer/ nyer gsum pa la gshegs so/ /ti shri kun dga' legs 'byung sku mched la lha khang bla brang pa zer te/ gcen ti shri kun dga' legs 'byung yab zhe bdun pa sa pho sprel lo byon/

de'i gcung ti shri kun dga' rgyal mtshan yab zhe dgu pa lcags pho khyi lo byon/ sa'i le dbang kun dga' legs pa lcam sring la dus mchod bla brang pa zer/ 'di ni ti shri kun dga' legs dang dgung mnyam yin no/ /rta dben kun dga' nyi ma sku mched gsum la rin chen sgang bla brang pa zer/ rta dben kun nyi'i gcung 'jam dbyangs don yod rgyal mtshan ti shri kun rgyal dang dgung mnyam yin/ so bzhi pa zla ba lnga pa'i tshes bcu gcig la gshegs so/ /gcung chos rje bla ma yab nga gcig pa chu pho byi lo byon/ re bzhi pa nyer lnga la gshegs so/ /des na da lta'i shing byi 'di bdag nyid chen po byon pa'i khyi lo nas gsum brgya dang sum du slebs pa lags so/ /mnyam med grags rgyal 'di bas lo gcig gis gzhon/ lo gya lnga bzhugs zer// ༈ //kha che paṇa chen bod du byon pa'i shing pho byi lo karma paka shi byon/ sa paṇa las lo nyer brgyad kyis gzhon/ dus gsum mkhyen pa'i slob ma spom brag pa'i zhabs la gtugs/ hor rgyal pos kyang spyan drangs/ mer bsregs/ chur bskyur mtshon gyis btab kyang gnod pa ma byung bas zhabs tog byas zer/ brgyad cu pa lug lo zla ba gsum pa'i tshes gsum la gshegs so/ /'di ni sa ra ha'i sprul pa yin la/ 'di'i sku skyes brgyud spel du byon pa ni/ karma rang byung rdo rje/ rol pa'i rdo rje/ de bzhin gshegs pa/ mthong ba don ldan/ chos grags rgya mtsho/ mi bskyod rdo rje ste/ karma paka shi nas mi bskyod rdo rje'i bar sngar bdun byon zin pa yin la/ dus gsum mkhyen pa ni bskal bzang gi sangs rgyas drug pa seng ge'i rnam 'phrul yin par bshad la/ karma paka shi ni sa ra ha'i rnam 'phrul du bshad kyi/ dus gsum mkhyen pa'i sku skye yin zhes kyang ma bshad pas/ karma zhwa nag pa zhes grags pa'i thog ma ni karma paka shi nas ngos 'dzin dgos par sems la/ 'on kyang / karma pa zhes pa'i mtshan 'dogs ni/

dus gsum mkhyen pas smad du sgam po gnas nang / bar du karma lha sding / stod du tshur phu'i dgon pa btab pa nas karma pa zhes mtshan 'dogs par gsal bas/ dus gsum mkhyen pa la karma pa zhes pa'i sgra bshad du yod pa tsam zhig yin no snyam du kho bo sems so/ /de lta bu'i karma paka shi'i slob ma ni rje u rgyan pa/ karma zhwa dmar can/ zhwa ser can/ zhwa khra can la sogs pa'o/ /sprul sku zhwa dmar ba tshul khrims dpal ni me pho byi lo bltams/ tillo pa'i slob ma khol po dga' zhes pa'i sku skyes yin zer ro// ༈ //sa bcad bzhi pa sum stong bzhi brgya pa'i skabs su byon pa ni/ bdag nyid chen po dharma pā la/ dpang lo/ nam bza' brag phug pa/ bu dol la sogs pa'i mkhas pa rnams te/ de yang sum stong bzhi brgya 'das nas nyag ma gcig gi steng du slebs pas sa pho 'brug gi lo 'gro mgon phyag na'i sras dharma pā la bltams/ bcu gsum pa la sa skya'i gdan sa mdzad/ de'i lo bla ma 'phags pa zhi bar gshegs/ nang rten lha chen dpal 'bar dang / 'phags pa'i sku 'dra 'bul thog bcu gsum zhes grags pa rnams bzhengs/ bcu bzhi pa la gong la byon ti shri mdzad/ nyi shu pa la mdo khams tri maṇḍal zhes par tshes bco brgyad la gshegs so/ /des na shing byi 'di dharma pā la'i sa 'brug nas nyis brgya go bdun pa yin/ sa pho 'brug de ni 'phags pas lha khang bzhengs pa'i lo yin te/ dpal ldan sa skya btab nas lo brgya dang go drug pa sa pho 'brug la lha khang chen po'i 'gram bting zhes 'byung ba yin no// ༈ //sum stong bzhi brgya dang nyag ma brgyad 'das pa'i dgu pa me pho byi lo dpang lo tsā ba blo gros brtan pa la stod lho rgyal du byon/ khong gi lo lnga lon pa'i tshe 'phags pa rin po che dag pa'i zhing du gshegs/ yum snga mor gshegs nas lug gi 'o mas gsos pas lu gu zhes par grags/ kho bo ba'i 'o mas gsos na legs pa la lug gi 'o mas gsos pas blo gros kyi phyed 'grib zhes gsungs/

lo bdun pa la mkhan chen ser khang pa dang me ston 'dul 'dzin las rab tu byung / bcu gcig pa la mdo rtsa rdzogs par bzung / bcu gsum pa la mdog tsha snar stag sde seng rgyal lo bcu dgu'i bar du bsten/ bcu dgu pa la stag sde ba gshegs nas mang mkhar khra tshang du lo tsā ba mchog ldan la dus 'khor sogs gsan/ gzhan yang stag sde ri phug gi mkhan po shes rab dpal ba dang / sa skya'i 'jam dbyangs bzhi thog pa dang 'jam skya dang / rong pa shes rab seng ge sogs kyi zhabs pad bsten/ rong pa sher seng 'di ni rong pa sga lo'i sras te/ lcags mo lug lo pa yin/ ti shri grags 'od las lo drug gis gzhon/ dpang lo las nyer lngas bgres/ slob ma yang dpang lo/ dpal ldan seng ge skyi ston grags rgyal sogs mang du byung / lo re lnga bzhugs zer ba de'i nyi shu pa la sngar gyi mkhan slob las bsnyen rdzogs/ nyer gcig pa la bal por byon/ sgra snyan ngag la sbyangs/ spyir bal por lan bdun/ so gnyis pa la gung thang gnas po cher chos gzhi btsugs/ gung thang bde blo sogs slob bu mang du byon/ dpang lo 'di khong rang bzhugs dus kyi mkhas pa bu dol/ rgyal sras pa/ ma ti paṇa chen/ kun spangs chos grags dpal/ 'jam dbyangs don yod rgyal mtshan sku mched/ nai rings pa 'jam dbyangs rgyal mtshan sogs mkhas pa thams cad kyis tshur zhabs la btud/ mkhas pa'i grags pa shin tu che/ bo dong e'i gdan sa rgyal sras rin po che'i zhu phul bas/ gu ru thogs med thos pa'i gtam la snyan/ /nyid kyi zhal nas legs pa ma gtogs pa/ /nyes par bshad pa ga la srid/ /kho bo'i mkhan chen stag sde ba/ /seng rgyan gyis kyang ma thob pa'i/ /gdan sa yin pas de ring rang la 'gro/ /'gyur na mi 'dod de lta rang la 'gro/ /zhes gsungs nas drug cu rtsa gcig lon pa'i tshe/ bo dong e paṇa chen 'bum phrag gsum pa'i gdan seng ge'i khri la'ang 'khod/ brgyud 'dzin gyi sras rang nyid kyi dbon po lo tsā ba byang chub rtse mo zhes grags pa de yin la/
