dgung lo drug cu rtsa bdun pa chu pho rta lo nag pa zla ba'i tshes bcu gsum la bo dong er dag pa'i zhing du gshegs so// ༈ //sum stong bzhi brgya dang nyag ma dgu 'das pa'i bcu pa me mo glang la brag phug pa bsod nams dpal bltams/ dpang lo las lo gcig gis gzhon/ lo don bdun bzhugs/ slob bu mang du byung yang gtso bor chos rje bla ma brag phug pa dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ brag phug pa blo gros brtan pa/ bka' bcu pa gzhon nu seng ge dang bzhi'o/ /brag phug pa dkon rgyal gyi slob ma ni/ sa skya bu ston dbang phyug rgyal po/ g.yag sde ba nam mkha' bsod nams/ mdo khams rtso mdo dpal 'bar gyi thim chu ba blo gros dkar po ste blo bzang dkar por grags pa dang gsum/ blo bzang dkar po'i slob ma ni/ gon jo ye shes dpal yin la/ gon jo'i slob ma ni khams kyi chab la kha ba blo bzang dkar mo dang / mkhan chen g.yag pa sogs yin zhing blo bzang dkar mo la lam 'bras pa blo bzang grags pa dang / paṇa chen bo dong pa sogs kyis gsan no/ /ri khrod pa blo brtan ni me mo 'brug lo pa ste chos rje bla ma las lo bzhis gzhon no// ༈ //sum stong bzhi brgya bcu bzhi pa lcags mo sbrul lo lam 'bras pa ye shes dpal mdo khams su byon/ lo bcu bzhi pa la nyan chen po'i bu chen blo gros dkar po la 'khrid dang gdams pa gsan/ zha lur bu ston la theg chen sems bskyed gsan/ sa skyar gzhung lugs pa mkhan chen g.yag pa la rnam rigs gsan/ kun spang chos grags dpal la sbyor drug gsan/ nam bza' pa lo bcu gnyis bsten te gsung ngag sogs gsan/ bla ma gu ru dbang phyug brtson 'grus la nai gu sogs gsan/ mkhan chen bla chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyi sras gung pa bkra shis bzang po la dmar po skor gsum sogs gsan/ lo lnga bcu nas gya lnga'i bar du gzhan don kho na mdzad/ slob ma'i mchog blo bzang dkar mo/ mkhan chen g.yag pa sogs te gya lnga pa sbrul lo zla ba bcu gcig pa'i nyer gnyis la 'jam sa lha sdings su gshegs so//

༈ //sum stong bzhi brgya dang bco lnga 'das pa'i bcu drug pa shing pho sprel lo karma pa rang byung rdo rje mnga' ris su byon/ lo gsum pa la ming yongs su grags pa'i karma pa yin/ zhwa nag khyer shog gsungs/ rang byung rdo rje zhes pa karma paka shi'i gsang mtshan yin zer/ mdo sde ma gzigs pa skyes rab brtsams/ ci yin zhus pas/ karma paka shi yis dus khams kyi rwa ba sgang du tshar gcig bltas gsungs/ 'di'i hor tho han thim mur gyi ti shri mdzad zer bas/ spyir tho han thi mur gyi lo nyer lnga rgyal srid mdzad pa'i stod la/ ti shri kun rgyal gyi ti shri mdzad/ bar skabs su bla chen bsod blos mdzad/ 'jug tu ti shri med pa lo brgyad byung zer ba'i tho han gyi sku tshe'i stod ti shri kun rgyal dang thog mtshungs tsam du ti shri mdzad par mngon te/ rang byung rdo rje ti shri kun rgyal las lo nyer drug gis bgres pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gang na'ang dgung lo nga drug pa bra gre'i tshes bcu bzhi la rgya nag pho brang du gshegs so// ༈ //sum stong bzhi brgya dang nyer gsum 'das pa'i nyer bzhi pa lcags mo yos la gnyag phu ba bsod nams dbang phyug mus gling skyar byon/ bcu gcig pa la mkhan po shākya mgon dang / slob dpon 'od zer rtse mo las rab tu byung / mdog lhod du mkhan chen kun rgyal las 'dul ba/ mus chen sangs rgyas dpal dang slob dpon shes rab ral gri sogs las mdo phyogs gsan/ bcu dgu pa la mkhan chen chu bzang pa dang / slob dpon 'od zer rtse mo las bsnyen par rdzogs/ bshol gyis kha bskang ba sogs nas nyi shur slebs zin pa las ma 'das/ nyan chen pa la lam 'bras sogs gsan/ na sa gdung ring du bsam gtan la bzhugs pa'i tshe/ sbyin bdag rnams kyis gnyag phu btab/ sbyin bdag dang gzhi bdag mched gsum dang bcas pas gnyag phu phul/ bshad sgrub kyi phrin las mchog tu rgyas/ mthar phag lo zla ba bcu pa'i tshes nyi shu la gshegs so/

/'di karma rang byung rdo rje las lo lngas gzhon zhing / bu ston las gcig gis bgres so// ༈ //sum stong bzhi brgya dang nyer gnyis 'das pa'i nyer gsum pa lcags pho stag la zha lu bu ston rin chen grub/ shab smad sgom gnas su byon/ dpang lo las lo bcu bzhis gzhon/ kun mkhyen dol bu las gnyis kyis bgres/ rgyal sras thogs med las lngas bgres so/ /lo bdun pa la khro phu rin chen bsod nams seng ge'i drung du sems bskyed dang / brgyad pa la smin byed dbang zab mo nod/ /khro phu sems dpa' chen po de ni kha rag sgom chung pa'i bar srid gzhan don skye ba 'tshol ba na/ khro los dag pa'i spyan ras kyis gzigs te rigs kyi sras su bskrun pa yin zer/ bco brgyad lon pa'i tshe mkhan po rin chen seng ge dpal dang / slob dpon tshad ma'i skyes bu las rab tu byung / mkhas mchog tshad pa'i skyes bu/ rigs pa'i thigs pa/ bsod nams mgon zhes mtshan gsum dang ldan pa de'i drung du phar tshad sogs la sbyangs/ nyer gcig pa la yab dang lhan gcig tu dbus gtsang gnyis su grwa skor mdzad/ dbus nas mkhas pa shākya gzhon nu dang kha rag byang gzhon/ gtsang nas mkhas pa dpal ldan seng ge dang / 'jam dbyangs sogs lung rigs kyi 'dul bas pha ston bu ston du grags/ nyer gsum pa la mkhan chen bka' bzhi pa grags pa gzhon nu dang / slob dpon bsod nams grags pa las bsnyen par rdzogs/ 'chad rtsod brtsom gsum gyi bstan pa spel/ thar pa lo tsā ba la sgra snyan ngag bla ma 'phags 'od la gsang 'dus/ rong pa sher bzang gi dbon po rdo rje rgyal mtshan la dus 'khor sogs gsan/ sum cu pa la phar phyin gyi lung snying mdzad/ so gcig pa la zhwa lu ba'i 'dzin skyongs gnang / zhwa lu ri phug btab/ ri phug tu tshogs pa brgya drug cu dang / zhwa lur sum stong brgyad brgya re 'dus/ re bdun pa la sgra tshad pa rin chen rnam rgyal la zhwa lu'i gdan sa gtad/

ri phug tu gdan phab dka' 'bum po ti so gsum bzhugs/ don lnga pa shing pho 'brug zla ba drug pa'i nyer gcig la gshegs so/ /'di la slob bu shin tu mang yang gtso bo sgra tshad pa rin chen rnam rgyal/ byang pa dkon mchog grags/ gong gsum bde chen pa chos kyi mgon po/ yo ga ba rin bzang / yo ga ba tshe dbang / khung po lhas pa sogs so/ /chos rje bla ma/ rgyal sras pa/ bu ston sogs ni phar slob tshur slob yin/ de na da lta'i shing byi 'di/ dpang lo'i me pho byi ba nas nyis brgya dang gya brgyad pa/ na bza' brag phug pa'i me glang nas nyis brgya gya bdun pa/ rang byung rdo rje'i shing sprel nas nyis brgya gya gcig pa/ bu ston gyi lcags pho stag nas nyis brgya dang don lngar slebs pa lags so// ༈ //sum stong bzhi brgya dang nyer bzhi 'das pa'i nyer lnga pa chu pho 'brug la kun mkhyen dol bu shes rab rgyal mtshan mnga' ris dol bu'i ban tshang du byon/ bcu gsum pa la skyi ston mkhan po tshul khrims snying po las rab tu byung / der kyi ston 'jam dbyangs grags rgyal byon pa la rdo rje phreng ba bslab/ bco brgyad pa la kyi ston grags rgyal glo bor phebs pa la tshad bsdus sbyangs/ de nas skyi ston sa skyar phebs te/ slar dpal ldan sa skyar skyi ston shākya 'bum dang / skyi ston grags pa rgyal mtshan te khu dbon de gnyis kyi drung du mdo phyogs sbyangs/ nyer gsum pa la bka' bzhi'i steng du spyod 'jug bsnan te pu sti lnga la grwa skor mdzad/ nyer lnga pa la chos lung mkhan po bsod nams grags pa las bsnyen par rdzogs/ so gcig pa jo nang du yon tan rgya mtsho'i zhabs pad bsten/ so lnga pa la de'i gdan seng ge'i khri la zhabs pad bsten/ so dgu pa la mchod rten chen po bzhengs te lo phyed dang bzhi la grub/ nyams rtogs kyi mdzod rdol/ lo bcu gsum du jo nang gi khri la 'khod de chos gsungs pas/

spyir bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa dang / khyad par gzhan stong pa zhes phyogs kun tu snyan pa'i ba dan g.yos/ nyid kyi zhe bdun pa sa pho stag lo lo tsā ba blo gros dpal gdan sar bskos/ rta lo lo tsā ba gshegs te nyid kyi re gsum pa shing pho rta lo phyogs rgyal ba gdan sar bskos/ bdun cu pa la nub chos lung du chos rje bla ma dang mjal/ bka' bsdu bzhi pa sogs mdzad/ slar bdun cu pa lcags mo glang zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes drug la zhi bar gshegs so/ /des na rje 'di karma rang byung rdo rje dang mjal te/ rang stong pa'i grub mtha' bzung bas karma pas phyis gzhan stong par 'gyur ba lung bstan zer/ spyir gzhan stong pa'i lugs thog mar karma rang byung rdo rjes bzung bar sems/ jo nang du kun mkhyen chen po man chad gzhan stong par song ba yin no/ /'on kyang jo nang thog mar 'debs pa po ni jo nang kun spangs zhang thugs rje brtson 'grus zhes grags pa de nyid yin te/ chu mo yos kyi lo mdog stod kha sbyar spang khang du byon/ 'phags pa rin po che las lo brgyad kyis gzhon/ shar pa 'jam dbyangs bzhi thog pa rin chen rgyal mtshan la lam 'bras gsan/ chos sku 'od zer las sbyor drug gsan/ rkyang dur du 'chad nyan sogs kyang mdzad/ phyis 'chad nyan bskyungs te sgom pa la bzhugs pas kun spangs par grags/ slar jo nang dgon pa btab/ bshad sgrub spel mar gnang / kun bu bzhir byon te byang sems rgyal ye shes/ la stod pa dbang rgyal/ mun le brag kha ba grags pa seng ge ston pa kun rgyal rnams so/ /la stod pa dbang rgyal dang jo nang kun spangs ni lam 'bras bsres brgyud kyi skabs su mtshan smos pa de yang yin no/ /brag kha ba grags pa seng ge ni la stod byang gi rgyal te thang kar byon/ khro phu sems dpa' chen po dang bu ston seng ge 'od las bsnyen par rdzogs/ sa skyar bya ru seng ge dpal las rnam 'grel dang jo nang du kun spangs pa dang byang sems rgyal ba ye shes la sbyor drug sogs gsan/

lo gya dgu thub bzhugs/ slob ma yang chos rje bla ma dang / bka' bcu pa gzhon seng sogs byon zer/ byams sems rgyal ye'i slob ma ni/ mkhas btsun yon tan rgya mtsho ste mdog gi spen sar byon/ chung ngu nas sa skyar 'jam dbyangs pa la sogs pa bsten/ phyis jo nang du sbyor drug gsan nas gdan sa bskyangs/ de'i slob ma ni kun mkhyen chen po'o/ /zhes bshad zin la/ kun mkhyen dol bu bas lo bdun cu bzhugs/ slob ma'i mchog kun spangs chos grags dpal/ lo tsā ba blo gros dpal phyogs las rnam rgyal/ sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen te sras kyi gtso bo bzhi'o/ /kun spangs chos grags dpal ni/ g.yas ru byang gi dpon chen yon btsun chen po grags pa dar gyi sku tsha/ dpon kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyi sras te/ dpangs lo/ dpal ldan seng ge bu dol la sogs pa'i mkhas grub mang du bsten/ bzang ldan dga' rong chud dga' chos sde'i chos grwa btab/ bstan pa'i rgyun la phan pa cher mdzad do/ /sa bzang ma ti ni mdog spangs bor du byon/ bzang ldan gyi mkhan po thog ma yang mdzad/ mkhas shing 'phrin las rgya che bar byung ngo / /phyogs las rnam rgyal ni mnga' ris dol por chu pho stag la byon/ kun mkhyen dol po las lo bcu bzhis gzhon/ gzhon pa'i dus dbus chos 'khor gling du gsan sbyongs mdzad/ dbus gtsang du grwa skor mdzad pa'i zhar la jo nang du kun mkhyen chen po'i zhabs zung bsten/ byang bdag chen ta dben nam mkha' bstan pas kun mkhyen dang dpon slob gnyis ngam rings su spyan drangs/ chos sde chen po btab/ phar tshad kyi 'chad nyan yang dag par mdzad/ gdan sa mkhan chen bsod rgyal ba la gtad nas rang lo zhe dgu pa la jo nang gi gdan sa mdzad/ lo lnga nas de yang gtad nas dbus la bzhud/ slar bse mkhar chung du phebs/ dus 'khor sogs kyi 'chad nyan gnang bas/ sa ga li 'grem pa sum brgya tsam gyi nang nas gsol ja rgyug pa'i chos dpon brgyad cu tsam byung zer ro/

/des na jo nang phyogs pa 'di'i dpal ngam ring gi chos sde'i bla brang dang shar nub kyi grwa khang la sogs pa btab pas chos sde btab ces grags pa ni/ 'das lo nas sum stong bzhi brgya dang bdun cu rtsa 'dren gyi skabs su yin par sems la/ 'di nyid chos sde'i mkhan rab lnga pa yin zhing / 'di nyid kyi mkhan po bsod nams rgyal mtshan la gtad rjes/ slar yang mkhan po mdzad cing / de nas mkhan po bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan la gtad ces mkhan rab las 'byung / mkhan po lan gnyis pa de kho pas jo nang gi gdan sa mdzad rjes yin nam ji ltar yin ma 'tshal lo/ /gangs khrod pa kun mkhyen grags pa dpal ni chu mo 'brug gi lo bsgyir phu rgya sar byon/ kun mkhyen dol bu dang dgung mnyam yin zhing mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa zhig ste/ lam 'bras kyang sa lugs dang zhwa lugs gnyis char bzhugs/ de yang sa lugs ni la tu ba dang nyan chen pa gnyis la gtso bor gsan/ gzhan yang tshogs sgom pa'i dngos slob gnyag snying po rgyal mtshan/ de'i slob ma mang mkhar rta lung pa bkra shis bzang po/ dza tsha lung pa rgyal mtshan dpal/ bar ston rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ dge rgan thugs rje bsod nams dang bzhi'i rta lung pa la'ang thor cha gsan zer/ khong gi zhwa lugs ni 'dzin pa rgyal mtshan dpal la gsan pa yin la/ 'dzin pa des lam 'bras kyi 'khrid lugs mi 'dra ba bco brgyad bzhugs par grags pa'i rgan mo lhas pa khams chen byang chub dpal la gsan/ des ko brag pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan la gsan pa yin la/ de lta bu'i gangs khrod pa nas brgyud pa'i gsung ngag ni/ des sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen la gnang / des theg chen chos rje la gnang / des 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan la gnang / des 'jam dbyangs blo gros rgyal mtshan nas brgyud de kho bo cag gi brgyud pa 'di la bzhugs pa yin no/ /gangs khrod pa 'di nyid ngam ring gi mkhan po yang lo dgu'i ring mdzad zer te mkhan rab gsum pa yin/

mkhan po thog ma ni dpon chen yon btsun chen po ti shri grags 'od dang / de'i dbon po ti shri sangs rgyas dpal dang / de'i dbon po kun spangs grags pa rgyal mtshan rnams la bka'i gnang ba zhus shing / khu dbon de dag gis mthun pa'i rkyen sbyar nas/ sta sde la rgyab tu sku 'khrungs pa'i mkhan po shākya seng ge spyan drangs nas chos sde chen po thog mar btsugs zhes 'byung bas so/ /sum stong bzhi brgya dang nyi shu tsam zhig 'das pa'i tshe dpal ngam rings kyi chos sde thog mar gzhi tshugs pa yin no snyam du sems so/ /des na kun mkhyen dol bu dang / kun mkhyen gangs khrod pa byon pa'i chu pho 'brug nas lo grangs nyis brgya dang don gnyis 'das pa'i don gsum pa ni shing pho byi lo 'di yin no zhes khong du chud par bya'o// ༈ //sum stong bzhi brgya dang nyer bdun 'das pa'i nyer brgyad pa shing mo lug la rgyal sras thogs med bzang po dpal lho phul chung du byon/ bcu gnyis pa la bsam gling du dpal 'bar dang / rin chen dpal bzang gi drung du rab tu byung / mtshan bzang po'i dpal zhes gsol/ bco lnga pa la bo dong er slob dpon kun dga' rgyal mtshan pa'i drung du mngon pa sogs la sbyangs/ 'jam dbyangs nyi ma rgyal mtshan pas mngon pa nas zang zing med pa'i tshor ba sdug bsngal bshad kyang zang zing med pa dang / tshor ba sdug bsngal srid pa 'gal bas lan thob gsungs pa la/ nyan rang dgra bcom pa la nyon mongs med kyang / snga ma'i las dbang gis tshor ba sdug bsngal 'byung tshul gyi sgo nas lan mdzad pas/ thogs med bzang po dpal zhes snyan par bsngags/ dpang lo bu dol chos rje bla ma la sogs pa'i mkhas grub dam pa bsten nas bcu dgu pa la bshad pa'i dga' ston spel/ nyer gcig pa nas 'chad po'i ring lugs bskyangs/ nyer dgu pa la byang sems rin mgon dang / nam mkha' sangs rgyas sogs las bsnyen par rdzogs/ so gnyis pa nas zhe gcig gi bar du bla brang rta ra'i gdan sa mdzad/

de nas e'i chos kyi khrir gsol ba btab kyang ma gnang ste kho bo las ches lhag pa zhig sgrub gsungs/ dpang lo chen po nyid spyan drangs/ byang chub kyi thugs kyis bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa ches lhag par bsgrubs te/ re bdun pa glang lo dbus la byon/ ta'i si tu byang rgyal dang mjal tshur zhabs la btud zer bas/ theg chen chos rje'i bcu gsum lon pa'i si tu ba gshegs pa'i lo de tsam yin par sems/ gang na'ang don lnga pa lcags phag tshes nyi shu la zhi bar gshegs so/ /slob ma'i mchog ni bu dol/ chos rje bla ma/ lo chen byang rtse sogs mtha' yas shing / gtso bor brgyud 'dzin ni dpal ldan ye shes so/ /rgyal sras pa/ bu rin po che las lo bzhi dang / dol bu las gsum gyis gzhon zhing / lo chen byang rtse las brgyad/ chos rje bla ma las bcu bdun gyis bgres so// ༈ //sum stong bzhi brgya dang so lnga 'das pa'i so drug pa chu mo yos la lo chen byang rtse lho zur tshor dpang gi lcam mo gcig gi sras su bltams/ bdun pa la dpang lo'i drung du dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa nod/ bcu drug pa la shong lo'i dbon po mkhan chen chos skyong dpal las dge tshul du bsgrubs/ dpang lo mnga' ris gnas po che dang / sa skya sogs su bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar 'khod de bslab sbyangs mdzad/ dpang los brtag par mdzad phyir bur rdog mang po grangs byas pa bcol nas re re nas blangs shing / rtsis pas ma tshang ba med par rtsis 'grig 'phral phugs kyi mdzad pa la dges pa thob ste/ dkar po nam lang zhes mtshan du gsol/ nyer gsum pa shing mo glang lo la dpal ldan sa skyar mkhan po 'jam dbyangs don yod rgyal mtshan/ las kyi slob dpon dpang lo/ gsang ston chos rje bla ma/ grib tshod mkhan po bsod nams bzang pos bgyis te bsnyen par rdzogs/ sprel lo sa skyar bshad gsar dang / gzhan yang zhwa lu sogs su grwa skor mdzad/ yongs kyi bshes gnyen chen po chos rje bla ma sku mched/

dpang lo/ rgyal sras pa/ bu dol/ gangs khrod pa grags pa dpal/ ma ti paṇa chen/ mchims blo bzang grags pa sogs la mdo rgyud kyi gsan pa mthar phyin/ 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyis bstan pa rin po ches gsal bar mdzad de/ don brgyad pa rta zla'i tshes nyer gcig la gshegs so/ /slob ma'i mchog ni nyid kyi dbon po lo chen grags pa dang / sgra pa nam mkha' bzang po sogs so// ༈ //sum stong bzhi brgya dang so bdun 'das pa'i so brgyad pa me pho rta la rig pa 'dzin pa gzungs kyi dpa' ba mdog sler byon/ dgung lo brgyad cu rtsa gcig bzhugs/ byang rtse las lo gsum gyis gzhon// ༈ //sum stong bzhi brgya dang zhe gnyis 'das pa'i zhe gsum pa lcags pho khyi la 'jam dbyangs don yod rgyal mtshan byon/ 'di nyid bzang po dpal gyi sras rnams bla brang go bzhir gyes pa'i bla brang rin chen sgang pa zhes grags pa de yin la/ 'di'i gcen rin chen sgang pa ta dben kun nyi dang / dus mchod bla brang pa kun dga' legs pa dang / lha khang bla brang pa'i tī shri kun dga' legs 'byung gsum dgung mnyam yin la/ 'di'i gcung bla ma dam pa dang / bzhi thog bla brang ba gu shri nam mkha' rgyal mtshan gnyis dgung mnyam yin zhing / bdag nyid chen po'i sras dgu'i tha chung yin no/ /de yang 'jam dbyangs don yod rgyal mtshan ni rang lo nyer gnyis pa'i tshe/ gcung bla ma dam pa dang gnyis bo dong bya rgod gshongs rnying pa'i gtsug lag khang du mkhan po tshogs pa'i mkhan po bsod nams grags pa dang / slob dpon dpal ldan seng ge las bsnyen par rdzogs/ gdul bya dag pa la 'jam dbyangs seng khri'i zhabs pad brten pa yang mthong / so bzhi pa sprel lo zla ba lnga pa'i tshes bcu gcig la gshegs so/ /'di nyid lo chen byang rtse las lo bdun gyis gzhon zhing / rab tu ma byung gong gi sras bla chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ de'i sras 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/

de'i sras bdag chen blo gros rgyal mtshan te/ de nyid ni brgyud pa gsum ldan gyi gsung ngag rin po che'i bdud rtsi ngom par gsol ba kho bo cag gi brgyud pa'i gtso bor byed pa yin no// ༈ //sum stong bzhi brgya dang zhe bzhi 'das pa'i zhe lnga pa chu pho byi lo bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan bltams/ gzungs dpal las lo drug gis gzhon/ lo gsum pa'i tshe bla ma bzang po dpal la 'jam dbyangs kyi lung nod nas bsnyen pa mdzad pas/ thogs med kyi spobs pa brnyes/ bcu gcig dpal bla chen kun blo bod du bsnyen rdzogs la byon pa la dge bsnyen zhus/ bcu bdun pa la mkhan po bsod grags sogs las rab tu byung / nyi shu pa la bya gshongs rnying par bsnyen par rdzogs/ yongs 'dzin gyi dam pa dpang lo bu ston lo chen byang rtse rgyal sras thogs med/ na bza' brag phug pa/ brag phug pa bsod nams dpal/ mkhan chen bsod nams bzang po/ dpal ldan seng ge sogs la mdo rgyud kyi zab don blangs/ 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi sgo nas bstan pa'i ring lugs legs par bzung / dbus gtsang gnyis su 'dus pa chen po rnam gnyis kyi chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ rje btsun gong ma'i bka' bsdu ba mdzad de bstan pa rin po che gsal bar mdzad do/ /de yang re gcig pa byi lo bo dong e'i chos grwar gtsang phyogs kyi dge 'dun stong phrag bzhi bcu dang / re gnyis pa glang lo bsam yas su dbus phyogs kyi dge 'dun stong phrag nyi shu la gser dngul gos dar la sogs pa'i 'gyed dang 'bel ba'i gtam gyis dga' ba skyed/ snye thang du dus kyi 'khor lo 'chad pa na/ dpe 'grems don gnyer ldan pa lnga brgya phrag gcig 'dus/ bstan 'gro'i bya ba rgya cher mdzad/ stod lung pa shes rab rdo rjes 'jam dbyangs gzi 'od 'bar bar mthong ba sogs dag pa'i snang ba bstan/ 'di nyid kyi bka' 'bum la yang pu sti nyi shu rtsa lnga bzhugs/

dgung lo re bzhi pa shing mo yos kyi lo zla ba drug pa'i nyi shu lnga'i nyin dag pa'i zhing du gshegs so/ /slob ma'i mchog ni sngar gyi rgyal tshab chen po gnyis/ gsung ngag 'dzin pa'i thugs sras brgyad/ bstan 'dzin kyi skyes bu chen po bzhi/ yongs grags kyi mkhas pa chen po bcu gcig go /dang po ni snar thang pa shes rab snang ba/ yar lung pa seng ge rgyal mtshan gnyis so/ /gnyis pa ni sngags 'chang gzungs dpal/ dpal ldan tshul khrims/ bla chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ nyan dbon kun dga' dpal/ jo nang mkhan chen byang seng / lo chen byang rtse/ lo chen skyabs mchog dpal/ spyan mnga' grags pa byang chub bo/ /de dag las sngags 'chang gzungs las/ bzang po rgyal mtshan/ mkhas pa dge bzang gnyis kyi sgo nas gsung ngag rdzong lugs zhes grags pa'i brgyud pa'i gtso bor mdzad pa yin la/ gnyis pa chos rje dpal ldan tshul khrims nas grub chen buddha shrī la brgyud de/ gsung ngag ngor lugs zhes grags pa'i brgyud pa'i gtso bor mdzad pa yin no/ /de nas brgyud pa gsum pa bzhi pa lnga pa gsum ni/ kho bo cag gi brgyud pa'i gtso bo bdag chen blo gros rgyal mtshan la yang bzhugs pa yin te/ chos rje bla ma/ bla chen kun rgyal/ 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ bdag chen blo gros pa zhes dang / chos rje bla ma/ nya dbon kun dga' dpal/ rtse chen pa kun blo/ 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog bzang po/ bdag chen blo gros pa zhes dang / chos rje bla ma/ mkhan chen byang seng pa/ theg chen chos rje/ 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ bdag chen blo gros pa zhes brgyud pa yin la/ de nyid las rdo rings kun spangs pa/ yongs 'dzin blo gsal rgya mtsho zhes kho bo cag gi 'dren pa de nyid la bka' babs pas so/ /drug pa lo chen byang rtse las/ lo chen grags pa/ de las paṇa chen phyogs las rnam rgyal zhes bo dong pa dag gi brgyud pa'i gtso bor mdzad pa yin no/

/brgyud pa bdun pa ni lo chen skyabs mchog nas/ shangs chos 'khor sgang pa/ sgra pa shes rin sogs las brgyud pa yin la/ brgyad pa ni spyan snga ba nas rje gtsong kha pa la sogs pa'o/ /bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu bzhi ni/ bu dol/ rgyal sras pa/ mkhan chen g.yag pa dang bzhi'o/ /yongs grags kyi mkhas pa bcu gcig ni/ ma ti paṇa chen/ red mda' ba gzhon nu blo gros/ nai rings pa 'jam dpal rdo rje/ theg chen chos rje kun dga' bkra shis/ gnyag phu ba bsod nams bzang po/ rtog ge pa dkar po dpal ldan bzang po/ grub chen buddha shrī/ spos khang pa rin chen rgyal mtshan/ lha btsun bsam yas pa/ shar gtsong kha blo bzang grags pa rnams so// ༈ //sum stong bzhi brgya dang don gnyis 'das pa'i don gsum pa lcags pho 'brug la karma pa rol pa'i rdo rje kong yul du byon/ chos rje bla ma las lo nyer brgyad kyis gzhon/ lo gsum pa'i tshe nga karma paka shi'i skye ba yin/ 'dzam bu gling 'dir nga yi gdul bya mang du yod gsungs/ mkhan chen don grub dpal dang gdan gcig pa bsod nams 'bum las rim gyis rab byung bsnyen rdzogs mdzad/ mtshan chos kyi grags par gsol/ rol pa'i rdo rje ni rang byung rdo rje'i gsang mtshan yin zer/ nyer gcig pa la hor gyis gdan drangs te tho gan thi mur gyi bla ma mdzad zer/ bla chen bsod blos ti shri mdzad pa'i skabs tsam yin par sems/ dgung lo zhe bzhi pa chu phag gi zla ba bdun pa'i tshes bco lnga'i tho rangs gshegs so// ༈ //sum stong bzhi brgya dang don gsum 'das pa'i don bzhi pa lcags mo sbrul la/ gnyag phu ba bsod nams bzang po gtsang gsum mdor byon/ 'di chos rje bla ma las lo nyer dgu dang / karma rol pa'i rdo rje las gcig gis gzhon/ theg chen pa las lo brgyad kyis bgres so/ /lo lnga pa la gnyag chen bsod nams dbang phyug la dge bsnyen zhus/ bcu gcig pa la mkhan po don grub dpal las dge tshul nod/

khyi lo mkhan po yon tan rgya mtsho dang / las slob dpal ldan brtson 'grus las bsnyen par rdzogs/ dpal ldan sa skyar nya dbon kun dga' dpal la tshad ma gsan te de nyid kyi slob bu bzhi brgya'i nang nas mchog tu mdzad/ de'i dus na dpal ldan sa skyar mkhas pa nya brtson gnyis grags che zhing / mdo phyogs kyi 'chad nyan rkang tshugs su gnang ba las/ nya dbon ni dol bu ba'i slob ma'i mchog dang / brtson 'grus dpal ni bu ston gyi slob ma'i mchog yin/ de'i tshe gnyag phu ba 'dis mkhan chen bsod nams dpal yang rigs pas bcom ste ston pa bzang ba'i grags pa thob ces kyang zer ro/ /rje 'di nyid dang / g.yag phrug sangs rgyas dpal dang / karma pa dkon mchog gzhon nu dang / mkhas pa sangs rgyas 'phel dang / gzhan gnyis dang bcas pa'i dpal ldan sa skya pa'i mkhas pa drug gis dbus gtsang la grwa skor la phebs pa na/ nya dbon gnyis kyis thog drangs rgya mtsho dpon rnams kyis sa skya mdun gyi zhing bya khra ma'i khar skyes thung mdzad/ mkhas pa khyed drug phyogs su 'bel ba'i dga' ston la 'chas pa la grangs lhag tu mi 'dug kyang / yon tan khyed drug las lhag pa phyin chad mi 'byung zhing / so so nas yon tan gzhal du med kyang / nya dbon bslab pas che bar 'dug pas gral gyi dbus su zhog ces kyang bsngags so/ /gsang phu dang rtse thang sogs su bka' chen bzhi/ mdo rgyan/ mdzod drug la bshad pa'i sgra snyan lhag par bsgrags/ mkhas mchog bsten tshul yang / kun mkhyen gangs pa la bde mchog dpal ldan bla ma dam pa la dus 'khor/ mkhan chen byang seng pa la sbyor drug ma ti paṇa chen la spros med/ rgyal sras pa la sems bskyed/ theg chen chos rje la lam sbas bshad/ jo nang phyogs las pa la dus 'khor gsan/ de yang bse mkhar chung du dpe 'grems gsum brgya/ chos dpon brgyad cu la phyogs las pas dus 'khor zab bshad mdzad/ ngas shes tshad de tsam yin khyed rnams so so'i go yul yig chung re khyer shog gsungs/

so so nas phul bas/ gnyag phu ba'i shog ril la 'dis kho bo'i grub mtha' go 'dug gsungs phyag rgyas spras te gnang zer/ g.yas ru byang nas skyi 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rin chen gyis bka' stsal te/ dpal ldan bzang ldan gyi chos grwar slob bu btsun chung drug gnang nas 'chad nyan la bskos/ lo bcu drug 'chad nyan bsrings pas/ blo gsal gsum brgya tsam 'dus te bzang ldan dge 'phel gyi grwa tshang tshugs/ slar chung pa chos gzhon dang / grwa pa thug phrad kyi nyen blangs/ 'jam dbyangs pas mjal phrad ma gnang ba'i mtshams sbyar te/ chos kyi sbyor yang nor dang mi ldan zhing / /bden tshig yod kyang zhu ba'i skabs med pa/ /nyes pa med kyang nag can gnyag phu ba'i/ /zhu ba'i tshig 'di cung zad gsan par rigs/ /ces sogs kyi zhu mchid phul te phyogs la phebs pas jo gdan mkhan po'i brtag pa bud pa dang / rten 'brel sne 'dzoms te mkhan por mnga' gsol/ de yang sa pho khyi lo bco brgyad pa nas/ sa mo bya lo nyer dgu'i bar lo bcu gnyis phyi nang gi bslab sbyangs mthar phyin pa mdzad/ sum cu pa lcags pho khyi nas zhe gcig pa byi lo'i bar lo bco lnga 'chad nyan yang dag par mdzad/ zhe gcig pa shing pho khyi lo sne gdong grags pa rgyal mtshan pas spyan drangs te jo gdan dge 'dun sgang pa'i mkhan po kha che paṇa chen gyi gdan seng ge'i khri la lnga bcu rtsa drug pa sa mo yos kyi bar lo bcu drug brtan par 'khod/ mdor na bla ma yongs 'dzin bdun gyis lhag pa'i bcu phrag brgyad bsten/ 'chad pa'i rgyun bsrings/ rtsom pa phal cher sku shin tu bgres pa nas mdzad de/ don gsum pa la 'dul ba'i bka' 'grel bdud rtsi nying khu/ don brgyad pa la 'jam dbyangs kha ches bskul te chos dbyings bstod pa'i rnam bshad snying po don gsal/ brgyad cu pa la rdo rje snying 'grel gyi ṭīkka/ gya gcig pa la lo tsā ba skyabs mchog gi gzhan stong dgag pa'i lan lung rigs gter mdzod/

gya gsum pa la 'dul ba 'di la bag chags sad/ rgan po'i lag rjes 'jog gsungs/ lung sde bzhi so thar gyi mdo dang bcas pa la mchan bu btab/ gya lnga pa la rgyud bla'i ṭīkka mdzad/ rtsod pa yang sang pa dang / bde gshegs snying po'i skor la rtsod pa mdzad pa sogs bstan pa dpang btsugs kyis rtsod pa mdzad/ dgung lo dgu cu rtsa gsum pa chu mo glang gi lor gshegs so/ /slob ma'i mchog chos bzang nyi ma/ bka' bcu pa padma bzang po/ karma de bzhin gshegs pa/ karma mthong ba don ldan/ smra ba'i seng ge rong ston chen po sogs so/ /des na da lta'i shing byi lo 'di/ rgyal sras thogs med byon pa'i shing mo lug nas nyis brgya dang bdun cu pa/ lo chen byang rtse'i chu mo yos nas nyis brgya dang re gnyis pa/ chos rje bla ma dam pa'i chu pho byi ba nas nyis brgya gsum pa/ nya dbon byon pa'i lcags sbrul nas nyis brgya dang nyi shu rtsa bzhir slebs pa yin no/ /mkhas pa'i dbang po g.yag phrug sangs rgyas dpal zhes pa yang / gnyag dbon dang rigs lam smra ba thog mtshungs shing / 'di bas cung zad gzhon zhing / rje btsun red mda' ba las cung zad bgres pa zhig yin la/ de yang rtse thang gi chen po byang chub rin chen gyi sras yin pa la/ rnam pa de nyid kyi nye gnas g.yag phu zhes pas sras su ngos blangs pas na g.yag phrug ces btags la/ 'khrungs yul dngos ni sa skya 'phrang zhes bya ba de nyid yin zhing / dpal ldan sa skya dang rtse thang sogs su gsan sbyong mdzad/ sa skya'i mkhas pa nya brtson gnyis kyis/ mkhas dbang brtson 'grus dpal la gtso bor bstan nas mdo sbyangs shing / gon gyo ye shes pa la gsung ngag sogs gsan/ bu dol gyi slob ma nya brtson gnyis/ nya brtson gyi slob ma g.yag gzhon rnam gnyis zhes bstan pa'i gsal byed dam par gyur/ dbus gtsang gi gnas mkhas grub gong ma'i bsti gnas so sor mkhas pa'i slob bu grangs ha cang mang ba min pa zhig la/

'chad pa'i rgyun bsrings/ brgyud 'dzin gyi mkhas pa rong ston smra ba'i seng ge dang / sems dpa' chen po gzhon nu rgyal mchog sogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig byon la/ 'di nyid mus chen sems dpa' chen po'i nyer bdun pa shing pho rta lor dge ldan du gshegs zhes 'byung bas/ red mda' chen po zhi bar gshegs pa'i chu pho 'brug gi yang phyi ma'i rta lo de yin par sems so// ༈ //sum stong bzhi brgya dang brgyad cu 'das pa'i gya gcig pa sa mo byi lo mnyam med red mda' ba chen po bod kyi blon po mgar stong btsan gyi brgyud du dpal ldan sa skya dang nye ba'i red mda' khab sor byon/ nya dbon las lo drug gis gzhon/ theg chen chos rje las lo gcig gis bgres/ lo bco brgyad pa la sa bzang ma ti'i drung du tshigs snga ma gnyis nos te mtshan gzhon nu blo gros zhes gsol/ thog mar dpal ldan sa skyar mkhas pa nya dbon dang / mkhan chen sangs rgyas 'phel gyi drung du tshad ma/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i drung du phar phyin/ lo chen byang rtse la mngon pa gong 'og rgyal sras pa'i drung du blo sbyong / mdog lhod pa mkhan chen kun dpal las bsnyen par rdzogs shing 'dul ba gsan/ mkhan pos stod 'dul gyi sdom brgyud 'di ma chad pa gcig gnang dgos zhes pa'i bka' stsal phebs zhes zer mod/ stod 'dul ba'i bshad rgyun ma gtogs sdom rgyun rang du cung mi 'gro bar sems te/ mdog lhod pas chos rje bla ma las bsnyen par rdzogs shing 'dul ba gsan/ chos rje bla ma'i sdom rgyun ni mkhan po shākya shrī las brgyud pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang bla ma dam pa'i drung du lam 'bras/ lo tsā ba nam bzang / lo tsā ba grags rgyal/ lo tsā ba skyabs mchog sogs las gsang 'dus sogs kyi rgyud man ngag dang / mkhan chen byang seng la dbu ma gsan zhing / dkon mchog la gsol ba btab te rang nyid kyi rnam dpyod kyis dpyad pas dbu ma thal 'gyur ba'i gnad la nges pa cher rnyed do/

/nged tsho slob gnyer byed dus dbu ma'i dpe cha gcig 'dug ces nor mi che bar byed pa las/ deng sang rtsis su byed pa 'di kho bos bstan pa la bya ba byas pa yin zhes dang / karma dkon gzhon gyi gsung gis/ deng sang mkhas rmongs kun kha dbu ma sna dbu ma zer ba 'di/ red mda' ba'i drin yin/ de gong thang zag na dbu ma shi ro gcig las gzhan med ces gsungs zer te/ rgyud gsang ba 'dus pa dang / dbu ma thal 'gyur ba'i bstan pa la 'di kho na bka' drin che ba yin/ de yang mkhas pa 'di sngon bu ston rin po che la mos pa zhig yin na'ang / slob dpon dang grogs kyi stobs kun mkhyen chen po'i grub mtha' la 'dris che ba zhig byung / de nyid kyi grub mtha'i rgyab rten bka' bstan bcos la gzigs rtog tshar gsum mdzad pas/ dang po la gzhan stong gi grub mtha' de bka' bstan bcos de dag gi dgongs pa yin pa'i nges pa shar/ gnyis pa la som nyi za ba gcig byung / gsum pa min pa'i nges shes 'grongs pa gcig byung gsungs zer na'ang / gnas skabs so sor phye dgos so zhes kho bo smra'o/ /de'i tshe chos kyi gnad ma gtogs par/ grub mtha' kha 'dzin rang stong gzhan stong zhes pa'i ming tsam la zhen pa dag gis/ chos spong gi las cher bsags par snang ba ni/ blun rmongs kho na'i spyod yul lo/ /mkhas pa 'dis ni bshad sgrub spel mar mdzad de/ bul rong gi dben gnas su lo bcu gnyis bzhugs pa'i lnga dpyad sgom gtso bor ston pa'i thugs dam nyams bzhes kho na mdzad/ lo bdun bskal ldan gyi gdul bya brgyad cu bskor la nyams khrid legs bshad kyi dga' ston spel/ rtsom pa mdzad pa yang / 'dzam gling mdzes pa'i rgyan mchog bka' chen bzhi/ /rtsa 'jug bzhi gsum theg chen rgyud bla dang / /chos mngon mdo dang dpal ldan 'dus pa ste/ /rnam bshad mdzad pa'i gzhung lugs bcu phrag gcig /ces pa ltar yin la/ 'chad pa'i dbyangs kyi gsungs las skyes pa'i slob ma'i grangs kyang /

kun mkhyen sher 'od blo bzang grags pa sogs/ /gzhung lugs rab 'byams smra ba'i bshes gnyen bdun/ /bka' bzhi legs par smra ba bcu phrag gcig /phar tshad shes pa'i slob ma brgya phrag brgal/ /zhes pa ltar te bshes gnyen bdun ni/ sbyangs pa'i mchog gyur kun mkhyen sher 'od dang / /sras kyi mchog gyur blo bzang grags pa dang / /lta ba'i mchog gyur gon gyo nyi ma grags/ /nyams len mchog gyur kun dga' dpal bzang po/ /brtse ldan mchog gyur dpal 'byor shes rab dang / /'chad mkhas mchog gyur bsod nams shes rab dang / /rtsod bzang mchog gyur dar ma rin chen te/ /zhes pa ltar yin zhing / bka' bcu pa gzhan yang byang pa bka' bcu pa dge legs dpal la sogs pa'o/ /de lta bu'i skyes bu de ni drug cu rtsa lnga pa chu pho 'brug gi zla ba bcu pa'i nyer dgu'i nyi shar la dag pa'i zhing du gshegs so/ /des na sum stong bzhi brgya pa'i 'jug 'dir/ bka' bzhi pa dang bka' bcu pa la sogs pa'i mtshan dang ldan pa'i mkhas grub mang dag byung ste/ hor bka' bzhi pa seng ge rgyal mtshan/ bka' bzhi pa nam mkha' 'od zer la sogs pa dang / bka' bcu pa ni rgyal tshab dar ma man chad nas byung bar gsal te/ de yan chad bka' chen bzhir grags pa dang / de bzhi'i steng du ci rigs bsnan pa'i drug tsam la grwa bskor mdzad pa sha stag byung ba yin la/ rgyal tshab rjes pu sti bcu la bshad pa'i srol stod mnan nas bka' bcu pa zhes mtshan grags shing / bo dong phyogs las pas bco lnga la bshad pa gnang yang / dbon po bka' bcu pa zhes pa tsam las ma byung la/ phyis byams chen smra ba'i dbang po sangs rgyas 'phel man chad nas rab 'byams zhes yongs su grags so/ /'on kyang bka' bcu pa gzhon nu seng ge sogs de yan la yang bka' bcu pa'i mtshan cung zhig grags par gsal lo// ༈ //sum stong bzhi brgya dang gya gcig 'das pa'i gya gnyis pa sa mo glang la theg chen chos rje kun dga' bkra shi dpal ldan sa skyar byon/

chos rje bla ma las lo so bdun gyis gzhon no/ de yang bdag nyid chen po bzang po dpal gyi sras rnams bla brang go bzhir gyes pa'i lha khang bla brang pa'i gdung brgyud dri med pa ste/ lha khang bla brang pa ti shri kun rgyal yab bzang po dpal zhe dgu pa lcags pho khyi lo byon pa yin la/ de'i sras tā dben chos rgyal mtshan yab nyer gsum pa chu pho sprel lor byon pa yin zhing / de nyid bco brgyad pa'i sras theg chen chos rje 'di nyid yin no/ /de yang dang por sa bzang ma ti las rab tu byung / phyis chos rje bla ma las bsnyen par rdzogs/ gzhan yang gangs khrod pa grags pa dpal jo nang phyogs las pa sogs mkhas grub mang du bsten/ gsung ngag gsan pa'i bla ma yang thog mar ma ti paṇa chen la sa bzang dgon par gsan pa yin mod/ de nyid la lam dus kyi chu rgyun chag med mi bzhugs pas phyis sa skyar zur khang du bu ston dbang phyug dar ma la gsan/ brgyud pa de yang chos rje brag phug pa nas/ brag phug dkon rgyal/ de nas sa skya bu ston la brgyud pa yin gyi chos rje bla ma brgyud pa la mi bzhugs pas/ phyis chos rje bla ma las dngos su nod pa/ mkhan chen byang seng la nod pa yin no zhes rje btsun dam pa kun dga' grogs mchog gsungs la/ mthar tā ming rgyal pos spyan drangs te/ re bzhi pa chu pho 'brug la sa skya nas shar phyogs la phebs/ re lnga pa chu mo sbrul la pho brang ser khang du rgyal po dang mjal/ rgyal po 'khor bcas la dbang dang gdams pa'i sgo phye/ 'phags pa ti shri dang 'dra bar bod chol kha gsum yang 'bul/ slar pho brang ta'i tur byon/ gser dngul gyi thub pa nye ba'i sras brgyad kyis bskor ba gandho la dang bcas pa yang phul/ 'di nyid byang ngam rings su yang lo skor gcig tsam zhugs/ gzhan yang byi ru'i gshed dmar/ sher shing gi 'jigs byed/ bse'u thags kyi thang sku gnyis/ za 'og thal gnyis la sogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa phul/

slar re gsum pa rta lo la gong nas bteg re bdun pa lug lor dpal ldan sa skyar phebs te/ don bdun pa shing mo sbrul lo gro zhun zla ba'i tshes bcu'i nyi shar la dag pa'i zhing du gshegs so/ /slob ma'i mchog ni kun dga' rgyal mtshan 'jam dbyangs grags pa'i dpal lo// ༈ //sum stong bzhi brgya dang gya dgu 'das pa'i dgu cu pa me mo bya la shar tsong kha pa blo bzang grags pa mdo khams su byon/ chos rje bla ma las lo lngas gzhon/ red mda' ba chen po dang theg chen pa las rim bzhin lo dgu dang brgyad kyis gzhon no/ /'di nyid lo bdun pa la mdo khams pa don grub rin chen las rab tu byung / don grub rin chen bcom ldan rigs ral gyi bu chen 'phrog ston rigs pa'i seng ge'i slob ma yin zer/ dgung lo bcu drug pa la dbus gtsang du byon/ grwa pa bde ba can du snye thang pa bkra shis seng ge sogs la phar phyin sbyangs/ bcu dgu pa la gsang phu sogs su grwa skor gnang / gtsang phyogs kyi zhwa lu snar thang sa skya sogs su byon/ sgra tshad pa rin chen rnam rgyal dang / ma ti paṇa chen sogs las zab chos gsan/ grwa skor yang mdzad/ la stod byang gi mdar/ bzang ldan/ ngam rings/ 'ga' rogs sogs su grwa skor mdzad/ jo nang du phyogs las pa la sbyor drug gsan/ bo dong du grwa skor mdzad nas snar thang du phyag phebs/ der nya dbon la phar phyin dang / rje btsun red mda' ba la mngon pa dang dbu ma sogs gsan te/ de nyid kyi thugs sras dam par gyur/ skyor mo lung gi mkhan po bka' bzhi pa blo gsal la 'dul ba gsan/ gong gsum bde chen pa sogs las sngags kyi rgyu man ngag gsan/ jo gdan tshogs chen pa'i mkhan po bka' bzhi pa tshul rin las bsnyen par rdzogs/ bla ma dbu ma pas mtshams sbyar te/ rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs la chos gsan/ bla ma dbu ma pa ni mdo khams su byis pa'i dus nyid nas 'jam dbyangs kyi sku'i snang bar shar/

rje 'di dang phar slob tshur slob yin/ mdor na rje 'di'i sku tshe'i stod la thos bsam gyis rgyud sbyangs/ bar skabs su bya bral kho na mdzad de zab don la dpyad sgom gyi sgo nas don nyams su bzhes/ 'phral gyi kun spyod 'dul ba'i lag len gsos btab/ khyad par dbu ma thal 'gyur ba'i bstan pa cher spel/ sku tshe'i smad la gzhan don phyogs med du rgyas/ dgung lo nga gsum pa sa mo glang la chos 'khor lha sar smon lam chen mo mdzad/ jo bo la rin po che'i dbu rgyan yang gsol/ bka' chems las/ de nas khyad par bsnyen bkur cher mdzad pa/ /dge slong byang sems shar phyogs sku 'khrungs pa/ /gsang sngags 'chang zhing rnal 'byor chen po ni/ /snying po'i mtha' can skyes mchog dam pa ni/ /zhal yang bsgyur zhing bsnyen bkur dam pa mdzad/ /ces pa'i lung gi don yin par yang 'chad/ lo de nyid la ri bo dge ldan btab ste phyin chad ri bo dge ldan zhes yongs su grags pa yin no/ /de nas dgung lo re gsum pa sa mo phag gi nyer lnga la dag pa'i zhing du gshegs so/ /slob ma'i mchog ni rgyal tshab rje/ mkhas grub rje/ thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub/ 'dul 'dzin grags rgyal dang / 'dul 'dzin blo gros sbas pa ste 'dul 'dzin rnam gnyis la sogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab bo/ /des na da lta'i shing byi 'di theg chen pa byon pa'i me glang nas nyis brgya dang bcu drug pa/ shar gtsong kha pa byon pa'i me bya nas nyis brgya dang brgyad du sleb pa yin no// ༈ //sa bcad lnga pa sum stong brgya pa'i skabs su byon pa ni/ rong ston smra ba'i seng ge bo dong phyogs las rnam rgyal/ sa skya pa'i bstan 'dzin kun dga' rnam gnyis/ karma de bzhin gshegs pa la sogs pa ste/ sum stong bzhi brgya dang go dgu 'das pa'i lnga brgya'i steng du slebs tsam gyi me mo lug la rong ston shākya rgyal mtshan shar rgya mo rong du byon/

shar gtsong kha pa las lo bcus gzhon/ lo bco brgyad pa yan chad du bon la 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gnang / bco brgyad pa la gsang phu ne'u thog gi chos grwar gling stod pa rin chen rnam rgyal dang / kong ston blo gros dbang phyug gi drung du rngog nas brgyud pa'i phar tshad bsdus gsum dang / dbu ma rang rgyud kyi bshad srol skyor mo lung gi mkhan chen bka' bzhi pa dang / 'phan yul gro pa'i mkhas pa dmar ston la 'dul ba smad lugs bya 'dul dang / thog ma bka' chen gyi bshad srol mngon pa mdo mchims lugs kyi bshad srol/ thang sag pa sprul sku gzhon nu rgyal mtshan la dbu ma thal 'gyur pa tshab kyi bshad srol/ lo pa shākya rin chen gyi drung du mngon pa gong ma sogs sbyangs/ lo nyer gnyis pa la gro pa'i mkhan po kun dga' rgyal mtshan dang / dmar ston pa'i drung du rab tu byung zhing bsnyen par rdzogs/ rnam nges kyi ṭīkka brtsams shing 'chad pa'i 'khur bzung / mdor na lo nyer gnyis nas gya gsum gyi bar la mkhas pa'i bya ba gsum gyis dus 'da' ba byung zhing / nyer bdun pa sa mo bya'i lo la mkhan chen g.yag pa dang mjal te sa lugs kyi mdo'i bshad srol dang / theg chen chos rje la gsung ngag sogs sngags kyi zab don blang nas/ sa rngog rnam gnyis kyi bshad srol rgyun bsrings te/ cha pa chos seng dang / bcom ldan rigs ral dang / kun mkhyen 'di gsum las 'chad pa'i rgyun dang / dngos slob bstan 'dzin thon che ba ma byung zhes grags/ gtsang phyogs la yang lan gsum byon pa'i dang po lo nyer bdun pa'i tshe mkhan chen pa'i zhabs 'bring mdzad do/ /mdo'i zab don gsan pa dang / legs bshad kyi skyes 'bul ba kho na mdzad/ gnyis pa rang lo zhe brgyad pa la mkhan chen gshegs te/ lnga cu tsam gyi tshe ding ri dang mus sogs su sngags kyi zab don bzhes pa dang / mdo phyogs kyi phrin las spel ba kho na mdzad/ lan gsum pa drug cu rtsa gcig pa'i tshe sde dpon so so'i bsod nams kyi mgron dang /

mdo sngags kyi chos 'khor bskor ba kho na mdzad/ bdun cu pa me mo 'brug la na lend+ra'i chos grwa chen po btab te/ lo bcu bzhir gzhan don mdzad cing dbus gtsang du grwa skor mdzad pa'i po sti bcu kho na yin yang / gzhan la 'dom pa'i gzhung lugs drug cu rtsa bzhi dang / rnam bshad mdzad pa'i gzhung lugs bzhi cu yod gsungs/ gzhan yang yar lung pa seng ge rgyal mtshan/ lo chen skyabs mchog lo chen grags pa/ kun mkhyen sher 'od/ snyan ngag pa 'jam dbyangs kha che/ mus chen nam mkha'i rnal 'byor sogs la zab don mang du blangs/ dam pa sangs rgyas kyi sku lus la kā ma la shī la'i thugs grong 'jug mdzad pa de'i sku'i skye ba gdon mi za bas/ dam pa'i zhi byed/ kā ma la shī la'i sgom rim sogs phyogs su gsal bar mdzad cing / khyad par phar phyin gyi bstan pa dang / dbu ma rang rgyud kyi bstan pa la kun mkhyen 'di bka' drin che ba yin no/ /legs bshad 'dom pa'i 'bras bu mkhas grub slob ma'i grangs ni/ snga tshar gyi bu chen bstan pa 'degs pa'i bka' chen bzhi/ bar tshar gyi bu chen gangs can mdzes pa'i rgyan brgyad/ mchog gnyis/ sku gsung thugs kyi mdzad spyod mtshungs pa'i bu chen gsum/ phyi tshar gyi bu chen bstan pa'i gsal byed bcu drug yang tshar gyi bu chen grags pa can bzhi la sogs pa'o/ /de la ka chen bzhi ni sems dpa' gzhon nu rgyal mchog sems dpa' chen po padma bzang po/ bzad pa blo gros rgyal mtshan/ spyan mnga' tshul khrims dar ma'o/ /bar tshar brgyad ni dmar khams pa grags pa bzang po/ dge ba rgyal mtshan/ gung ru rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ rong chung shes rab dpal te khams pa bzhi'o/ /chos lung bka' bcu pa/ sga sdong pa chos rgyal dpal bzang / mkhas dbang ratna shri bha dra/ snar thang pa shes rab seng ge bzang ldan bka' bcu pa ste gtsang pa bzhi'o/ /mchog gnyis ni dbus pa dmar ston rgya mtsho rin chen dang / gtsang pa sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gnyis so/

/phyi tshar bcu drug la/ paṇa chen bzhi ni snar thang lo tsā ba saṃ gha bha dra/ yar rgyab dbon po paṇa chen bsod nams rnam rgyal/ spob 'dar ba lo chen gzhon nu dpal/ dwags po dbon po paṇa chen bkra shis rnam rgyal lo/ /gsung sgros 'dzin pa'i mkhas pa bcu gnyis ni/ khams su lha 'bre ston pa shes rab rdo rje dang / rin chen blo gros gnyis/ dbus su bzod chen phyogs las rnam rgyal/ mkhas grub don yod dpal ba gnyis/ nyang stod pa shes rab legs pa dang / ngam ring pa sangs rgyas grub/ mnga' ris su 'jam dbyangs shes rab rgya mtsho/ nges med du bzhugs pa gzhu don bsod nams rin chen/ gsang phu na paṇḍi ta nam mkha' bstan pa/ gtsang rong byams chen nas dkar shākya grags/ khams nas gyon gyo sbyin bzang dang / gzi blo gros seng ge rnams so/ /yang tshar bzhi ni/ gsang phu nas gra ston pa yon tan rgya mtsho dang / rtse thang nas chen po dpal 'byor rgya mtsho gnyis/ khams su go bo rab byams pa shes rab dpal dang / gtsang du byams chen rab 'byams pa sangs rgyas 'phel te bzhi'o// ༈ //sum stong lnga brgya dang brgyad 'das pa'i dgu pa me pho 'brug la/ la stod pa shrī par pa ta dpal gyi ri'i byang ngos kyi 'brog sde chen por bo dong phyogs las rnam rgyal byon/ lo bdun pa la gyam dgon par rang gi zhang po lo chen grags pa'i drung du rab tu byung / mtshan sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan du gsol/ slar bo dong er lo chen de nyid las dge tshul du sgrub ste mtshan chos kyi rgyal mtshan du btags/ lo bcu drug pa la dpal ldan sa skyar rnam 'grel la grwa skor mdzad/ bo dong er dbyangs can ma sgrub pas/ rgyud mang gi sgra las zab rgyas kyi chos tshul nod/ de phyi nang gi gnyid ma lus par sad pas/ dbyangs can dga' ba'i dpal zhes grags/ dgung lo nyer gsum pa la rtse thang dang gsang phur po sti bco lnga'i grwa skor gnang bas mkhas pa'i grags pas khyab/

de'i tshe gsang phur mkhan chen g.yag phrug sangs rgyas dpal dang / rig gter gyi dgongs pa rang rig la yul yod med la rtsod pa'i tshe/ mkhan chen pas rang rig yul med du zhal gyis mches pa la/ rje 'dis rang rig chos can/ khyod rang gi zhal bya la mi bslu ba'i rig par thal/ tshad ma yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na khyod kyi yul yod par thal lo/ /zhes dang / mkhan chen pas gzugs sgra ka bum sogs rtag par khas blangs pa la/ ka ba chos can/ khyod ni gzugs med par thal/ khyod rtag pa yin pa'i phyir zhes pa'i rig pa'i sgo nas snyan par grags so/ /'on kyang pha rol gyi gru'i 'dod dang bstun na khyab pa med mtshams de kho na yin pas/ phas rgol pham par gyur pa yang ma yin no/ /de nas slar e chos kyi 'byung gnas su lo chen grags pas mkhan po dang / rje btsun red mda' chen pos las slob bgyis te bsnyen par rdzogs/ des na paṇa chen 'dis rnam par thar pa ni brjod kyis mi lang bsam gyis mi khyab na'ang / gtso bor bsdus na rtsod pas phas rgol gyi grags pa gzhom tshul/ rtsom pas bka' bstan bcos kyi dgongs pa bkral tshul/ 'chad pas bstan 'dzin gyi bu slob spel tshul gsum las/ dang po ni la stod tā'i se tu lha btsan skyabs pas mthun pa'i rkyen sbyar te/ g.yag phrug sangs rgyas dpal dang rtsod pa'i tshe/ bka' bstan bcos kyi gzhung phal che ba/ rgol phyi rgol gnyis char gyi mgrin pa nas thogs med sgrogs shing / phas kyi rgol ba g.yag phrug chen po'i spobs pa sgrub pa la/ rgol ba de nyid kyi yi dam gyi lha rje btsun mi g.yo ba mngon sum du byon pa/ paṇa chen de nyid kyis kyang zhal gzigs/ de'i tshe lha gcig ma ngo log pod gcig ma mgo ma thon/ gdong gang po rtsod pa pham zhes grags so/ /zhes zer mod/ don du na rje btsun mi g.yo ba mngon sum du byon pa ni rgol ba gnyis char gyi ngo mtshar smad du byung ba'i rnam thar yin zhing /

rtsod pa'i ngag la yang / rang rang gi gdul bya'i snang dor pham rgyal gyi snang ngo tsam las/ pha rol gyi rgol ba nyid shis la pham par rigs pa ga la yin ste/ dper na de'i tshe mkhan chen g.yag pas sems can sangs rgyas nges yin/ rgyas par mi srid ces khas blangs pa la/ paṇa chen gyi 'o na sa bon las myu gu skyes par mi srid par thal/ dam bca' de'i phyir zhes pa la sogs pa la lan ma byung zhes sgrog mod/ yang dag pa na de gnyis mtshungs pa'i go skabs ga la yod de/ sems can sangs rgyas par med pa khas blangs kyi/ sems can las sangs rgyas 'byung ba med pa khas blangs pa med pa'i phyir na/ sa bon myu gur song ba med pa khas blangs kyi sa bon las myu gu skye ba med par khas blangs mi dgos pa'i phyir/ de nas byang ngam rings su bdag chen 'jam dbyangs rin chen pas mthun rkyen sbyar te/ dpal ngam rings kyi bshes gnyen dag la 'bel ba'i gtam gyi sgo phye ste/ don dam don byed nus pa gang / /zhes pa'i gzhung la grub mtha' rnam bzhi'i bden gnyis kyi rnam bzhag phra zhing zhib pa'i blo gros kyis phye ste/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsod nams skyabs dang / mkhas grub dge legs sogs rigs pas pham par byas so zhes grags so/ /de nas byang mdog gi pho brang du tā'i se tu rnam rgyal grags pas mthun pa'i rkyen sbyar te/ kun mkhyen rong ston chen po slob bu'i tshogs dang bcas pa la 'bel ba'i gtam chen po gleng / gsang sngags kyi dkyil 'khor chen po khri khrag gcig gi zhal phye pa zhal gyis mches shing / 'jam dbyangs kyi dkyil 'khor drug cu'i rnam grangs legs par bgrangs shing / 'phags yul du byon pa'i thal rang gi skyes chen 'dren res bgyis pa na/ rong ston chen pos legs ldan byed/ dpal sbas/ ye shes snying po/ zhi ba 'tsho/ kā ma la shī la ste lnga las bgrangs ma bzod pa la/ paṇa chen 'di nyid kyis nyi shu rtsa lnga tsam zhig thal byung du bgrangs pa sogs kyi sgo nas pha rol zil gyis gnon zhes grags so/

/gnyis pa rtsom pa ni yi dam gyi lha dpal rdo rje sems dpa' dang / rdo rje phag mo la sogs pas mngon sum du snang ba stsal zhing / dpal de nyid 'dus pa rtsoms shig ces gnang ba nos pa dang / mtshan gyi 'od gsal chen po las dpal sa skya pa chen po grags pa rgyal mtshan dang / bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa dang / gshongs ston rdo rje rgyal mtshan la sogs pas kyang / de ltar gnang ba stsal ba la brten/ de nyid 'dus pa'i rgya mtsho/ 'jug pa'i sgo bzhi le'u nyi khri chig stong / man ngag bdun khri bdun stong / chos tshom brgyad khri bzhi stong yod pa'i rgyas pa la glegs bam brgya dang bcu/ 'bring pa la nyi shu/ bsdus pa la glegs bam gnyis/ shin tu bsdus pa'i snying po la glegs bam gcig yod pa'i rtsom pa chen po mdzad de rgyal ba'i bstan pa gsal bar mdzad do/ /gsum pa 'chad pa blo gsal gyi bu slob spel tshul ni/ bzo rig nas bzung yongs su rdzogs pa'i bar/ /de dang de yi bka' bab nyi shu gsum/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje mi g.yo zlos gar mkhan/ /rnam dag 'khon gyi gdung brgyud rnam pa gsum/ /rig sngags 'chang ba'i khyu mchog chen po gcig /nyi ma zla ba ltar grags mkhas grub gnyis/ /'jig rten gsum gyi mig cig lo chen gsum/ /phyogs las rnam rgyal rgyal ba'i bshes gnyen drug /mdo sngags yongs rdzogs mkhas pa bcu gsum dang / /paṇa chen shākya shrī'i gdan sa gnyis/ /'dus pa rgya mtsho'i gtsug rgyan bcu drug dang / /mtshan nyid rab 'byams smra ba'i bshes gnyen gsum/ /sngags gzhung rab 'byams smra ba'i bshes gnyen gsum/ /sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'i rnal 'byor bzhi/ /drag po'i brtul shugs rdzogs pa'i sngags 'chang gnyis/ /bka' bcu legs par smra ba stong phrag gcig /bka' bzhi kun tu smra ba stong phrag zung / /phar tshar shes pa'i slob ma khri khrag brgal/ /tshe 'di blos btang grub chen lnga bcur ldan/

/lhag par rgyal ba thams cad brnyes pa'i yum/ /rdo rje phag mo gsang ba'i mdzod 'dzin ma/ /sa la dge slong ma yis rab grags pa/ /sprul pa'i gar gyis gsang ba 'dzin par mdzad/ /ces pa ltar bka' babs nyi shu rtsa gsum ni/ bzo rig gi bka' babs mnga' ris bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho/ gso rig bka' babs byang pa rnam rgyal grags bzang / snyan ngag gi bka' babs ngam ring bka' bcu pa dpal ldan bzang po/ tha snyad kyi gtsug lag gi bka' babs dpal e'i bka' bcu pa nam mkha' dpal bzang / tshad ma rig pa'i bka' babs stag lung bka' bcu pa mañdzu shrī/ 'dul ba'i bka' babs gung thang pa dpal ldan seng ge mngon pa'i bka' babs gsang phu ba bzad pa blo gros rgya mtsho/ phar phyin bka' babs gung thang pa rgyal mtshan dkon mchog byams chos bka' babs sa skya bka' bcu pa mchog gi blo gros/ dbu ma'i bka' babs bka' bzhi pa shes rab mgon po/ spyod 'jug gi bka' babs sa skya byang sems gzhon nu rgyal mchog 'chad pa'i bka' babs dmar khams pa grags pa bzang po/ rtsod pa'i bka' babs shel dkar ba thugs rje dpal/ rtsom pa'i bka' babs rtse thang pa bsod nams rnam rgyal/ btsun pa'i bka' babs gung thang pa ma ti bi dza ya/ sred pa las grol ba'i bka' babs rgyal khams kyi spongs ba pa yon tan seng ge mos gus kyi bka' babs sku zhang 'jam dbyangs chos rje/ rgyud rdo rje phreng ba'i bka' babs rtse thang pa mkhan chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ gar gyi bka' babs bo dong pa dar ma seng ge sde snod gsum gyi bka' babs shel dkar ba dpal ldan sangs rgyas/ rgyud sde'i bka' babs stag lung thang pa ka drug pa ngag dbang grags pa/ rtogs pa'i bka' babs rang dbon gla 'khor ba ngag dbang rgya mtsho/ bstan pa yongs kyi bka' babs shel dkar ba 'jam dbyangs grags pa dang nyer gsum mo/ /'khon gyi gdung brgyud gsum ni bdag po grags pa blo gros/ grags pa rdo rje/ theg chen pa'i dbon po dge legs bkra shis pa dang gsum mo/

/sngags 'chang gi khyu mchog gcig bu ni/ rdo rje 'dzin pa kun dga' rgyal mtshan no/ /nyi zla ltar grags pa gnyis ni/ mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang po dang / dpang lo'i sku skyer grags pa'i blo gros brtan pa gnyis so/ /'jig rten gyi mig gsum ni/ e'i lo tsā ba bsod nams bzang po/ lo tsā ba rdo rje bzang po/ lo tsā ba thugs rje dpal ste gsum mo/ /phyogs las rnam rgyal gyi mkhas pa drug ni/ bo dong stag sde ba dol pa rgyal mtshan grags/ spyi bo lhas kyi mkhan po bshes gnyen nyi ma/ rtse thang pa chos kyi grags pa/ gsang phu bka' bcu pa padma bzang po/ snar thang pa dge 'dun grub pa/ shang chos 'khor sgang pa'i mkhan chen bka' bcu pa shes rab rin chen te drug go /mdo sngags yongs rdzogs bcu ni/ bo dong rta ra'i chen po rin chen chos bzang / dol pa rgyal bzang / bo dong brang mo che'i rgyal grags/ brang mo che'i chen po shes rab grags/ rtag sde ba shes rab dpal/ sgro smon can gyi bla ma kun dga' dpal/ bo dong rta rin chen po 'jam dbyangs dkar po/ bo dong brang che'i chen po seng ge rgyal mtshan/ slob dpon chos kyi nyi ma/ gsang phu ba rong chung shes rab dpal/ bka' bcu pa ratna shrī/ rje'i dbon po shel dkar ba mkhan chen rje btsun pa/ ngam rings rab 'byams pa sangs rgyas seng ge ste bcu'o/ /kha che bsod snyoms pa'i gdan sa gnyis ni/ tshogs chen pa'i mkhan po don grub dpal 'byor dang / dge 'dun sgang pa'i mkhan po seng ge dpal gnyis so/ /gtsug rgyan bcu drug ni/ dam pa rgya gar gyi gdan sa glang 'khor chos rje kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ paṇa chen 'bum phrag gsum pa'i gdan sa pa mkhan chen nam mkha'i rin chen/ yang de'i mkhan po nyid kyi dbon po mkhan chen 'jig med grags pa/ yang de'i mkhan po nyid kyi dbon po bshes gnyen blo gros rgyal mtshan/ ngam ring mkhan chen bsod nams skyabs/ yang de'i mkhan po dkon khang pa nyi ma/

mngon dga'i chos dpon 'jam dbyangs kun legs/ de'i mkhan chen rgyal mtshan blo gros/ nyang stod dpal 'khor bde chen gyi mkhan po dkon mchog bzang po/ byams chen gyi mkhan po sku skyes/ 'dzim pa'i mkhan po bkra shis rin chen/ 'dus pa 'bring gi rtsom yig nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ 'phags pa nam snying / 'dar mkhan chen bde legs rgyal mtshan/ dge 'dun sgang pa'i mkhan po byang chub mchog ldan te bcu drug go /mtshan nyid rab 'byams pa bzhi ni/ gsang phu bas go bo rab 'byams pa/ shel dkar ba yon rgyal/ byams chen rab 'byams pa sangs rgyas 'phel/ mnga' ris pa nam mkha' bsod nams dang bzhi'o/ /sngags rams pa gnyis ni/ shab lhun rtse ba kun mkhyen 'phags 'od dang / rmog cog pa'i gdan sa sangs rgyas dpal bzang gnyis so/ /sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa bzhi ni/ jo gdan ras chen gzhon nu dpal/ chos rje brtson 'grus rgyal mtshan/ la phyi ba nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ grub pa'i rgyal mo bsod nams 'bum dang bzhi'o/ /sngags 'chang drag po gnyis ni/ ngam rings kyi a nanda dang / gung thang gi bla chen chos dpal bzang po'o/ /bka' bcu stong phrag ni bsod nams blo gros sogs so/ /bka' bzhi stong phrag zung ni mus sras bka' bzhi pa sogs so/ /phar tshad khri khrag rgal ba ni/ de dus kyi bshes gnyen phal che ba'o/ /sgrub chen lnga bcu ni/ rnal 'byor ma rdo rje phag mo sogs so/ /des na dpang lo chen po nas bo dong e'i gdan seng ge'i khri chen po la 'khod par yin la/ de'i gnag gi dbon po lo chen byang rtse/ de'i rus kyi dbon po lo chen grags pa/ de'i gnag gi dbon po paṇa chen 'di nyid yin te/ dbon rgyud de dag gis rim par bzung zhing bo dong pa zhes snyan pas grags so/ /des na lo 'di ni paṇa chen 'di byon pa'i sbrul lo nas brgya dang brgyad cu rtsa brgyad pa yin/ paṇa chen 'di dpal ldan sa skya pa'i bstan 'dzin kun dga' rnam gnyis las lo bdun gyis bgres shing /

rong ston chen po las lo bco brgyad kyis gzhon no/ /mnga' ris bla chen chos dpal bzang po lcags mo phag lo pa ste/ paṇa chen 'di las lo lnga yis bgres/ a nanda pa chu pho byi lo pa ste paṇa chen 'di bas lo bzhis bgres pa tsam yin no// ༈ //sum stong lnga brgya dang bcu bzhi 'das pa'i bco lnga pa chu pho khyi la dpal sa skya pa'i bstan 'dzin kun dga' rnam gnyis byon/ de yang rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po ni/ sa skya tshogs kyi nye gnas dpon tsha grub pa yon tan gyi sras su bltams/ lo dgu pa la shar pa ye shes rgyal mtshan gyis mkhan po/ sa bzang 'phags pa gzhon nu blo gros kyis slob dpon mdzad de tshigs snga ma gnyis nod/ de nas bzung ste lo nyi shu rtsa lnga bzhes kyi bar du gtso cher shar chen po'i zhabs pad bsten te rgyud man ngag gi zab bcud blangs/ shar chen pas mkhan po/ mkhan chen blo gros dpal bas las slob/ sa bzang 'phags pas gsang ston bgyis te bsnyen par rdzogs par yang mdzad de/ rdor dkar gdan gcig kho na mdzad cing nyes ltung gi dri mas dben/ gzhan yang sa bzang 'phags pa gzhon nu blo gros la rdo rje phreng ba sogs rgyud sde'i bshad srol mang du gsan/ mkhan chen g.yag pa la rnam rig sogs rigs pa'i gsang tshig gnad du dril ba gsan/ sa skyar sgo rum gyi rje btsun gong ma'i gsung rab la lo gsum gyi bar du gzigs rtogs nan tan mdzad pas chos spyi dang / khyad par dpal ldan sa skya pa'i zab don gyi gnad la phyin ci ma log pa'i go ba phul byung rnyed/ chos rje dpal ldan tshul khrims pa la kyai rdor man ngag lugs kyi bka' gsan pas/ dpal ldan sa skya pa'i bstan pa'i 'jug sgo thog ma yin no/ /zhes mi 'phrog pa'i dad pa thob/ dgung lo nyer lnga pa'i tshe shar chen pa zhi bar gshegs te/ gsung ngag rin po che'i bdud rtsi sngar ma gsol bas thugs kyi mdun pa cher g.yos te/ shangs chos 'khor sgang du lo chen skyabs mchog pa'i drung du lhags pa na/

mdo rgyud kyi zab rgyas kyi chos mang dag dang / snang gsum gyi khrid rim tsam las thugs kyi re ba ma rdzogs pa na/ dus de'i tshe mtshan gyi 'od gsal chen po'i ngang las/ bla ma kun dga' bzang po lam 'bras zhu na 'di na yar byon zer ba gcig byung bas/ de na phar byon pas ri 'bor gcig na dngas ra sgo byang bstan/ rtsig pa khrol le ba gcig gi nang na/ khang pa sgo shar bstan zhig gi skas la 'dzegs byon pas/ skas mgo nas dge bshes sha rtsi rmug po byas pa gcig gis spos sna byas nas byon pas/ 'tshoms kha lhor bstan gcig na bla ma sku bgres se ba ber thul bsnams pa gcig dang / mjal te zag med kyi dga' ba chen po myong ba gcig byung / phyis dpal ldan sa skyar byon/ gsung ngag gi rtsad spyad pas/ chos rje dpal ldan tshul khrims pa la gsung ngag yongs rdzogs kyi slob ma'i gtso bo gsum gyis/ shar chen pa ni zhi bar gshegs/ mer nyag rin rdor ni khams la bzhud/ grub chen buddha shrī nyid 'os su gzigs te/ dgung lo nyer bdun pa sa mo byi lo zhe dgon du byon pas/ 'od gsal du ji ltar shar ba de kho nar mngon sum du gyur/ mos gus kyi bsam pa tshims te lus nyams mnan gyis mi bzod par cher skyes/ byi ba dang glang gi lo de nyid du gdan phab/ stag lo chos rje buddha ba sa skya dang sa bzang gnyis su chos 'khor bskor ba'i tshe'ang zhabs pad la btud de gsung ngag gi bdud rtsi sogs snying po'i bcud la tshim par rol/ dgung lo zhe brgyad yan la sa skya chu bzang sogs gnas nges med du gsung ngag sogs zab rgyas kyi dga' ston so sor spel/ de nas gnas kyi brtag pa mdzad pa na/ e wam̐ chos ldan gyi ri khrod de 'od gsal la gsal por shar/ gang na yod ma nges pa la khyod kyi dgon pa don grub kyi ston pa yod zer ba 'od gsal la shar/ phyis nyag re don grub zer bas gnas de'i yon tan bsngags pas/

dgung lo zhi brgyad pa sa mo bya la e wam̐ chos ldan gyi dgon gnas chen po btab/ dpal ldan sa skya pa'i rgyud man ngag dang rgyud sde bzhi'i bstan pa spyi khyab dang / khyad par bya spyod kyi bstan pa la rje 'di nyid kho na bka' drin che ba yin no/ /rje 'di nyid kyis dbang khrid gdams pa'i sgo bye ba phrag brgya phye/ gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras tshar gsum gyis lhag pa'i bcu phrag brgyad gnang / bsnyen par rdzogs pa khri ral pa can gyis mkhan po mdzad/ dge 'dun gyi sde gsar btsugs kyang / glo bor dge 'dun stong phrag 'du ba'i chos sde/ chu 'dus su lnga brgya 'du ba/ steng khyebs su nyis brgya 'du ba/ gu ger brgya phrag sogs dang / e waṃ chos ldan du gsang ngag pa stong phrag 'du ba sogs su bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa dar rgyas mdzad/ mthar don lnga pa byi lo sa zla'i nyer lnga la gshegs/ zla ba tshes 'phral rje mus chen gyis gsung ngag btsugs/ phyi nang gi rten bzhengs pa sogs mdzad do/ /sngags kyi bstan pa spel ba'i slob bu'i grangs kyang / bu ston rin po che dang rje 'di gnyis las lhag pa med pas bgrangs bar mi spobs kyang gtso bor bsdus na/ bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu chen po bcu ni/ sems dpa' chen po gzhon nu rgyal mchog dmar khams pa grags pa bzang po/ chos rje gzhon nu seng ge byams chen rab 'byams pa sangs rgyas 'phel/ paṇa chen shākya mchog ldan/ kun mkhyen go bo rab 'byams pa bsod nams seng ge paṇa chen 'bum phrag gsum pa/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' chos bzang / thugs sras kyi gtso bo sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ gung ru shes rab bzang po/ nyag bre/ rgyun bskul ba paṇa chen grags pa rgyal mtshan/ dpal gyi rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs shes rab rgya mtsho/ rgyal tshab dam pa kun dga' dbang phyug mkhas grub dpal ldan rdo rje/ sa skya'i gdung brgyud bdag chen chu mig pa grags pa blo gros pa/

bdag chen mthu stobs dbang phyug bsod nams rgyal mtshan pa/ bdag chen bzhi thog pa kun dga' dbang phyug pa/ bdag chen chu mig pa blo gros dbang phyug shar pa'i gdung brgyud ye shes dbang phyug rgyal mtshan/ 'brug pa'i gdung brgyud rgyal dbang rje/ bod chos rgyal gyi gdung brgyud mnga' bdag khri dbang rgyal mtshan/ gu ge mnga' bdag lha btsun pa yar lung gong ma yab sras/ grub thob thang stong rgyal po rnams 'di'i slob bu dpal gyi rgyal mtshan yan ma dpe ltar dang / 'jam dbyangs shes rab rgya mtsho man ma tshang shing 'chad pa rje rdo rje 'chang rang nyid kyi rnam thar sogs khung thub nas kha bskang / kyi gtsos pa'i slob bu mtha' yas pa zhig bskrun par mdzad/ mthar dgung lo bdun cu rtsa lnga pa sa ga zla ba'i nyer lnga la e wam̐ chos ldan de nyid du gshegs so// ༈ //bstan 'dzin dam pa kun dga' rgyal mtshan ni lo tsā ba zhang ye shes sde sogs byon pa'i rigs brgyud dbon po nor 'phel gyi sras su dpal ldan sa skya'i mthong smon bla brang du chu pho khyi de nyid la byon/ lo lnga pa la bo dong phyogs rgyal las dge bsnyen nod/ bcu par shar pa ye shes rgyal mtshan las dge tshul nod de kun dga' rgyal mtshan zhes btags/ nyi shu pa la theg chen chos rjes mkhan po dang / shar yes slob dpon mdzad de bsnyen par rdzogs/ tshad ma rig gter rtsa 'grel la shin tu sbyangs pas mtshan 'jam dbyangs grags pa'i dpal zhes theg chen pas gsol bar mdzad/ bo dong er bla ma kun dga' bzang po lo bdun tsam bsten/ tshad ma sogs la bshad sbyong mdzad/ lo bcu gsum pa la gdan sa chen por grwa skor yang gnang / mkhan chen g.yag pas phar phyin gyi ka chen rtsom pa'i rtsom yig pa mdzad de ṭīka chen rtsom pa dang / yi ger 'bri ba dang / thugs la zin pa gsum dus mnyam du byung bas phar phyin yang dag par mkhyen/ de'i tshe mkhan chen pa bar skabs su ngal gso ba'i tshul du mnal cung zad mdzad de/

sad res kyi da len yang kho bos dga' ldan du phyin/ byams pa dang 'jal zhes yang yang gsung ba yin zer/ theg chen chos rje'i drung du gsung ngag sogs zab rgyas kyi gdams pa nod/ gzhan yang bla chen kun rgyal/ sa bzang gzhon nu blo gros/ bla ma dpal ldan don grub sogs las rgyud man ngag mang du gsan/ phyis byang nas 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rin chen gyis spyan drangs te/ dpal ldan sa skya pa'i zab chos mang po'i sgo phye/ dpal ngam rings kyi mkhan po dang / ya ga chos sdings zhes grags pa nor bu gling gi grwa tshang gi 'dzin skyong yang gnang / yos lo ngam rings su mgon khang bzhengs dus lha khang ka gnyis ma la/ logs bris skya ris ja sbyor gcig gi ngo la gnang / blo bzang dkar mor grags pa'i grub chen blo gros bzang po la/ gsung ngag sa lugs dang zhwa lugs sogs gsan pas thugs bskyed thon par byung / grub chen des kyang bde mchog sogs zab rgyas kyi gdams pa zhus/ mtshan gyi 'od gsal chen po las rje btsun gong ma lnga'i zhal gzigs te/ rgyal ba'i mdun na rgyal sras sbyin pa dpal/ /zhes sogs shlau ka lngas bstod cing phyag 'tshal ba 'od gsal las bzhengs pa'i tshe yang gsal bar dran/ deng sang ya ga chos sdings na yang rgyun du 'don par mdzad do/ /mdor na 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi sgo nas dpal ldan sa skya pa'i bstan pa ches cher gsal bar mdzad de/ nga lam 'bras la mkhas pa yin/ /ni gu ba rgad po yin/ sbyor drug pa nyams myong can yin zhes gsung ba yin zer ro/ /slob ma'i mchog kyang sngags 'chang a nanda pa/ bdag chen dpal ldan chos skyong / sems dpa' gzhon nu rgyal mchog mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang po la sogs pa mang du byon te/ slar rang lo nga lnga pa me pho 'brug gi lo khrum zla ba'i nyer brgyad la gshegs so// ༈ //'das lo nas sum stong lnga brgya dang nyi shu 'das pa'i nyer gcig pa sa pho 'brug la mus stod gling skyar mus chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan byon/

dgung lo dgu pa la dbang 'od pas mkhan po mdzad/ rab tu byung bco lnga pa la gle lung mkhan po 'dun smon dang / zur chos pa byang seng gnyis la phar phyin spyod 'jug sogs sbyangs/ bco brgyad par bshad ston mdzad/ nyi shu pa la nam mkha'i rnal 'byor la gcod khrid gsan/ nyer gcig pa la ngam rings su blo gros rgyal mtshan dang sa blo ba'i drung du phar phyin sogs sbyangs/ lo gsum nas der grwa skor mdzad/ nyer bzhi pa la lhor mkhas mchog thugs rje dpal ba'i drung du phar phyin gyi dka' gnas la dpyad/ sa skyar grwa skor mdzad/ nyer lnga la shel dkar du mkhas pa g.yag pa dang 'jal/ lha'i nags 'dab khyung lung du zla ba gnyis/ ngam rings su zla ba gnyis/ tsha snar zla ba gnyis te zla ba drug phar phyin gyi gnad zab mo nyams su myong / nyer bdun pa la g.yag pa mkha' spyod la gzhud/ nyer brgyad pa la mu gu lung du sems dpa' chen po gzhon nu rgyal mchog snga phyir lo bdun bsten/ tshad ma 'u yug pa'i rigs mdzod chen po sogs la sbyangs/ so gnyis pa la ngam rings su chos rje rong chen pa la phar tshad kyi gnad zab mo gsan/ so bzhi pa la byang bka' lnga pa dpal 'byor shes rab la dbu ma red mda' ba'i lugs gsan/ so lnga pa stag lo lha sar skor ba 'bum gter mdzad/ yar lam nub chos lung du bdag chen kun dpal las bsnyen par rdzogs so/ /so brgyad pa 'brug lor dpal ldan sa skyar rje ngor pa'i drung du bde dgyes kyi lam zab mo gsan/ thugs yid gcig tu 'dres/ so dgu pa sbrul lo theg chen chos rje gshegs/ rje dpon slob kyis brtag gnyis bshad pa dang / sbyor drug gi gnad zab mo nyams len mdzad/ bzhi bcu pa rta lo dpal ldan sa skya der gsung ngag rin po che'i zab don nyams su myong / slar yang zhe gcig pa sprel lo nas zla ba bdun du gsung ngag rin po che zab gnad mthil phyin par gsan/ zhe gnyis pa sa mo bya nas ngor dgon gsar 'debs pa'i mkhar las dang /

zab don nyams len zung 'jug tu mdzad cing rje 'dis de'i tshe brtag gnyis rnam bshad kyi dga' ston legs par skyed/ de nas bzung ste rje 'di'i re brgyad dang / rje ngor chen don bzhi bzhes kyi bar du ngor dang mus su 'byon res kyis rgyud man ngag gi bstan pa'i me ro sor chud pa mdzad/ zhe dgu pa 'brug lo lha gong du kyai rdo rje'i bsnyen pa zla ba bcu gsum du 'bum phrag bcu gcig nang / nga dgu pa stag lo rje ngor pa nub chos lung du phebs/ rje 'di la ngor du lam 'bras 'dus pa'i tshogs la bdag med ma'i dbang bka' dang 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi rten 'brel zab mo sgrigs shig gsung ba ltar rten 'brel sgrigs/ rje 'di'i re dgu pa ngor chen don lnga pa me pho byi lo sa ga zla ba'i nyer bzhi la ngor chen gyi gdan seng ge'i khri la 'khod/ lo de la rdo rje 'chang dag pa'i zhing du gshegs/ de nas byi glang stag gsum 'dzin skyong gi khur bzhes gnang / don gcig pa stag lo rin spung nor bzang la bde mchog sogs kyi dbang gnang / yar lam mus su ya ma'i dgon pa btab/ don gsum pa 'brug lo mus bsam gtan phug tu bde mchog gi bsnyen pa gnang / lhor tā'i se tu rnam rgyal grags pa yab sras la bde dgyes kyi dbang gnang / don bzhi pa sbrul lor ngam rings su 'dus pa'i tshogs la gsung ngag blo sbyong sogs kyi dga' ston gnang / don lnga pa rta lo rje sher rgyam pa ngor gyi gdan khrir bzhag don bdun pa sprel lor bsam gtan phug tu bdud rtsi ril bu sgrub/ 'od gsal chen po'i ngang du rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi zhal gzigs// ༈ //sum stong lnga brgya dang nyi shu rtsa gsum 'das pa'i rtsa bzhi pa lcags mo lug la thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub dpal ldan sa skya'i gung ru ba zhes pa'i 'brog gnas su byon/ 'brog ma tshugs pa kha yul chags te rdzi po sogs kyang mdzad/

lo bco lnga pa la dpal snar thang gi gdan sa bcu bzhi pa grub pa shes rab las rab tu byung ste thos bsam gyi gzhi btsugs/ nyi shu pa la snar thang gi gtsug lag khang du grub pa shes rab las bsnyen par rdzogs/ nyer lnga pa shing mo lug lo dbus la byon te khra 'brug tu sems dpa' chen po kun bzang la dbu tshad dang / thang po cher rong ston shākya rgyal mtshan la phar phyin gsan/ bkra shis gdong khar rje btsun tsong kha pa chen po dang mjal te grangs nges rnam 'byed sogs gsan/ gsang phur shes rab seng ge la phar tshad sogs gsan/ gro par dmar ston dpal ldan rin chen dang / rgya mtsho rin chen gnyis la 'dul ba gsan te me pho rta'i bar lo bcu gnyis dbus su bzhugs/ me pho rta la gtsang la byon te byang sogs su 'chad nyan mdzad/ bzhi cu pa lcags pho khyi la 'jug pa'i rnam bshad mdzad/ zhe gcig pa phag lor la stod shel dkar sogs su chos bar bteg mkhas grub dpal ldan sangs rgyas dang bsgro gleng mdzad/ padma chos sdings su bo dong phyogs las rnam rgyal la sgrol ma'i dbang sogs gsan/ zhe gsum pa chu mo glang la rtsa shes rnam bshad mdzad/ nyid kyi lnga bcu rtsa bdun pa me mo yos la bkra shis lhun po'i chos grwa chen po btab ste 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyis bstan pa rin po che gsal bar mdzad de/ brgyad cu rtsa bzhi pa shing pho rta lo'i tshes brgyad la zhi ba'i dbyings su gshegs// ༈ //sum stong lnga brgya dang lnga cu rtsa drug 'das pa'i nga bdun pa shing pho 'brug lo mtshungs med rdo rje rgyal mtshan chag skyar skya'i phu'i 'brog seb tu byon/ theg chen chos rje don drug bzhes pa'i lo de yin/ 'di nyid byams chen rab 'byams rje las lo bcu gsum gyis gzhon/ paṇa chen shākya pa las bzhi dang / kun mkhyen gau rams pa las lo lngas bgres/ zla ba gnyis nas mangs ris gung thang du spyan drangs/ lo brgyad pa la gla 'khor ba mañdzu shrī las rab byung mdzad/

dgu pa la sha ra ba'i dngos slob kun smon mdzes pa'i dpal gyis btab pa'i dgon pa mus sras kyi gdan seng ge'i khri la zhabs pad bsten/ lo gsum gyi bar du chos rje yon tan mgon po las rta mgrin yang gsang sogs gsan/ bcu gcig pa shing pho stag lor gung thang gi chos grwar bla chen chos dpal bzang po re bzhi bzhes pa'i tshe zhabs pad bsten/ lo drug bar du rgyud gsum gyi gsan sbyong dpal ldan sa skya pa'i gsung ngag dri ma med pa thugs la smin/ lo bco brgyad pa lcags mo bya lo dpal ngam rings kyi chos grwar rdo rje a nanda pa lo bdun cu pa zhig dang / mnyam med dpal ldan chos skyong lo so gnyis pa zhig gi zhabs la btud de/ a nanda pa las lo nag dril gsum/ 'jigs byed ra lugs/ phag mo skor gsum/ chos skyong gi man ngag sogs dang / bdag chen dpal chos drung du rgyud gsum las byung ba'i dbang bka' bcu bdun sogs dang / bde dgyes kyi bshad bka' du ma gsan/ bcu dgu pa la sems dpa' chen po gzhon nu rgyal mchog pas mkhan po dang / nam mkha' lhun bzang pas slob dpon mdzad de bsnyen par rdzogs/ nyer gcig pa la gung thang gi dpal ri 'dab kyi dgon par sems dpa' chen po rgyal mtshan dkon mchog lo nga bdun pa zhig gi drung du gsung ngag lam skor dang bcas pa dang / gsang 'dus mi bskyod lugs kyi dbang bka' 'gos lugs dang / bshad bka' bo dong lugs dang / nag khrid dmar khrid sogs gsan/ bzhi cu pa la gung thang gi chos grwar shākya shrī bha dra lo gya brgyad pa zhig la dpal ldan sa skya pa'i dbang bshad man ngag mang du nod/ zhe lnga pa la mus srad kyi bsam gtan gling du rin po che chos bde legs pa lo don gnyis lon pa zhig la gur saṃ sbyongs rgyud sogs kyi bshad pa man ngag mang du gsan/ bo dong phyogs las rnam rgyal dang bdag chen rnam rgyal grags bzang la dus 'khor gyi dbang sogs gsan/

zhe dgu pa la dpal ldan sa skyar gdan phebs/ thog mar sa skya sman grong du zhi khro sogs rnying ma'i chos 'khor mang du bskor/ de nas nyi thog dang zhe dgon sogs su bzhugs/ de nas brang mo che pa'i brgya dpon chos rje kun bsam pas/ bla ma mnyam med pa dang / chos rje gzung dpal nas brgyud pa'i chos dri ma med pa bzhugs par dgongs nas/ bla brang brang mo cher spyan drangs gdan phebs te/ dgung lo don lnga pa la zhi bar gshegs kyi bar gnas de nyid du zab don nyams bzhes dang / 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyis bstan pa rin po che gsal bar mdzad de/ de yang rtsom ni rgyud/ man ngag lag len/ spyi 'gro gsal byed de gsal byed rnam bzhi/ bla ma 'phags pa dang / bla ma dam pa/ lag len/ bka' sgrub ste sgrub pa rnam bzhi/ bir srung 'khrul sel sogs 'khrul sel rnam bzhi/ chu rgyun rnam bzhi sogs bsam gyis mi khyab par mdzad/ thugs sras bstan 'dzin byon tshul yang snga tshar la man ngag tshar ba bar 'brog rdor gling gi gdan sa ba 'jam dbyangs bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ chos rje blo gros rgyal mtshan/ rje 'di nyid kyi gcung rtogs ldan blo gros bzang po/ nyid kyi sku zhang bka' bcu dkon mchog bzang po/ chen po rin chen rgyal mtshan/ nyid kyi dbon po se ra ba nam mkha' rin chen dang drug bar tshar la/ byang pa bdag chen bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ me nyag chos grags/ 'dzim pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ brang mo che'i mkhan po kun bsam/ bo dong bka' bcu pa chos rin chen/ jo nang pa nam mkha' chos skyong / shangs pa kun dga' dpal ldan dang bdun no/ /phyi tshar la bdag chen rgya gar shes rab rgyal mtshan/ bdag po bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ rje rin chen byams pa dkon mchog dpal/ 'dzim pa kun dga' snying po/ nyid kyi dbon po kun rin/ brang mo che'i gdan sa pa nam mkha' dpal/ sdom brtson shes rab rin chen/ rab 'byams pa lha dbang / rgyud man ngag gnyis ka tshang ba'i sa dkar ba/

mus chen rnam rgyal bzang po dang bcu'o/ /rje 'di nyid kyi rigs kyang phun sum tshogs pa gtsang gi rigs yin zhing / snga dar gyi tshe rgya nag nas jo bo shākya mu ne spyan 'dren pa'i gyad mi bzhi'i ya gcig gi brgyud pa yin la/ 'di'i rigs las byon pa yang sad mi bdun gyi gtsang de wa ind+ra rakṣa zhes bya ba dang / phyi dar gyi rtsa ba g.yo dmar gtsang gsum gyi/ gtsang rab gsal zhes bya ba dang / der rjes gtsang ban rdor mo zhes bya ba snying ma'i grub thob chen po dang / de nas rnam grol ba kun rig zhes bya ba rgyu 'phrul sde brgyad sogs la mnga' brnyes pa'i mkhas grub chen po sogs mang du byon no/ /thugs dam gyi rim pa yang tho rangs lam zab bir bsrung thun mong min pa/ de nas mchod gtor rgyas pa dang 'brel ba'i lam yab la brten pa'i lam dus rgyas pa/ de nas dkar cha bzhi dang / rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i sbyin sreg de nas gsol ba/ de nas mchod 'bring dang 'brel ba'i lam dus 'bring po/ de nas yum gur rigs bsdus saṃ ṭi'i mtshon bya can/ man ngag lugs la brten pa'i lam dus rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum/ de nas gung tshigs/ de nas zab chos 'chad pa dang rtsom pa sogs mdzad/ de nas mchod gtor rgyas pa dang / lam dus rgyas pa lung sbyin gyi nyams bzhes rnams mdzad do/ /mdor na rang gzhan gyi don mthar phyin te/ don lnga pa nyer bzhi la dag pa'i dbyings su dpal ldan sa skya'i bla brang brang mo che nyid du gshegs so// ༈ //sum stong lnga brgya dang zhe gsum 'das pa'i zhe bzhi pa'i lcags mo yos lo/ bstan pa'i gsal byed byams chen rab 'byams pa rong gi sna rdo spe zhes par byon/ lo bdun pa la chos 'khor sgang du seng ge rgyal mtshan la rab tu byung / bcu gsum tsam la gsang phu ne'u thog tu phyag phebs/ shangs ston rin chen grub la gsan pa mdzad cing / bcu bzhi pa la mngon dga'i chos grwar bka' bzhi'i grwa skor gnang bas skog po bka' bzhi par grags/

bco brgyad pa la rtse thang snyal sogs su bka' bcu'i grwa skor gnang zhing gsang phu'i chos lung spyi khang du bzhugs pas chos lung bka' bcu pa zhes grags/ bcu dgu pa la mkhyen rab dbang phyug gi grwa sar phyag phebs lo bcu bzhugs te/ nyi shu rtsa brgyad pa la po sti bzhi cu rtsa lngas thog drangs pa'i gzhung lugs rab 'byams la dpal ldan sa skyar bshad pa'i dga' ston spel bas byams chen rab 'byams pa zhes grags so/ /gzhan yang rong ston smra ba'i seng ge sems dpa' chen po gzhon nu rgyal mchog rong chung shes rab dpal sogs la mdo phyogs kyi bshad pa rgya cher mdzad/ e wam̐ chos ldan du rdo rje 'chang gis mkhan po/ rje 'khor lo sdom pas las gsang / mkhas pa gzhon nu seng ge'i dus bsko ba mdzad de bsnyen rdzogs/ mkhan slob gnyis las gsung ngag rin po che gtsos pa'i bde kyai gsang gsum gyi rgyud man ngag gi bcud chen po blang / de nas 'di ltar dgongs te dben pa'i bdud rtsi'i nyin mtshan 'da' ba rje mi la lta bu'am/ 'dus pa'i tshogs la gnang ba'i bdud rtsis nyin mtshan 'da' ba rje blo ldan shes rab lta bu gang yang rung ba'i rnam thar la zhugs par bya'i gzhan ni bdag gi cha ma yin no/ /'on kyang de gnyis gang zhig bstan pa la phan par lung bstan du gsol/ zhes bla ma dkon mchog dpang du gsol ba'i brtag pa mdzad pa na/ 'od gsal gyi ngang der rgyal gyi shrī yin zer ba'i rir/ lung gi po sti brag ri bltams pa pha mtha' mi mngon pa zhig gi brda don bsam pas/ 'chad pa'i sgra dbyangs bstan 'gro'i dpal du dgongs te/ thog mar na lend+ra'i chos grwar 'dus pa'i tshogs ha cang mi mang ba zhig la 'chad pa'i bdud rtsi spel/ slar nyi shu rtsa brgyad pa 'brug gi lo la kha rag bong 'brug tu bstan pa'i gzhi 'chad nyan gyi 'brug gi sgra mtho bas rong ston chen po'i zhal gyi bdud rtsi las/ 'brug gsum 'dzom pas gangs can 'dir snyan pa'i grags pas khyab par 'gyur zhes lung bstan/

slar nyid kyi so dgu pa sa mo sbrul gyi zla ba dang po la/ 'dus pa'i tshogs brgya phrag gnyis dang bcas pa'i bdag po rin spung nor bu bzang pos mthun pa'i rkyen sbyar te/ 'bras yul skyed mos tshal du 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyis rgyal ba'i bstan pa nyin mo ltar gsal bar byas pa yin no/ /mdor na lo bco brgyad pa nas don lnga'i bar bstan pa'i bya ba 'chad rtsod kho nas dus 'da' bar byed/ lo lnga cu rtsa brgyad du 'chad pa'i rgyun bsrings pa yin no zhes grags te/ mthar don lnga pa shing mo sbrul snron zla ba'i tshes gcig la gshegs so/ /slob pa'i mchog bstan 'dzin chen po ni bgrang bar mi bzod cing / skyed tshal nyid las mchod pa'i grwa pa chen po yang thub bstan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling / de las mched pa yangs pa can dang gnyis/ gnyan yod bya gshongs/ chos 'khor lhun po/ gzha' ri dgon gsar ba rtsa ba nyid dang / grwa sa chen po drug po 'di nyid kyis kyang 'dzam gling 'di mdzes par byas pa ma yin nam/ bstan 'dzin gyi thugs sras mkhas grub bstan gsal/ rtse thang sang lhun/ gau rab 'byams pa/ 'bum rab 'byams pa/ byams chos don grub/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' chos bzang sogs so/ /des na shing pho byi lo 'di byams chen rab 'byams pa byon pa'i lcags mo yos nas brgya dang lnga bcu rtsa bzhi pa yin no// ༈ //sum stong lnga brgya dang drug cu 'das pa'i re gcig pa sa pho sprel lo paṇa chen shākya mchog ldan gsang phu'i bar tshigs zhes par byon/ lo brgyad pa'i tshe rong ston chen po skyor mo lung du byon pa'i zhabs phyir bar ma rab tu byung ba'i mtshan shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blor gsol/ bcu pa la na lend+rar dge tshul du bsgrubs shing / de nas nyer gcig gi bar rong ston chen po'i zhal gyi bdud rtsi nyams su myong zhing / rgyan drug mchog gi gzhung la sbyangs/ nyer lnga'i tshe ngor du ngor chen/

brag dkar sems dpa' chen po/ mus chen gsum gyis mkhan po dang las gsang mdzad de bsnyen par rdzogs/ mkhan slob de gsum/ lcags lung pa gzhon nu blo gros/ paṇa chen nags rin sogs las gsung ngag sbyor drug sogs zab rgyas kyi chos nod/ lo bco lnga pa la gsang phu'i gnas go grwa tshang gi 'dzin bdag gnang / phyis ngor pas bka' gnang ste dpal ldan sa skyar gzhung lugs brgya la bshad pa'i dga' ston dang / go sgra las drangs pa'i gnas bstod dang / nga brgyad ma sogs mdzad de rig gnas lnga la snyan pa'i grags pas khyab/ nyid kyi zhe gnyis pa sa mo glang la mngon pa gong 'og dpyid chos la dbu ma/ dbyar chos la 'dul ba gtso bor 'doms par mdzad/ mnga' ris su chos rgyal bkra shis mgon gyis dpon slob sum brgya tsam spyan drangs/ de'i tshe kun mkhyen rdzong dkar ba sdom rig la 'chad pa'i dbyangs snyan sgrogs pa'i snyan pas mtshams sbyar te/ bstan bcos sdom pa gsum la dka' gnas spyod pa'i dri ba brgya rtsa brgyad pa mdzad/ shar lam byang ngam rings su 'dus pa'i tshogs kyi bsu ba bsnyen bkur sogs mdzad/ chos rgyal rnam rgyal grags pa la dus 'khor gyi dbang sogs gsan/ slar gser mdog can du dri lan gser gyi thur ma mdzad/ lar 'di'i dris lan bcu phrag gcig gi sgo nas kyang bstan pa dkar por bgyis pa lags so/ /yongs 'dzin bcu gcig la gsan pa rgya cher btsal/ blo brtan bzhi pa dang / de'i nye gnas blo brtan pa'i drung du ka tsan snyan ngag sogs sbyangs shing / yongs rdzogs kyi paṇḍi ta chen por gyur/ spyir rig gnas lnga dang khyad par sgra rig dang / nang rig gi snying po dka' ba mtha' dag dang / lugs gnyis kyi srol las byung ba'i rang stong gzhan stong gi lta ba'i gnad zab mo la 'di kho na bka' drin che ba yin/ zhwa lu mkhyen rab chos rje 'od gsal gyi ngang las bstan 'dzin chen po rnams la gzigs par stsal bas/
