byams chen rab 'byams pa mtshan dus sgron me sbar te phyogs bzhir po sti bkram gzigs rtog gnang zhing / mtha' bram gzugs kyis skor ba zhig gzigs/ paṇa chen 'di nyid sku'i ngo bo mi snang zhing steng gi nam mkhar gzer gyi rdo rje gzi 'od 'bar ba dang / gtor ma la me 'bar ba zhig gzigs/ de yang lta ba zab mo mnga' ba'i mtshon byed do zhes grags so/ /mnga' ris 'khor 'phral 'du khang rnying pa dang / phyis gsar pa mgon khang / lam 'bras lha khang / gos sku sogs bzhengs/ bstan pa'i sbyin bdag gtsang chen hor shāka dang / sgar pa don yod rdo rje dang / seng ge rtse pa 'phags pa rab brtan sogs kyis mthun rkyen sbyor bar mdzad cing zhabs kyi padmo la btugs/ rtsom pa yang / tshad ma'i bka' 'grel spyi don che chung gnyis/ /rnam rig ṭīka chen gnyis te rnam pa lnga/ /mngon pa gong ma'i bka' 'grel 'og ma'i spyi don che/ /phar phyin ṭīkka lugs snying spyi don gsum/ /rtsa 'jug ṭīkka stong mthun chen po gsum/ /'dul ba'i bka' 'grel las brgya'i ṭīkka dang / /so thar ṭīkka gzhi gsum las mchog sogs/ /bde gsang rnam bshad gser thur chos chen sogs/ /brtsam pa'i rnam grangs brjod par mi nus so/ /de ltar mdzad pa mthar phyin te dgung lo brgyad cu pa me mo yos gro zhun zla ba'i tshes lnga la gshegs so/ /thugs sras bstan pa 'dzin pa ni/ de dus grwa tshang go bzhi na 'chad nyan gnang ba'i shangs chen pa/ lcags ra ba/ rnal 'byor rgyal ba/ blo bzang ba sogs bgrang bar mi lang par byon no/ /des na shing pho byi lo paṇa shāka pa byon pa'i sa sprel nas brgya dang so bdun pa lags so// ༈ //sum stong lnga brgya dang re gcig 'das pa'i re gnyis pa sa mo bya la mdo khams su go bo rab 'byams pa bsod nams seng ge byon/ ngor dgon gsar btab pa'i lo de yin/ paṇa shāka pa las lo gcig gis gzhon/ lo bcu pa la byang chub sems dpa' kun dga' 'bum las rab tu byung /

de nas bcu dgu bzhes kyi bar du mkhan po dang go bo rab 'byams pa shes rab dpal sogs bsten te/ gzhung lugs gsum las lhag pa'i bcu phrag gcig mgrin pa'i lam du rgyu zhing ljen par mdzad de go bo rab 'byams pa zhes snga mo nas rang byon du grags/ nyi shu pa sa pho 'brug lor go rab 'byams shes rab dpal gyis/ rab 'byams la sogs bshes gnyen rgya phrag gcig /ces brgya 'bul gyi rnam grangs mang du bkod pa la gtso bor byas te/ rong ston smra ba'i seng ge dgung lo brgyad cu rtsa gnyis lon pa/ chos grwa na lend+rar phebs nas lo bcu gsum lon pa de nyid la rong ston chen po'i gsung gi bcud myang ste/ lo gnyis lon pa sbrul gyi lo la rong ston chen po dag pa'i zhing du bzhud pa nas lo de nyid la chos grwa chen po 'bras yul gsar tshugs kyi dga' ston gsar pa lang long du 'gyed pa'i tshe/ byams chen rab 'byams rje'i zhabs kyi padmor btugs/ lo ngo lnga la mdo phyogs kyi gnad ma lus pa la sgro 'dogs dpyad do/ /rang lo nyer lnga pa chu pho byi lo e wam̐ chos ldan du rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po'i zhabs pad bsten/ nyer drug pa'i shing pho byi lo rdo rje 'chang sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ sdom brtson sangs rgyas dpal bzang sogs pas mkhan po dang las gsang mdzad de bsnyen par rdzogs/ mdor na bya lo nas mo pho byi lor ngor chen zhi bar gshegs kyi bar lo ngo bzhi la gsung ngag sogs rgyud man ngag gsan/ byi lo ngor chen zhi bar gshegs na'ang / mus chen sogs mkhas pa du ma la gsung ngag sogs rgyud man ngag gi zab bcud blangs te/ lo brgyad la rgyud man ngag gi sgro 'dogs dpyad de/ rang lo so gnyis pa lcags mo sbrul lor mdo khams phyogs gom zung 'phos te 'bras yul nyid du phyag phebs pa na/ rab 'byams chen pos thugs brtse'i lcags kyus bzung ste/ so gsum pa sbrul lo nas sprel lo'i bar lo bzhi tsam zhig 'bras yul nyid du zur nas 'chad pa'i dbyangs kyi blo ldan yid gsos par byas/

kyai rdo rje'i gzhi bsnyen dang sdom gsum ṭīkka/ yum don rab gsal sogs rtsom pa'i sgo yang phye/ slar yang mus chen gyi thugs rje'i zhags pas drangs te mus su byon/ bya lo zab chos gsan pa dang gsang 'dus rtsod spong sogs mdzad/ so brgyad pa khyi lo rje mus chen chos rgyal rnam rgyal grags bzang gis byang ngam rings su spyan drangs pa'i zhabs 'bring du bkod de blo gsal 'ga' la legs bshad kyi skyes dang / kun rig rtsod spong / kyai rdor rtsod spong / rtsom gyi me tog kha phye/ me pho khyi lo de nyid kyi lo de'i rgyal zla'i tshes bco lnga la blo gsal don gnyer bcu phrag bzhi dang bcas/ rin spung nang so don yod rdo rje dpon blon gyis mthun pa'i rkyen sbyar te rta nag gser gling du chos kyi grwa btsugs/ khyi lo de nas sbrul lo'i bar lo bco brgyad kyi ring la blo gsal ha cang mang ba ma yin pa'i don gnyer sha stag la 'chad pa'i dbyangs kyis ngal gsos/ nyid kyi zhe lnga pa chu mo sbrul gyi lo de nyid la/ thub bstan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling chen po btab/ 'dus pa'i tshogs chen po la mdo sngags kyi dga' ston ngo mtshar rmad du byung bas spyir bstan pa'i snying po/ khyad par rnam rig gi bstan pa rma med par sor chud kyi lnga cu rtsa lnga pa chu mo yos la/ e wam̐ chos ldan gyi seng ge'i khri la zhabs sen bkod/ me pho rta'i bar lo bzhir rdo rje 'chang yab sras kyi dgongs pa rdzogs par mdzad/ rta lo de la yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel rgyal tshab tu dbang bskur te slar yang rnam par rgyal ba'i gling chen por phyag phebs/ bskal ldan rnams la mdo sngags kyi bka' drin stsal/ slar re gcig pa sa mo bya'i lo dpal ldan sa skyar chos kyi dga' ston spel/ tshur lam sngon po rdzong du chos kyi dga' ston stsol ba'i tshe cho 'phrul zla ba'i nyer gcig la zhi bar gshegs so/

/bstan pa 'dzin pa'i slob bu yang kong ston dbang phyug grub pa/ mus rab 'byams thugs rje dpal bzang po/ bka' bcu smra ba bsod nams rgya sogs bgrang bar mi bzod par byon no/ /des na shing byi 'di paṇa chen 'di nyid byon pa'i sa mo bya nas brgya dang so drug pa yin no// ༈ //sum stong lnga brgya dang re lnga 'das pa'i re drug pa chu mo glang la rgyal ba 'bum phrag gsum pa dang / 'jam dbyangs kun dga' chos bzang gnyis byon/ 'di gnyis paṇa chen shākya mchog ldan las lo lnga dang / kun mkhyen go bo rab 'byams pa las lo bzhis gzhon pa tsam mo/ /de yang rje paṇa chen g.yas ru byang gi sa'i thig le 'jam pa lhas sdings zhes grags pa'i 'dab khang dmar brag lung du byon/ lo bdun pa'i tshe chos rgyal dkon mchog legs pas byams chen 'jam gling rgyan gtsug lag khang dang bcas pa bzhengs/ byams phrug bdun brgya gsar du bsdus pa'i skabs su/ sems dpa' chen po gzhon nu rgyal mchog pas mkhan po mdzad nas rab tu byung / mdog chos 'khor sgang du paṇa chen sangs rgyas seng ge byang sems blo gros rin chen/ dol phrug chos bzang rnams las gzhung lugs chen po la gsan pa stsal/ dpal ldan sa skyar bka' bcu'i bshad pa stsal/ e wam̐ chos ldan rgyud de 'bras yul skyed tshal du kun mkhyen byams chen rab 'byams pas zhabs pad bsten/ rje 'di dang / rtse thang sang lhun/ zhwa lu bka' bcu pa gsum la 'bum 'dzin pa'i bka' gnang phebs/ rje 'dis zla ba gcig la thugs su smin/ tshig don gyi bshad pa kun mkhyen chos rje 'dus tshogs dang bcas pa la/ legs bshad bdud rtsi'i mchod pas brnyes te 'bum phrag gsum pa zhes mtshan gyi shis brjod snyan pa'i glu dbyangs zlos/ sgra pa she rin dang / shangs pa kun dga' dpal ldan la sgra kā tsan sogs rig gnas che chung la sbyangs pas paṇḍi ta zhes snyan pas grags/ sum cu pa chu pho rta lo kun mkhyen gau rab 'byams pa zur 'chad mdzad pa'i skabs su/

byams chen chos rje'i mkhan po/ gau rams chen pos las slob/ zhwa lu bka' bcu pas dus go ba mdzad/ 'jam dbyangs chos rje sogs mang zhig bsnyen par rdzogs/ de nyid kyi dbyar chos la rtse thang sogs su gzhung lugs drug cu'i bshad pa'i dga' ston spel/ so gcig pa lug lo dgun chos dpal ngam rings su sher phyin stong phrag brgya pa la bshad pa'i srol chen po gtod/ lug lo dbyar chos lho shel dkar du bshad pa'i chos sbyin rgyas par stsal/ so gnyis pa sprel lo glo bo smon thang gi chos sder 'bum gyi gtsos gzhung lugs brgya la bshad pa'i dga' ston sgrub/ chos rgyal a mgon drung du gdan du 'os pa'i mtha' can dang 'bol grum dang gsum gdan snyel 'bol gyi khri la/ rim bzhin 'bum gyi glegs bam ka pa kha pa ga pa nga pa/ rnams mgrin pa'i dpal nas bkod pas rgyal blon 'bangs ngo tshar gyi dpal la bkod de/ po sti lnga pa man chad gsung nas sgrogs pa dang / rgyal blon gyis thog drangs glo bo lung gang gi bskal ldan rnams la/ 'bum gyi lung dang bshad pa'i dga' ston phyogs gcig tu gnang bas/ rgyal blon kun gyis zhabs sen spyi bor blangs shing 'dod dgu'i mchod pa rgya cher phul/ so gsum pa bya lo shar lam mus chen drung du zab don gyi bdud rtsi zhus shing / skyed mos tshal du byams chen rab 'byams pa 'dus tshogs dang bcas pa la bsnyen cing bkur bas dges par mchod/ kun mkhyen gau rams pas zur 'chad ma gnang nas lo gcig song ba/ nyid kyi so bzhi pa khyi lo 'jam dbyangs chos rje dang gnyis la zur nas 'chad bshad spel ba'i 'os su bka' stsal/ lo bcu gsum gyi bar du blo gsal don gnyer nyis brgya skor la legs bshad yid gsos par mdzad/ zhe bdun pa phag mo mi dge ba'i rkyen grogs su shar te blo gsal shes ldan brgya phrag gnyis dang bcas/ bsod nams kyi dpal la dbang sgyur ba'i sde dpon so so'i mthun pa'i skyen sbyar te/

gnas nges med du legs par bshad pa'i char phab/ de yang yul dbus kyi sman ljongs su phag byi glang gsum/ gtsang chu gru gsum du stag yos 'brug gsum/ yar 'brog tu sbrul lo/ skyangs 'dur du rta lo/ nor bu sgang rgyang bo dong sogs su lug sprel gnyis te/ lo bcu bzhi'i bar du gnas nges med du 'chad pa'i zlos gar cir yang bsgyur ro/ /nyid kyi lnga bcu rtsa bdun pa sa mo bya lo gtsang stod bsod rgyal gyis mthun pa'i rkyen sbyar te/ zla ba lnga pa'i tshes bzang po la dpal gnyan yod bya gshongs kyi chos grwa chen po btab/ kun mkhyen gau rams chen po gshegs pa'i lo de yin/ de'i phyi lo nyid kyi nga brgyad pa khyi lo 'phags mchog klu sgrub rgyal tshab tu dbang bskur te lo bcu gsum du 'phags mchog rjes 'chad pa'i rgyun bzung zhing / paṇa chen chos rjes gnas nges med du bskal bar 'tshams pa la zab sngags kyi chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ nyid kyi bdun cu pa chu pho khyi lo 'phags mchog dag pa'i zhing du gshegs te/ slar nyid kyi gnyan yod gnas su mdo sngags kyi chos 'khor bskor/ khyi lo de la gnyan yod du bdag cag gi ston pa 'khor gnas brtan gyis bskor ba'i dri'i gtsug lag khang dang bcas pa bzhengs/ don gcig pa phag lo rab gnas kyi mnga' gsol/ nyid kyi don gnyis su slebs pa gnyan yod thebs nas lo bcu drug pa shing pho byi lo dpyid zla'i nyer gcig la dag pa'i zhing du gshegs/ rje 'di nyid kyis mdo sngags kyi chos gsan pa'i tshul yang / rje ngor chen yab sras la sa skya ngor lugs/ rnal 'byor pa bsam gtan dpal sogs la sa skya rdzongs lugs/ bshes gnyen blo gros rgyal mtshan sogs la rje btsun bo dong pa'i de nyid 'dus pa'i 'dus pa/ stag lung ngag dbang grags pa la dwags po bka' brgyud dang ras chung snyan brgyud sogs/ mkhyen rab yon tan dpal 'byung la shangs pa bka' brgyud dang ri chos so/

/ka tog nor bu bzang po la rdzogs pa chen po'i chos skor/ rnal 'byor rdo rje'i mtshan can la zhi byed sogs te ji ltar gsan pa de dag kyang gnas nges med du legs par sgom pas dus 'da' ba kho na lags shing / bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa ches cher gsal bar mdzad cing / khyad par rigs pa'i gnad zab mo blo gsal la nges pa bde lag tu skye ba la paṇa chen 'di'i 'phrin las kyi rgyun kho na bka' drin che ba yin no/ /thugs sras bstan 'dzin gyi slob bu yang / thugs sras 'phags mchog klu sgrub/ ar ston blo gros rgya mtsho/ kun mkhyen lcags thang chos rje/ rgyal ba dkon mchog dpal ba/ lho byang gi lha dbang rnam gnyis/ 'jam mgon blo gros bkra shis sogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa byon no// ༈ //'jam dbyangs kun dga' chos bzang ni chu mo glang gi lo de nyid la glo bo 'brog seb tu byon/ bcu pa la brag dkar sems dpa' las dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa nod/ bco brgyad pa la glo bo bdag pos sa skyar grwa skor dang / dbus gtsang du slob gnyer ba brgya phrag gsum tsam rdzongs brda gnang ba'i skabs su/ dpal ldan sa skyar blo gros gzhon nu'i bshad gsar dang / ngor du rje rdo rje 'chang dang mjal/ bcu dgu pa la e wam̐ chos ldan de nyid du rje rdo rje 'chang gis mkhan po/ brag dkar sems dpa' chen pos kha char ba zhes grags pa'i slob dpon/ gcung gzhon nu seng ges dus go ba mdzad de rab tu byung / bcu dgu pa lug gi lo'i stod la chos grwa chen po 'bras yul du phebs/ byams chen rab 'byams pa dang mjal/ nyid kyi nyi shur son zhing rje byams chen chos rje'i zhe gnyis pa skyed tshal thebs nas lo bzhir slebs pa lcags pho sprel lo nas byams chen rab 'byams pa lus dang grib ma ltar bsten cing gsung gi bdud rtsi mdo sngags kyi zab bcud la tshim par rol/ sum cu pa byams chen rab 'byams rje dang gau rams chen pos mkhan slob las bsnyen par rdzogs/

so bzhi pa khyi lo nas paṇa chen 'bum pa dang gnyis kyis zur 'chad mdzad de rgyal ba'i bstan pa phan tshun 'gran pa bzhin du rgyas par mdzad/ nyid kyi nga gsum pa shing mo sbrul lo byams chen rab 'byams pa dag pa'i zhing du gshegs/ lnga cu rtsa bzhi pa me pho rta lo nas skyed mos tshal gyi gdan seng ge'i khri la zhabs sen bkod pa'i sgo nas/ don gcig bzhes kyi bar du mdo sngags kyi bstan pa bskyangs/ don gcig pa chu mo phag gi lo tshes bcu gcig la zhi bar gshegs/ thugs sras bstan 'dzin mang du byon yang bstan pa la phan pa'i bshes gnyen nyid kyi gdan sa ba nyid dang / chos 'khor lhun po 'debs pa po paṇa chen dngos grub dpal 'bar dang / gzha' ri dgon gsar 'debs pa po lha dbang blo gros rnams so/ /des na shing byi 'di paṇa chen 'bum phrag gsum pa dang / 'jam dbyangs kun dga' chos bzang gnyis byon pa'i chu glang nas brgya dang so bzhi pa lags so// ༈ //sum stong drug brgya'i skabs su byon pa'i rgyal ba lcags thang pa chen po la sogs pa ste/ sum stong drug brgya dang drug 'das pa'i bdun pa shing pho rta lor gtsang lcags thang du lcags thang rab 'byams pa bsod nams byon/ bcu gcig pa la yul de'i sangs rgyas gling zhes bya bar bsod nams legs pa dang / 'chad bka' bcu pas mkhan slob mdzad de rab tu byung / bcu gcig pa de nyid nas bco brgyad kyi bar la mdog chos 'khor sgang du bshes gnyen shākya rgyal mtshan dang blo gros rgyal mtshan gnyis la rigs pa'i rnam 'gyur legs par sbyangs/ bcu dgu pa la gnyan yod bya gshongs thebs nas lo bzhi lon pa'i tshe/ chos grwa de nyid du 'jam dbyangs 'phags mchog klu sgrub la grags chen bco brgyad kyi legs bshad dang gsung ngag sogs kyi zab gnad lo grangs brgyad kyi bar du myong / paṇa chen 'bum phrag gsum pa la gsung ngag shangs pa bka' rgyud/ ras chung snyan rgyud sogs zab khrid kyi bcud chen blangs/

nyer lnga pa la dpal 'khor lo bde mchog dang / nyer drug pa la rtse thang du gzhung lugs bcu bdun gyi legs bshad kyi skyes phul/ nyer dgu pa la mdog ya ga chos sdings su byams pa dkon mchog dpal gyis mkhan po/ lu phu gdan pa pa dbon chen brtson 'grus rgya mtshos las slob/ mtshungs med chos dpal 'byor bas gsang ston mdzad de bsnyen par rdzogs/ mdor na dgung lo nyer gcig pa nas sum cu'i bar blo gsal don gnyer mang po la sgos su legs bshad kyi gdams/ so gcig nas so lnga'i bar spyi nas bskos pa'i zur 'chad gnang / so drug nas lo gsum gsang phu chos grags kyis mkhan po/ rje 'di nyid kyis slob dpon mdzad/ so dgu pa chu pho sprel lo dpal 'bum phrag gsum pa'i rgyal tshab dam par mnga' gsol te/ de nas dgung lo re gcig bzhes kyi bar lo grangs nyi shu rtsa drug tu dpal 'bum phrag gsum pa'i gdan seng ge'i khri la zhabs bkod de 'chad pa'i sgra dbyangs sgrags/ mdor na nyer gcig pa la sgos su legs bshad gnang ba nas/ re lnga pa la gdan sa gtad kyi bar lo kun dril bzhi cu zhe bzhi'i bar du mdo phyogs kyi 'chad nyan kho nas bstan pa rin po che gsal bar mdzad/ 'chad pa'i skabs de yang mtshungs med rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi dngos slob shes rab rin chen la rdzongs lugs kyi gsung ngag sogs gsan pa mang du mdzad/ re bzhi pa me mo bya lo paṇa chen bzang po bkra shis la gdan sa btad de na bza' brag phug tu gdan phebs/ re lnga pa sa pho khyi lo chos rgyal tshe dbang rdo rjes ngam rings kyi mkhan por mnga' gsol/ re bdun pa lcags pho byi lo'i zla ba bcu gcig pa'i gnam gang la dag pa'i zhing du gshegs/ 'chad pa'i 'bras bu bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu yang brgya rtsa gcig byon par bshad kyang / gtso bor bsdus na paṇa grub bzang po bkra shis/ 'jam dbyangs phyogs las rnam rgyal/ skyid gshongs pa chen po blo gros rnam rgyal/

'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ 'dzam gling rab 'byams sangs rgyas lhun grub/ lnga rig bkra shis chos 'phel/ gdan gcig pa shākya rgya mtsho/ mkhas mchog grags pa bzang po/ 'jam mgon dpal ldan bkra shis dang brgyad do/ /kho bo cag kyang lo bco lnga lon pa'i tshe kun mkhyen chen pos gdan sa paṇa grub bzang po bkra shis la gtad tsam gyi lo dpal gnyan yod kyi gtsug lag khang du rje 'di nyid kyi zhabs pad bsten/ rab tu byung ba'i mkhan po dang / bla ma'i rnal 'byor sogs kyi bka' drin stsal te dges pa chen pos bskyangs shing byin rlabs snying la sim/ ming bsgyur ba'i tshe khyod kyi skya ming la ci zer gsungs/ klu rgyal nor bur 'bod zhus pas/ ming zur gyi klu ming de ma chad pa gcig dgos pa 'dug gsungs/ da khyod yon tan che ba 'dams sam grags pa che ba 'dams gsungs/ ci yang ma spobs pa la yon tan che ba dga' mod ming la 'di bzhin gyis gsungs ba phebs shing brtse bas bskyangs/ mdor na 'chad pa kho nas bstan pa spel ba la rong ston gyi rjes su kun mkhyen lcags thang pa 'di kho na bka' drin lhag par che ba yin no// ༈ //sum stong drug brgya dang nyi shu rtsa bdun 'das pa'i rtsa brgyad pa shing mo yos la paṇa grub bzang po bkra shis byang phyi 'brog gi dol khrod du byon/ yongs kyi 'dren pa lha mang lcags gsum/ 'chi med dbang po/ 'dzam gling rab 'byams pa ste/ lnga la mdo sngags kyi gsan pa mdzad cing / zhe gsum pa me mo bya la gnyan yod bya gshongs kyi khrir 'khod/ lo ngo bdun du 'chad pa'i rgyun bsrings/ zhe dgu pa chu mo yos la dpal ngam rings kyi dbu mdzad dang / ya ga chos sding gi bshad grwa bskyangs/ lnga cu rtsa gsum pa me mo lug la chos sde chen po'i khri chen po la zhabs brten nas lo bco brgyad du bstan pa bskyangs/ bdun cu pa shing pho byi lo 'di nyid la dag pa'i zhing du phebs so/

/de ltar kho bos bstan rtsis 'di ni shing pho byi lo nas mgo brtsams te/ me pho stag lo rdzogs par grub pa yin mod/ 'di yan gyi rtsis rnams ni shing pho byi lo sor bzhag nas rtsis pa yin la/ deng sang gi me stag ni 'das lo nas lo grangs sum stong drug brgya dgu cu rtsa dgu pa sum stong bdun brgyar nyag ma gcig gis ma chog pa'i lo de yin no zhes shes par mdzod cig/ ༈ //sum stong brgya so bdun 'das pa'i so brgyad pa shing mo glang la rgyal ba skyid gshongs pa blo gros rnam rgyal 'dar skyid gshongs su byon/ bco brgyad pa la gnyan yod du lcags thang rje'i zhabs pad bsten te mdo phyogs sbyangs/ phyis su rje blo gsal rgya mtsho dang rje btsun kun dga' grogs mchog gi drung du gsung ngag sogs sngags kyi zab don blangs/ nyi shu rtsa lnga pa la dpal 'khor lo bde chen dang / nye drug pa la byang ngam rings su bshad pa'i snyan grags ches cher khyab/ nyer bdun pa la dpal chos 'khor gling gi bshad grwa bzung ste lo bcur bstan pa spel/ so brgyad pa la gnyan yod kyi gdan seng ge'i khri mnan te/ lo brgyad du lung rigs kyi bstan pa bzung / mi dbang chos rgyal yab sras mnyes par byas te 'tsho ba'i rten du mchod gzhis bzang po zhus te gnyan yod la mthun rkyen du sbyar/ zhe brgyad pa la ngam rings chos sde'i dbu mdzad dang / ya ga chos sding gi bshad grwa skyongs shig par/ chos kyi rgyal po tshe dbang rdo rje yab sras kyi bkas bkug ste lo bdun du 'chad pa'i dbyangs snyan par zlos/ lnga cu rtsa lnga pa la gnas bzang po snyag phur gdan phabs te zab don nyams su bzhes/ drug cu rtsa gcig pa glang gi lo la chos kyi rgyal po kun dga' rin chen sku mched kyis dpal ngam rings kyi mkhan por mnga' gsol te chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bzhin pa'o/ /mthar dgung lo brgyad cu gya gcig pa bya lo zla ba gsum pa'i nyer lnga la dag pa'i zhing du gshegs so//

༈ //rje btsun dam pa kun dga' grogs mchog me mo yos la glo bor byon/ drug cu pa me stag zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i tshes brgyad la chos lung byang rtser gshegs/ rje btsun tshar pa blo gsal rgya mtsho shing pho stag la mdar mang mkhar dmu ru byon/ don gsum pa me stag zla ba bdun pa'i tshes bco lnga la mdar brang mo che'i dgon par gshegs/ rje 'di gnyis gshegs pa'i me stag 'di ni 'das lo nas gsum stong dgu cu rtsa dgu pa yin no/ /zhes gong du bshad pa las shes dgos so/ /kho bo cag gi 'dren pa 'di gsum gyi rnam par thar pa ni logs su spro bar sha chags pas 'dir ma bris so/ /'dir bstan rtsis mdzad pa'i rnam thar yang phyis logs nas 'chad do zhes smra 'o// ༈ //gnyis pa dgon gnas rim par byon tshul la/ bstan pa phyi dar la 'das lo nas sum stong brgya dang don lnga 'das pa'i don drug pa chu mo lug la mang mkhar mu gu lung zhes pa lam 'bras pa'i gnas de byon/ 'debs pa po rje gā ya dha ra dang 'brog mi lo tsā ba yin/ chu mo lug lo de nas shing pho byi lo'i bar lnga brgya dang nyi shu rtsa gnyis lon/ ༈ /sum stong brgya dang brgyad cu rtsa gcig pa sa mo glang la bo dong e byon/ 'debs mkhan bshes gnyen mi ṭa chen po yin/ sa glang de nas brgya dang bcu bdun lon/ ༈ /sum stong brgya dang dgu cu rtsa drug pa shing pho 'brug la lam 'bras pa'i gnas se mkhar chung byon/ de nas lnga brgya dang brgyad cu rtsa gnyis lon/ ༈ /sum stong dang nyis brgyar slebs pa'i me mo lug la byang rwa sgreng byon/ 'brom ston gyi lnga cu rtsa gcig lon pa'i tshe btab/ me lug de nas bzhi brgya dang dgu cu rtsa brgyad lon/ 'di dus gsal ltar yin/ 'brom gyi lam yig sogs ltar na jo bo gshegs pa'i phyi lo me mo lug la snye thang du jo bo'i gshegs rdzongs rgya cher sgrub/ de'i phyi lo sa pho sprel lo 'brom rang gi lnga cu rtsa gnyis lon pa'i tshe rwa sgreng btab ces bya'o/

༈ /sum stong gnyis brgya dang bzhi lon pa'i lcags mo lug la gsang phu ne'u thog chos sde byon/ de nas bzhi brgya dang dgu cu rtsa bzhi 'debs mkhan rngog legs pa'i shes rab bo/ ༈ /sum stong nyis brgya dang drug tu slebs pa'i chu mo glang la bod kyi rdo rje gdan dpal ldan sa skya byon/ 'khon dkon mchog rgyal pos bzhi cu lon pa'i tshe btab/ chu glang de nas bzhi brgya dang dgu cu rtsa gnyis lon/ ༈ /'das lo nas sum stong nyis brgya dang brgyad cu rtsa drug pa chu mo bya la snar thang gi chos sde gtum ston blo gros grags kyis btab/ de nas shing byi 'di bar la bzhi brgya dang bcu gnyis lon/ ༈ /sum stong nyis brgya dang dgu cu rtsa gcig pa sa pho stag la ye shes seng ges phag mo grub btab/ de nas bzhi brgya dang bdun/ ༈ /sum stong sum brgya dang brgyad du sleb pa shing mo lug la tshal/ zhang brtson grags kyis btab/ de nas sum brgya dang dgu cu/ ༈ /sum stong sum brgya dang bcu gnyis pa sa mo phag la 'bri khung byon/ 'debs mkhan 'bri khung 'jig rten mgon pos lo so bdun lon pa'i tshe'o/ /de nas sum brgya dang brgyad/ ༈ /sum stong sum brgya dang bcu pa lcags mo byi lo stag lung byon/ 'debs mkhan stag lung bkra shis dpal gyi so dgu lon pa'i tshe'o/ /de nas gsum brgya dang bdun/ ༈ /sum stong sum brgya dang bcu dgu pa me mo lug la gung thang zhang brtson grags kyis btab/ de nas gsum brgya dang don brgyad/ ༈ /sum stong sum brgya dang dgu cu rtsa gnyis pa sa mo lug la zang zang ne rings byon/ 'debs mkhan sras bde legs rgyal mtshan de nas sum brgya dang drug lon/ ༈ /sum stong bzhi brgya dang nyag ma gcig tu slebs pa sa pho 'brug lo sa skya'i lha khang chen po 'phags pa rin po ches so bzhi bzhes pa'i tshe dpon chen shākya bzang pos khri skor bcu gsum bskul nas btab/ de nas nyis brgya dgu cu rtsa bdun lon/

dpal ngam rings kyi chos sde yang gsum stong bzhi brgya nyi shu rtsa 'dren gyi skabs su btab par sems te/ mkhan po gsum pa gangs khrod pa grags pa dpal gyi dgung lo bzhi cu lon pa lcags mo lug gi lo si tu rdo rje mgon po dang 'dzim pa rgyal mtshan dpal gyi bkas bskul te mkhan po mdzad pa yin la/ khong gi mkhan po mdzad pa'i lo de la grwa pa phogs len pa lnga cu dang / khong dpon slob bcu ste drug cu tsam las ma byung / lo gnyis nas brgya dang bcu bzhir 'phel bas brgya ston bzang po mdzad ces gangs khrod pa'i rnam thar na bzhugs shing / khong gi mkhan po gnang ba'i lo de ni 'das lo nas gsum stong bzhi brgya drug cu rtsa drug pa yin la/ de'i gong du yang chos sde btab nas mkhan rab gnyis song ba las shes so/ /chos sde 'di nyid kyi mkhan rab ni/ shākya seng ge nas 'jam dbyangs blo gros rnam rgyal gyi bar nyi shu rtsa brgyad yin la/ bzang ldan chos sde yang dpal ngam rings chos sde'i rjes tsam la byon pa yin te/ kun spangs chos grags dpal gyis bdag rkyen mdzad de/ bzang ldan/ 'ga' rong / chu dga' chos sde gsum dus mnyam du btab ces 'byung zhing / bka' lnga pa dpal 'byor shes rab dgung lo brgyad bzhes pa'i tshe rjong chos sde gsar du btsugs/ khong gis so gnyis pa la rdzong chos sde'i mkhan po mdzad/ so bdun par ngam rings chos sde'i mkhan po mdzad/ ces 'di nyid kyi rnam thar las byung ba gang zhig chos rje bka' lnga pa de nyid ngam rings chos sde chen po'i mkhan rab dgu pa yin pa las so/ /dpal bzang ldan gyi mkhan po ni/ sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen/ kun spangs chos grags dpal/ mkhan chen sangs rgyas bzang po/ gzhon nu tshul khrims/ gzhon nu shes rab ste kho na las ma byung ngo / /rtse thang gi chos sde lcags mo yos la btab ces deb sngon las 'byung bas sum stong bzhi brgya brgyad cu rtsa bzhi pa lcags mo yos la rtse thang byon/

de nas nyis brgya dang bcu gnyis lon/ 'debs mkhan tā'i si tu byang chub kyi rgyal mtshan zhes grags pa khri bskor bcu gsum la dbang bsgyur zhing sne'u brag tog gzhis ka rin sprung / bsam grub rtse sogs 'debs pa po de yin/ ༈ /sum stong lnga brgya dang bcu ru slebs pa me sbrul la mdog zhe dgon gyi sngags dgon byon/ de nas brgya dang brgyad 'debs mkhan chen buddha shrī lnga cu rtsa gcig bzhes pa rje dpal ldan tshul khrims la gsung ngag thog mar gsan pa'i tshe yin/ ༈ /'das lo nas sum stong lnga brgya bzhi cu rtsa gnyis pa sa mo glang la 'brog ri bo dge ldan byon/ de nas brgya dang lnga bcu rtsa drug 'debs mkhan rje blo bzang grags pa lnga cu rtsa gsum lon pa na'o/ ༈ /sum stong lnga brgya dang drug cu rtsa gnyis pa sa mo bya lo ngor dgon gsar byon/ 'debs mkhan rje rdo rje 'chang gi bzhi cu rtsa brgyad lon pa na'o/ /sa mo bya de nas brgya so drug lon/ ༈ /sum stong lnga brgya drug cu rtsa dgu pa me pho 'brug la na lend+ra byon/ de nas brgya dang nyi shu rtsa dgu 'debs mkhan rong ston gyi bdun cu lon pa'i tshe'o/ ༈ /sum stong lnga brgya dang brgyad cu pa me mo yos la bkra shis lhun po byon/ 'debs mkhan thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub kyi lo nga bdun lon pa'i tshe'o/ /'di 'bras yul las lo gnyis kyis snga ba tsam mo/ ༈ /sum stong lnga brgya dang brgyad cu rtsa gnyis pa sa mo sbrul la 'bras yul skyed tshal byon/ de nas brgya dang bcu drug 'debs mkhan byams chen rab 'byams pa so dgu lon pa'i tshe'o/ ༈ /sum stong lnga brgya dang brgyad cu rtsa drug pa chu mo bya la mdog ya ga chos sding byon/ de nas brgya dang bcu gnyis/ 'debs mkhan mkhas btsun dpal ldan bzang po'o/ ༈ /sum stong drug brgya dang nyag ma gcig 'das pa'i gnyis pa sa mo glang la dpal shākya mchog ldan zhe gnyis lon pa'i tshe thub bstan gser mdog can du bshad pa'i grwa btsugs/

sa glang de nas shing bya'i bar la dgu cu rtsa drug ༈ /sum stong drug brgya dang lnga ru slebs pa chu pho 'brug la mdog lo bu rdzongs lugs kyi sngags dgon byon/ grub chen chos rin gyis lnga cu rtsa gnyis lon pa'i tshe btab/ ༈ /sum stong drug brgya dang nyag ma drug tu slebs pa chu mo sbrul la kun mkhyen gau rab 'byams pas zhe lnga lon pa'i tshe thub bstan rnam par rgyal ba'i bshad grwa btab/ de nas go gnyis lon/ ༈ /sum stong drug brgya dang nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa sa mo bya la thub bstan gnyan yod bya gshongs dpal 'bum phrag gsum pas lnga cu rtsa bdun lon tshe btab/ de nas bdun cu rtsa drug lon/ ༈ /thub bstan yangs chen de nas lo bzhi sa byi lor btab/ ༈ /sum stong drug brgya dang so lnga pa chu pho khyi lor dge bcu rdzong lugs kyi sngags dgon byon/ de nas drug cu rtsa gsum/ 'debs mkhan byams pa dkon mchog dpal bas dgung lo lnga cu rtsa bzhi'i steng du btab/ ༈ /gangs can khrod 'dir khro phu byams chen zhes grags pa ni/ paṇa chen shākya shrī bod du byon pa'i shing pho khyi lo tsam nas mgo brtsams te/ sum stong sum brgya zhe bzhi pa'i bzhi cu rtsa lnga pa chu pho sprel lo paṇa chen de nyid kyis gtso byas te rab tu gnas pa'i me tog gtor/ khro lo byams pa dpal lo zhe gcig lon pa'i tshe yin/ ༈ /sum stong lnga brgya dang drug cu rtsa drug 'das pa'i rtsa bdun pa shing pho stag lor/ dpal ngam rings kyi byams chen byon/ de nas brgya dang so gcig 'debs mkhan chos rgyal dkon mchog legs pa/ mkhan po a nanda ma ti dang / seng ge dpal rin pa gnyis kyi lo la/ sems dpa' chen po gzhon nu rgyal mchog gis bkod pa gnang nas btab/ de'i tshe sems dpa' chen po gzhon nu ba lnga cu rtsa lnga yin/ a nanda pa drug cu re gsum lon/ ༈ /sum stong drug brgya 'das nas nyag gcig gi steng du slebs pa sa pho byi lo rin sprung byams chen byon/

de nas dgu cu rtsa bdun/ 'di'i zhal bkod kyang byang sems chen po bas gnang zer bas dgung lo brgyad cu rtsa drug pa'i lo yin no/ /de ltar kho bo'i bstan rtsis 'di ni shing pho byi ba nas brtsam/ me pho stag la rdzogs par grub pa yin mod/ 'di yan chad 'das lo nas du song sogs rtsis pa ni shing byi yan chad gzhir bzhag pa yin la/ rdzogs par grub pa'i me pho stag lo 'di ni 'das lo nas sum stong drug brgya dgu cu rtsa dgur slebs pa'i lo de yin pas/ sngar rtsis pa'i steng du lo gnyis bsnan te me stag yan la gsal bar shes par gyis shig de ltar bstan rtsis lhag bsam rab dkar ces bya ba bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu dam pa rnams la yid ches pa'i rnam thar lo rgyus dang sbyar te/ bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa spyi bye brag la gus pa skyed pa'i phyir 'dren pa dam pa rnam gsum gyi zhabs rdul gtsug gis mchod pas/ lung rtogs kyi bstan pa spyi bye brag la so sor ma 'dres pa'i rnam dpyod kyi spobs pa gzu bor gnas pa'i chos bzhin rjes su 'brang pas so so la ma dad pa'i snyog pa'i dri ma bsal ba/ shākya'i dge slong sde snod 'dzin pa mang du thos pa klu sgrub ces bya bas/ ston pa chos dbyings su bzhugs nas sum stong brgya phrag drug dang / bcu phrag dgur gcig gis ma mchog pa me pho stag gi sa ga zla ba'i dus bzang po la dpal ya ga chos sdings kyi mdun sa chen por sbyar ba 'dis kyang bu ram shing pa'i bstan pa rin po che bshad sgrub thos bsam sgom gsum dang / 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi sgo nas phyogs mtha' dag tu dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig de ltar bdag gi sug bris su bgyis pa las/ slad kyi 'das lo nas sum stong bdun brgya nyi shu pa thams cad 'dul zhes pa me mo phag gi lo zla ba brgyad pa'i dkar phyogs rdzogs pa gnyis pa'i tshes la/

'dar chos 'khor yang rtse'i sngags grwa blo bshad gling gi gtsug lag khang du yi ge'i 'du byed phul du byung ba bzang dger phu ba gzhon nu blo gsal 'jam pa'i rdo rjes mi phyed pa'i dad 'dun kho nas zab ste bris pa'i rnam dkar dge bas tshe dang dpal 'byor zla ba yar ngo ltar gyur cig/ ༈ //rgyal bstan gnam sngon 'od kyi zhu ba bzhin/ /bstan 'dzin rgyu skar rnam 'od 'jug pa'i phreng / /phan bde'i lo thog ze'u 'bru rgyas pa'i dpal/ /'khor ba ji srid brtan par mdzad du gsol// //dge'o// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 166 mang thos klu sgrub rgya mtsho/ bstan rtsis chos 'byung gsal ba'i nyin byed/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 165
